Ending or aborting a match restores every participant and world object.

items.name: Shooting Stars
devNotes: Main 62d662706: #1489 swing timing, animation and star varbits from captures.

PR #584 and PR #883 (60a8ac359) implement the landing cadence, layered mining/stardust, size/level gates, discovery bonus, Darkmeyer repeat-site redirect, Dusuri's shop pricing/Celestial ring and the noticeboard.
The 83-site landing table is data-driven; some landing geometry, shop wording and the Random Events vicinity radius remain inferred rather than captured.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2511 feat(mining): Cam Torum calcified rocks and oozing water; #2663 Store and keep gems in an open gem bag. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3966 Let Grace and other reward-currency shops buy their stock back. #3835 World config: plugins declare their own options (v0.1). #3608 Reward-currency shops buy nothing back. 7 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: World spawn cadence, tiers and entry
steps: Add one scheduler task submitted with api.getTaskManager().submit(...) that owns exactly one active star and a next-fall timestamp; roll the landing site from the 82 documented sites (21 free-to-play) without repeating the previous one and pick a crash size of 6-9 layers.

Land the star as a GameObject placed from object-spawns.json (or a new data/definitions entry) and deplete one layer on a fixed 7-minute timer while at least one player is mining, per the wiki size table; enforce the per-layer Mining level from the size table (sizes 1-9 -> levels 10..90).
On shutdown stop the scheduler and deregister any spawned star; on startup begin a fresh cadence instead of resuming a half-mined star.
acceptanceCriteria: Only one star object exists on the world at any time and a new star removes the previous one.
Prospecting the star reveals its layer size and depletion percentage, and a player below the layer's level cannot mine it.

taskDetails.name: Core mining loop and per-layer XP
steps: Reuse the pickaxe table, swing animations and sounds from Mining.plugin.js (PICKAXES/PICKAXES_DESC), but roll stardust from this plugin: 29% at level 1 scaling to 46% at level 99, granting stardust plus 32 Mining XP per stardust (32.8 with the full prospector kit, 16 on free-to-play).
Mining enhancers that multiply yield must not affect the star, and uncut gems can be rolled from the gem table with a charged amulet of glory increasing the rate.

Track per-player contribution against the shared star so the first player to mine it receives double stardust for the next 300 mined from any star; that discovery bonus persists through logout and server updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Two players mining the same star advance the shared layer once per interval and each gains stardust independently.
The discovery bonus is exactly 300 doubled stardust and is neither lost on reconnect nor reset by unrelated mining.

taskDetails.name: Rewards, points and noticeboard
steps: Persist each account's stardust with api.persistAttribute and register it as the currency for Dusuri's Star Shop using the wiki prices (celestial ring 2,000, star fragment 3,000, bag of gems 300, soft clay pack 150).
Record the last five discoverers on a Shooting Star Noticeboard object and refresh it on each discovery; this is a world object, not a new interface.
Route the rock golem pet roll through the existing Pets.plugin.js path rather than a second pet roll here.
acceptanceCriteria: Stardust survives logout and is spendable at the documented shop prices.
Stardust is credited once per successful roll and never duplicated on reconnect.

taskDetails.name: Persistence, restart and cleanup
steps: Use onServerStartup/onServerShutdown to own the star task and clear any spawned star object; never persist the live star's layer or location.
Persist only per-player stardust and the discovery-bonus counter with api.persistAttribute.
Guard against hot-reload by sweeping World.getObjects() for the star id on register and deregistering strays, mirroring the stale-fire cleanup in Firemaking.plugin.js.
acceptanceCriteria: A restart never leaves a star object or a duplicate scheduler running.
Reconnecting mid-layer neither resets nor duplicates the player's stardust.

items.name: Evil Trees
devNotes: Not counted toward progress (weight 0): Evil Trees is RuneScape 3 content and is not in OSRS.

Greenfield world event. Model the depleting shared object and respawn task on Mining.plugin.js (depleteRock/RockRespawnTask), and the axe/log/XP tables on Woodcutting.plugin.js plus Firemaking.plugin.js.

Confirm scope before coding: on the OSRS wiki the title Evil_Trees does not exist and 'evil tree' redirects to the removed Ent random event; the tiered Evil Tree D&D with normal/oak/willow/maple/yew/magic/elder tiers is RuneScape 3. If this server means OSRS, implement the Ent random event (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ent_(random_event)); do not invent OSRS tiers or rewards that are not on the wiki.
Either variant: spawn exactly one world tree at a time deterministically, share its health across all choppers, split rewards by contribution, and reset the cadence on restart.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2511 feat(mining): Cam Torum calcified rocks and oozing water; #2528 Implement remaining Morytania diary activities; #2548 Add remaining Kourend Diary skill and combat actions; #2621 Keep calcified rocks standing for Endless Harvest miners when the water stops; #2658 Add the Runite Golem's rock and the Wilderness Diary's rune scimitar task; #2663 Store and keep gems in an open gem bag. (10 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: World spawn cadence and entry
steps: Schedule one deterministic world timer via api.getTaskManager() that grows one evil tree at a time from documented sapling/landing locations; begin a fresh cycle after a restart rather than resuming a mature tree.

Select the documented tier (normal, oak, willow, maple, yew, magic, elder) and place the sapling/mature GameObject from object-spawns.json; higher tiers require the matching Woodcutting/Firemaking level.
There is no lobby - players interact with the sapling/tree directly. If implementing the OSRS Ent random event instead, spawn the ent on the chopper's active tree rather than a world timer.
acceptanceCriteria: Only one evil tree is active per world and its tier and location are deterministic from the scheduler seed.
A restart never leaves a sapling that can never grow.

taskDetails.name: Core activity loop and mechanics
steps: Track the tree's health as shared world state owned by one task so every chopper contributes; reuse Woodcutting.plugin.js's axe/success logic and animation cadence for the chop rolls and Firemaking.plugin.js for any nurture/burn stage.
The tree progresses sapling -> mature -> felled; rewards are only granted when it is felled, and both mining enhancers and duplicate interactions must not apply.
If modelling the OSRS Ent: continue chopping an ent risks breaking the axe, the ent shows as a distinct option colour / yellow minimap dot, and one ent affects all players chopping that tree.
acceptanceCriteria: Tree health is authoritative and shared; two choppers do not each deplete a private copy.
Contribution per player is recorded for the reward split.

taskDetails.name: Rewards and points
steps: On felling, award the documented Woodcutting/Firemaking/Farming XP and noted log/coin rewards once per participant, scaled by tier and by each player's contribution (kindling), reading exact values from the wiki reward table.
Grant any event-specific outfit or pet roll through the existing Pets.plugin.js path only.
Handle a full inventory by dropping noted rewards or messaging the player - never silently delete a reward.
acceptanceCriteria: Each participant receives exactly one reward bundle per felled tree, proportional to contribution.
Repeated interaction with a felled tree grants nothing.

taskDetails.name: Persistence, reset and cleanup
steps: Persist only per-player contribution and any pet/outfit unlock; the tree object and its health are ephemeral and must be deregistered on death, timeout and shutdown.
On register/server-startup sweep World.getObjects() for stale tree ids and deregister them, mirroring the stale-fire cleanup in Firemaking.plugin.js.
Cancel the scheduler on onServerShutdown so no orphaned timer survives a restart.
acceptanceCriteria: No tree object or scheduler task survives a restart, logout, or plugin reload.
Contribution persists across a reconnect within the same tree's lifetime without duplicating rewards.

items.name: Managing Miscellania
devNotes: Implemented in PR #971 (05e06f217): Throne of Miscellania/Royal Trouble gates, coffer/approval/allocation interface, daily charging and resource accrual from lastCollected, Advisor Ghrim collection and persisted kingdom state.
Workers/coffer caps and resource tables live in data/kingdom.json; tests cover offline accrual, approval decay, allocation and logout/restart persistence.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4057 feat(leagues): expand Demonic Pacts task trigger coverage. #3274 Credit Fremennik diary for earning full Miscellania approval.

taskDetails.name: Entry, kingdom access and coffer
steps: Gate the Manage interface on Throne of Miscellania, with Royal Trouble enabling the expanded worker count and coffer cap; open the coffer to deposit/withdraw coins and persist the balance with api.persistAttribute.
Validate deposits against the wiki cap (base vs Royal Trouble) and refuse withdrawals above the stored balance.
Refresh any coffer/approval varbits the cache interface reads rather than writing component text, following Windmill.plugin.js's varbit refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: A player without the quest cannot open Manage and a deposit above the cap is rejected.
Coffer balance is correct after logout and login.

taskDetails.name: Approval and daily resource collection
steps: Track approval 0-100, decayed over time and raised by the documented kingdom tasks (chopping maple, mining coal, fishing, farming) with per-player persistence.

Every 24 hours charge the coffer 10% (capped per the wiki) and accrue resources across the allocated groups - maple logs, herbs, fish, coal, flax, seeds plus any Royal Trouble extras - scaled by approval.
Compute accrual from (now - lastCollected) so offline days are paid correctly, and hand the resources over via Advisor Ghrim.
acceptanceCriteria: Accrual for a multi-day absence matches the daily formula and approval level.
Approval below 100 reduces output proportionally rather than being ignored.

taskDetails.name: Rewards, allocation and points
steps: Enforce that allocations sum to the worker count and scale each resource's output by approval; grant resources once per collection.
Keep reward item ids in item-gameplay.json and any drop-shaped tables in npc-drops.json rather than hardcoding.
Handle a full inventory by holding the collection until space is available instead of deleting it.
acceptanceCriteria: Collected resources match the allocation and approval exactly and are granted once.
A full inventory keeps the pending collection rather than losing it.

taskDetails.name: Persistence, reset and cleanup
steps: Persist coffer, approval, allocation and lastCollected per account with api.persistAttribute; never reset them on restart.
Cancel the per-player task on logout and on onServerShutdown, and re-submit it on login from the persisted timestamp.
Ensure a disconnect mid-collection cannot duplicate or lose resources.
acceptanceCriteria: Kingdom state survives restart and produces identical accrual on reload.
No per-player task leaks after logout or shutdown.

items.name: Random events
devNotes: Main 62d662706: #1504 Drill Demon, Mime and Gravedigger unlock their emotes once the outfit is complete, before the lamp.
Main 4b1eac7f6: #1253 rewards that do not fit are dropped for three hours instead of refused.

PRs #468/#703 implemented the event roster, persisted real-time scheduling, invitation/session cleanup and return-location recovery; PR #884 (7c726f687) adds ordinary-bank, old-Hunter, underwater/Kalphite, Ferox, GE-plaza and crashed-star vicinity eligibility plus the missing managed-area exceptions.
Remaining: landscape/creature habitat edges, the GE footpath cutoff, the star radius and some combat eligibility edges are approximations rather than live-captured boundaries.
Optional means dismissal/ignoring; there is no saved opt-out toggle, and invitations do not teleport until accepted.
Main 82657e165: #1601 the Quiz Master seats the player upstairs and asks real odd-one-out questions.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1728/#1729/#1730 and #1809 reconcile event flows, rewards and cleanup against recordings; #1876 restores native Beekeeper puzzle dragging.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2695 Fix rev 241 client actions the server dropped or misrouted (Accept Aid, teleport warnings, furnace, nexus, clans, fairy log, close buttons). Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3835 World config: plugins declare their own options (v0.1). #3728 Random events: re-mounted side tabs get their click flags back.

taskDetails.name: Trigger cadence and entry
steps: Schedule a persisted real-time due timestamp 60-120 minutes after the last event, scan every five in-game minutes, and rebase an overdue offline timestamp by 10-70 minutes; keep a due event pending while a busy action stalls it.

Choose uniformly from location-eligible definitions; retain transformed/private-area/tutorial exclusions and Wilderness teleport filtering. Complete the missing ordinary-bank/old-Hunter zone metadata and safe managed-area exceptions.
Spawn an owned, dismissible invitation near the player; only explicit dialogue acceptance starts a teleport event. Do not add a skilling-success trigger or invented per-player opt-out toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: The due timestamp survives relogging, and a busy action delays rather than rerolls an already due event.
Only one invitation or teleport session is active per player, and the eligible event pool respects OSRS location restrictions.

taskDetails.name: Event roster and mechanics
steps: Model harmless events (Genie -> XP lamp, Drunken Dwarf, Sandwich lady, Beekeeper, Mime, Frog, Molly's evil twin) and the historical combat guardians (Evil chicken, Tree spirit, River troll, Shade, Rock golem) as a data table, each with its own spawn and resolution handler.
Drive dialogue through npc-dialogues.json/NpcDialogues and objects through onObjectInteraction, keeping each event a small named handler rather than one giant function.
For combat guardian events, respect the wiki's optional/dismissable rules instead of the old forced-attack behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: Each event in the roster has a reachable trigger, resolution and despawn path.
Adding a new event does not require editing the trigger or cleanup core.

taskDetails.name: Rewards and gift table
steps: Award event gifts, XP lamps and costume pieces (Mime, Zombie, Frog, Beekeeper, Evil chicken, Prince & Princess) once per completion with full-inventory handling.
Read all rewards from item-gameplay.json and never hardcode ids or amounts.
Make rewards idempotent so dismissing or re-entering an event cannot duplicate a gift.
acceptanceCriteria: Completing an event grants its reward exactly once.
A full inventory is handled without deleting the reward.

taskDetails.name: Persistence, reset and cleanup
steps: Persist the next due timestamp and a nullable return tile before entering a teleport event; restore the entry tile before logout save and recover it on crash/relogin, with a validated Lumbridge fallback.
Remove invitation NPCs and session-owned dynamic pieces on completion, departure, disconnect and shutdown; isolate throwing cleanup callbacks and make repeated teardown harmless.
acceptanceCriteria: No event-owned NPC or session survives logout/shutdown, and login inside an abandoned event restores a valid saved return tile.
A bad cleanup callback does not prevent the remaining session-owned entities from being removed.

items.name: Champion's Challenge

taskDetails.name: Entry, scrolls and challenge gating
steps: Use the generated scroll-drop tables with the 32 Quest Point and already-defeated checks; start the selected challenge through Larxus in the private basement.
Keep the scroll on an abandoned fight and consume it on victory; unlock Leon after the ten scroll champions.
acceptanceCriteria: A scroll champion cannot be started without the matching scroll or repeated after defeat.
A failed or abandoned fight preserves the scroll.

taskDetails.name: Champion fights and mechanics
steps: Apply each champion's equipment, inventory, prayer and combat-style restrictions and its attack method.
Complete the documented prayer-drain, teleport, poison, projectile and Lesser Demon materials checks; block teleports while allowing ladder exits and normal dangerous-death recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Each champion follows its documented combat rules and attack behaviour.
Death or an early exit cleans up the fight without silently losing the scroll.

taskDetails.name: Rewards and lamps
steps: Grant kill XP and record the defeated flag once, then offer the corresponding lamp from the Chest of Champions.
Persist claimed lamps and award the cape after Leon; preserve full-inventory and repeated-interaction guards.
acceptanceCriteria: A victory grants kill credit once and each champion's lamp can only be claimed once.
Defeating Leon unlocks the cape.

taskDetails.name: Persistence, reset and cleanup
steps: Persist defeated and claimed-lamp bitsets and resend varp 617 on login.
Remove private NPCs on exit/logout, recover a login from a stopped instance to the guild, and put a dangerous-death grave on the ground floor.
acceptanceCriteria: Defeated and lamp flags survive logout and restart.
No abandoned challenger or instance remains active.

items.name: Creature Creation
devNotes: PR #703 (b7c3ca998, including review fix 1c04dee61): all six revision-241 Symbol-of-life altars use the Wiki ingredient pairs and canonical NPC combat/drop tables. Tower of Life gates entry to the loop; each unnoted ingredient primes its altar separately and persists until Activate consumes the priming to create one owner-only creature. Ardougne easy/medium diary noting uses the ordinary drop pipeline.

The dungeon Area removes living owned creatures on exit, logout, player death and shutdown. NPC death frees the altar while preserving weak drop provenance for diary rewards. Activation also frees a non-death-removed creature or cancelled queued spawn, while still blocking a creature awaiting world registration.

The implemented four-task activity contract is complete. One living creature per player per altar is an explicit conservative limit pending capture evidence; exact spawn/animation timing and concurrency were not capture-verified. A live fixture checked quest gating, exact consumption, foreign combat refusal, a normal Newtroost kill/drop and partial priming across relogin.
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2238 feat: complete Ardougne easy and medium diary tasks. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4389 Tower of Life: the tower door lets only the checked player through. #4020 Fix Tower of Life pipe calibration, door and stairs.

taskDetails.name: Entry, ingredients and recipe table
steps: Gate the Symbol-of-life interactions on completed Tower of Life and load the six Wiki recipe pairs/cache altar coordinates from minigames/data/creature-creation.json.

Accept each correct unnoted ingredient once without consuming wrong/duplicate inputs; persist partial priming, then Activate clears both ingredients before spawning the matching NPC with rollback on failure.
Allow one living creature per player per altar; reject duplicates, retain pending-registration guards, and free stale guards after non-death removals.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong or duplicate ingredients and an incomplete quest consume nothing.
A valid primed pair creates the correct creature once, including rapid repeated activation and failed-spawn recovery.

taskDetails.name: Core creation loop and mechanics
steps: Spawn the owner-only creature by the altar through api.spawnNpc, reuse the normal NPC combat/death/drop path and constrain its wander radius within the dungeon.
Release the active-altar guard after death/removal so creation can repeat, preserving the existing one-live-creature-per-owner-per-altar concurrency limit without inventing an unsupported cooldown.
acceptanceCriteria: Each valid creation yields exactly one killable NPC and the flow can be repeated.
No duplicate creature spawns from rapid repeated use.

taskDetails.name: Rewards and unique drops
steps: Reuse the six canonical npc-drops.json tables, including ordinary floor drops when inventory is full.
Apply the Ardougne easy/medium diary ingredient-noting rules through npc-drops:roll and keep owner provenance available when the death callback runs before the drop roll.
acceptanceCriteria: Killing a created creature rolls its documented drop table exactly once.
A full inventory is handled without losing loot.

taskDetails.name: Persistence, reset and cleanup
steps: Persist both primed ingredients per altar as namespaced player attributes; partial priming survives logout and leaving the dungeon.
Keep created NPCs transient and remove them on owner logout/death, Area exit and shutdown; release stale active guards on the next activation without replaying creatures from saves.
acceptanceCriteria: No created creature survives an owner departure or server restart.
Partial altar ingredients survive save/load and cannot be duplicated by repeated activation or spawn failure.

categories.name: Bosses
categories.summary: Standalone, wilderness, slayer, quest and skilling encounters.

taskTemplate.name: Implement access and encounter setup
steps: Map {feature} location, prerequisites, instance rules and spawn/reset triggers.
Prevent duplicate encounters and define logout, death and re-entry behaviour.
Initialize combat state, arena objects and player-visible encounter feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Access rules reject invalid players without spawning the boss.
A reset produces one clean encounter with no stale entities.

taskTemplate.name: Implement attacks and phases
steps: List {feature} attack styles, animations, graphics, projectiles, timings and target rules.
Implement phase thresholds and mechanic priority through the existing combat method APIs.
Cap or validate damage, movement and safe-zone rules at their authoritative boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic simulation reaches every phase and special attack.
Protection, avoidance and damage rules match the documented encounter.

taskTemplate.name: Implement drops and kill credit
steps: Add {feature} guaranteed, common, unique, tertiary and pet rolls to the shared drop data.
Assign kill credit, kill count and contribution using existing combat ownership rules.
Connect collection log, clue, task and achievement hooks when available.
acceptanceCriteria: Only eligible participants receive rolls and kill credit.
Drop-table fixtures cover unique and always-drop paths.

taskTemplate.name: Implement failure and recovery
steps: Define death storage, gravestone, fee, safe-death and hardcore consequences for {feature}.
Reset hazards, spawned adds and arena state on wipe, teleport and disconnect.
Make repeat entry safe after every failure path.
acceptanceCriteria: A wipe leaves no active hazards or stuck boss state.
Items follow the repository's configured death rules.

items.name: Abyssal Sire
devNotes: PR #667: the Abyssal Sire at bosses/AbyssalSire.plugin.js from rsprox captures (rev 227/228) with Poll 84 numbers from the Wiki: four one-fighter chambers, the Slayer-task gate, all three phases (tentacles, stuns and respiratory systems; the walk out, melee mix and pull; panic, explosion and spawn flood), 478 Slayer XP, Combat Achievements, the Font of Consumption, the Overseer and the rest of the Abyssal Nexus.
Remaining (estimates flagged in docs/abyssal-sire.md): the unprayed phase-2 swipe/flick max, Protect from Melee on tentacle hits, the occupied-chamber line and the Overseer's lore values/chathead.
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2570 Stop rewards being lost to a full inventory or a level-up. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4344 Poison sources: pass severity (hit x 5) to poisonEntity. #4226 Settings: dialogues, messages and switches follow their All Settings rows.

taskDetails.name: Implement access and encounter setup
steps: Require Slayer 85 before allowing entry to the Abyssal Nexus/Sire lair; read the requirement from slayer-tasks.json / the wiki, never a literal.
Create a per-player PrivateArea for the Sire lair (subclass PrivateArea like CountDraynorPrivateArea) and spawn the Sire + four tentacles + four respiratory systems as tracked entities.
Register the combat method provider for all Sire ids from server/data/definitions/npc-spawns.json and monsters-complete.json.
acceptanceCriteria: A sub-85 account is refused and no NPC spawns.
One clean encounter per entry; no stale entities after reset.

taskDetails.name: Implement attacks and phases
steps: Phase 1: tentacles must be killed to expose each respiratory system, and all four systems destroyed before the Sire is targetable; use untargetable flags / setUntargetable and a phase counter.
Phase 2: Sire walks and uses melee plus shadow/poison pools; use npc-combat-defs.json for anim/projectile ids and CombatFactory.poisonEntity for the pools.
Spawn the Sire's spawn adds on a hit roll, mirroring KalphiteQueen.plugin.js hatchWorker + WorkerDespawnTask.
acceptanceCriteria: A simulated fight reaches both phases deterministically.
Pools/poison and spawn adds match the wiki.

taskDetails.name: Implement drops and kill credit
steps: Ensure the 'abyssal_sire' table in npc-drops.json covers the uniques (unsired, bludgeon pieces); do not add rates in code.
Assign kill credit only on the final Sire death, not on systems/tentacles.
Pet Abyssal orphan is already item 13262 in the cache; add it to the shared Pets plugin if missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the final kill rolls loot and credits the kill.
Unique and always-drop fixtures pass.

taskDetails.name: Implement failure and recovery
steps: Tear down the PrivateArea on wipe, death, teleport and disconnect so no respiratory systems/tentacles remain (copy CountDraynorPrivateArea.destroy).
Apply the repository death-item rules (ItemsKeptOnDeath) and any Sire-specific safe death.
Re-entry after any failure spawns a fresh full encounter.
acceptanceCriteria: A wipe leaves no active adds.
Items follow the configured death rules.

items.name: Alchemical Hydra
devNotes: PR #970: Slayer 95/task-gated private lair, three chemical vents and four forms, poison pools, converging lightning, fire walls/trails, enraged attack switching and encounter cleanup are implemented.

Final-form kills use the canonical Hydra loot table, ring-piece drops, kill records, Slayer credit and the shared pet path. Focused tests cover access, phase/vent state, specials, rewards and exit/death cleanup.

The tracker previously described four vents and changing ranged/magic weaknesses; corrected to three vents, four forms and attack-style switching. Some tiles, hazard timing and damage values remain calibrated rather than recording-verified.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #1960 — The merged Wiki/recording audit corrects the relevant fight behavior; findings, sources and remaining inferred values are listed in docs/audits/boss-fights*.md. Existing access/fidelity gaps are not promoted by attack-specific fixes.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4344 Poison sources: pass severity (hit x 5) to poisonEntity. #4226 Settings: dialogues, messages and switches follow their All Settings rows.

taskDetails.name: Implement access and encounter setup
steps: Require Slayer 95; place the encounter in Mount Karuulm (read spawn tiles from npc-spawns.json and verify the region).
Track the three chemical vents as arena objects and reset the four-form encounter state; use a PrivateArea or a phase-scoped attribute.
Register the combat provider for every hydra id (8615-8622) with { singleton:false }.
acceptanceCriteria: Only eligible players enter and the three chemical vents initialise once.
A reset rebuilds a clean arena.

taskDetails.name: Implement attacks and phases
steps: Implement green poison, blue lightning, red fire and grey enrage forms; the first three are weakened by the correct chemical vent. Switch the Hydra between ranged and magic attacks at the documented intervals.
Use a Task-driven phase transition (see KalphiteQueen TransformTask) so phase changes are tick-accurate and interrupt-safe.
Final phase enrage shortens attack speed; keep the number in a constant sourced from the wiki.
acceptanceCriteria: All four phases and their specials are reachable.
Chemical weakening/empowerment and attack-style switching match the documented phase rules.

taskDetails.name: Implement drops and kill credit
steps: Table 'alchemical_hydra' in npc-drops.json; uniques are the hydra's claw/eye/fang/heart and hydra leather - leave rates in the dump.
Credit only the killing player on the final phase; no credit on vent damage.
Wire the Ikkle hydra pet through the shared Pets plugin.
acceptanceCriteria: Uniques/always-drops resolve.
Killer-only credit and pet roll.

taskDetails.name: Implement failure and recovery
steps: A wipe mid-phase must clear vents, queued special-attack tasks and any poison/lightning hazards.
Apply standard death rules; if the dungeon uses a safe death, encode it explicitly.
Re-entry after failure restarts at phase 1.
acceptanceCriteria: No hazard persists after a wipe.
Re-entry is safe and fresh.

The chest rolls the Wiki table once per kill using the key, keeps the kill count (varps 1529/1733) and feeds the collection log; the first click after a kill respawns the boss 15 ticks later.

Bryophyta: melee with poison and the earth blast; growthlings (1/5, one batch at a time, 20 ticks apart) make her immune and die only to an axe or magic secateurs; the logs' bronze axe. Her open-world spawn is removed. Not modelled: the gate's Check-Count option, Combat Achievements, F2P tables.

taskDetails.name: Implement access and encounter setup

Create a per-player PrivateArea for Bryophyta's lair.
Register the combat provider for all Bryophyta ids.

Key is consumed exactly once on a valid entry.

Both styles appear.

No double key handling.

Standard death rules.

items.name: Callisto
devNotes: Main sync 9949ef068: PR #641 replaces the old Callisto plugin with the Wilderness boss rework: Callisto's Den (multi) and Artio's Hunter's End (singles-plus) with the shared 50k entry fee/discount, Peek/Check-Fee, the Escape Caves and their air decay, the boss HUD and the damage-share loot split (docs/wilderness-bosses.md).
Fight from captures: melee/ranged/knockback orb cadence, roars at 66%/33% with bear traps, freezable despite size, death/respawn timings; kill counts feed Combat Achievements.
Remaining: singles-plus plays as singles, some fee/gate messages are ours, and an abandoned fight resets after 100 ticks (our timing).

taskDetails.name: Implement access and encounter setup
steps: Confirm the lived spawn in npc-spawns.json (Callisto id 6609 near 3290,3847) and that NpcIdentifiers.CALLISTO in Callisto.plugin.js resolves to it; wilderness bosses need no instancing.
Register the combat method provider for every Callisto id variant (see KalphiteQueen KQ_IDS arrays for the multi-id pattern).
Decide and document re-entry: Callisto is a shared Wilderness spawn, so no private area, but respawn timer belongs in npc-spawns/NpcDrops handling.
acceptanceCriteria: A player at the spawn tile gets one Callisto, not duplicates.
Respawning after a kill produces exactly one fresh Callisto.

taskDetails.name: Implement attacks and phases
steps: Attack rotation is already coded: finished() rolls a magic combo on a 5s SecondsTimer, hits() applies Projectile.arrivalTicks, and the special knockback is in handleAfterHitEffects.
Keep the combo timer per-instance ({ singleton:false }) so two attackers do not share cooldown state.
Magic projectile id 395 and stun duration 4 come from the plugin; do not silently retune without a wiki check.

The stun does not stack while TimerKey.STUN is active.

taskDetails.name: Implement drops and kill credit

Assign kill credit through the standard onNpcDeath killer field so ring of wealth / collection log hooks see it.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the killing player receives the drop roll.
Unique and always-drop rows resolve from npc-drops.json fixtures.

taskDetails.name: Implement failure and recovery
steps: Callisto lives in ~level 40 Wilderness; death follows the standard Wilderness item rules, so no instance cleanup is required.
If a knockback pushes a player out of the boss's aggression range, combat must reset cleanly (the plugin uses CombatFactory.stun, which restores after 4 ticks).
Verify a disconnect mid-fight does not leave a stunned/force-moved player state.
acceptanceCriteria: A player killed by Callisto drops items per ItemsKeptOnDeath/Wilderness rules.
Disconnect after a knockback clears force movement and stun on login.

items.name: Cerberus
devNotes: Implemented in PR #971 (05e06f217): the Taverley hellhound lair winches/arenas/exits, the hellhound-task access gate, Cerberus' melee/ranged/magic triple attack, souls/lava summoning special, kill credit/Slayer decrement and Hellpuppy pet roll.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4226 Settings: dialogues, messages and switches follow their All Settings rows.

taskDetails.name: Implement party and raid setup
steps: Create the raid from the Chambers of Xeric lobby: validate party size and that every member is present and eligible, then assign exactly one party-scoped PrivateArea (copy the resolveInstanceArea/ATTR_INSTANCE_AREA pattern from server/plugins/bosses/CountDraynor.plugin.js and the multi-player match area from PestControlMatchArea).

Keep raid-scoped state in one object per raid (scout/layout seed, party roster, deaths, supplies, in-raid potion secondaries, personal/party points); persist only survivor, completion and personal-best fields with api.persistAttribute.

Handle invite, leave, logout and rejoin through api.emitCustomEvent("raids:party") plus api.onPlayerLogin/Logout; a disconnect detaches the member from the PrivateArea but must never spawn a second raid, and the last member leaving calls PrivateArea.destroy().
Reject entry for a stale member (area destroyed or roster mismatch) and for re-entering while already inside an active raid.
acceptanceCriteria: Every party resolves to one authoritative raid PrivateArea, and a second entry reuses it instead of creating another.
A member who logs out mid-raid can rejoin the same raid; idle/abandoned raids release their entities via PrivateArea.destroy().

taskDetails.name: Implement rooms and progression
steps: Enumerate the room types inside a raid Boundary: combat (Guardians, Vasa Nistirio, Vanguards, Tekton, Muttadiles, Lizardman Shamans, Skeletal Mystics), skilling/puzzle (Ice Demon, Thieving, crab/scavenger, Tightrope, Farming) and the Great Olm finale; each room is its own Boundary registered against the raid PrivateArea.

Implement scouting/layout selection: pick the room order from a per-raid seed so both linear and non-linear layouts are reproducible, and store that seed plus the chosen rooms in raid state (Barrows already keys room links/progression off deterministic room state).

Gate each exit object on the authoritative room completion (all room NPCs dead, or puzzle/skilling quota met); only the completion emit unlocks the next door, and keep the current room index in raid state so a reconnect resumes it where OSRS permits.
acceptanceCriteria: Every generated layout has a valid path from the lobby to the Great Olm.
A room cannot be exited before its completion condition fires, and a reconnect resumes the same room index and seed.

taskDetails.name: Implement bosses and modifiers
steps: Register every room boss with api.registerNpcCombatMethodProvider(ids, Method, { singleton: false }) as KalphiteQueen.plugin.js does, with phases: Vasa Nistirio (teleport/crystal), Tekton (anvil/heat/frozen), Vanguards (shared death window), Muttadiles (adult + baby), Lizardman Shamans, and Great Olm's three phases (head/claws, flame wall plus teleport/lightning/acid, enraged final).

Implement scavengers yielding raid supplies/secondaries and require Herblore to brew within the raid; scope every raid NPC, object and hazard to the raid PrivateArea so none leaks into the public world or another party.

Implement raid scaling for 1..max party size using the wiki scaling rules (read the HP/damage values, do not hardcode them), and reset rooms on wipe (guard onPlayerDeath inside the area) as well as on abandonment.
acceptanceCriteria: Scaling fixtures cover solo and maximum party size, with no raid entity visible outside its instance.
A wipe resets the room cleanly with no duplicated bosses or leftover ground items.

taskDetails.name: Implement points, loot and completion

Roll regular and unique loot once from the final authoritative points, modelled on the single-claim reward chest in Barrows.plugin.js and the once-only contents guard in server/plugins/interface/LootKeys.plugin.js; read the unique table and point thresholds from the wiki CoX rewards section.

Grant from the CoX unique set (Twisted bow, Elder maul, Kodai insignia, Dinh's bulwark, twisted buckler, arcane/dexterous prayer scrolls, ancestral pieces, dragon claws) and persist completion, personal-best and collection data before releasing the instance.
acceptanceCriteria: Known point fixtures produce the expected unique/regular split, and chest interaction cannot pay out twice.
Completion and personal-best records survive logout/login and are written before the raid area is destroyed.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Give the league profile a distinct persistence namespace so league state can never serialize into a vanilla save: JsonPlayerPersistence.resolveFilePath (JsonPlayerPersistence.plugin.js:148) keys data/saves/characters/<normalized>.json, so add a league-scoped directory/username namespace chosen from world.json rather than new PlayerSave fields.

In register(api), declare the whole league attribute namespace with api.persistAttribute before any handler reads it - league.points, league.tier, league.tasks, league.relics, league.areas, league.masteries - mirroring QuestRuntime.js:226 registering quest.points; PlayerSave only persists keys that were declared.

Apply the Raging Echoes rules from https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Raging_Echoes_League#Rules: 5x base XP raised to 8x/12x by relic tiers, ironman (no player trade/GE), region-locked travel, and no transfer of items or progression between league and normal profiles.
Gate the plugin like PvpMode is gated in world.json: a normal world leaves LeagueMode disabled and no league attribute is ever created on that world.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh league login writes league attributes only into the league namespace; the same username's vanilla save is unchanged byte-for-byte.
Disabling LeagueMode leaves normal characters and their saves unaffected; league worlds select their own profile through pluginConfig league:type.

taskDetails.name: Implement progression data
steps: Put the immutable progression tables in JSON data files with stable string ids, not bare numbers: a relic tier table (0/750/1500/2500/5000/8000/16000/25000 points), an area table (Misthalin + Karamja default, up to three more at 90/200/400 completed tasks), and a mastery tier table per style.

Validate every unlock server-side and idempotently: a relic tier is selectable only once and only when league.points >= its cost; an area only at its next task threshold and only from the nine unlockable regions (Asgarnia, Fremennik, Kandarin, Desert, Morytania, Tirannwn, Wilderness, Kourend, Varlamore); a mastery only after the previous tier of the same style.

Recompute derived bonuses (XP multiplier, drop-rate multiplier, relic passives) on onPlayerLogin (PluginTypes.ts:576) and immediately after each successful unlock, so a restored profile behaves exactly as it did before logout.
acceptanceCriteria: An out-of-order or under-cost unlock is rejected and writes nothing.
Save/load restores relics, areas, masteries and the derived multipliers exactly.

taskDetails.name: Implement tasks, points and rewards
steps: Expose one shared helper on the league bus, e.g. api.onCustomEvent("league:award-task", payload), so the Tasks, Relics, Area unlocks and Points plugins award through a single code path instead of duplicating point arithmetic.

Award at the authoritative gameplay event only (onNpcDeath, onItemAction, onObjectInteraction, onPlayerLevelUp, onZoneEnter) and have the helper check league.tasks.<key> before adding the task's point value to league.points - the same check-before-write shape QuestRuntime.complete uses to make completion a no-op the second time.
Connect league.points to relic tier eligibility, area task thresholds and the reward-shop check handled by the Points & rewards item.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-emitting the same task event awards nothing after the first; league.points always equals the sum of completed task values.
Crossing a tier threshold makes the matching relic choice available without a relog.

taskDetails.name: Connect league interfaces
steps: Keep the cache-native Summary, Info, Rank, task list, relic and area interfaces, using their captured scripts and event masks through the existing league units.
Send character-specific varps, varbits and script arguments on open/login and after every unlock so the live widgets refresh without a relog.
Keep locked, available and completed states derived from server-owned league data; no public endpoint exposes character state.
acceptanceCriteria: After login the widgets match a fresh server snapshot of league.points/tier/tasks/relics/areas.
A relic or area unlock repaints the widget without a relog, and no endpoint exposes another player's league state.

taskDetails.name: Implement tasks, points and rewards
