Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2511 feat(mining): Cam Torum calcified rocks and oozing water; #2512 feat(prayer): Ralos' Rise exposed altar, blessed bone shards and libation bowl; #2513 feat(leagues): 15 more Map of Alacrity shortcuts (stacked on #2509); #2578 Bring eight stale tests up to date; #2613 Fix the Corsair Curse doll's route and the Follow-off minion's stale pursuit; #2621 Keep calcified rocks standing for Endless Harvest miners when the water stops. (10 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4103 Soul Harvest: soul shards at the Ourania Altar, for combination runes, at Kourend's Blood Altar and at the libation bowl. #3965 Culling Spree: choose the Slayer task from three and set its kill count (5-200). #3927 Colossal Wyrm Agility: termites spawn, and Worm Tongue's Wares sells at the cache's prices. 19 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Only allow a relic choice on a league profile; never read or write league.relics on a normal account.
Apply Tier 1's ironman-consistent passives immediately on entering the league (5x XP, 2x eligible drops, infinite run energy, farming/clue accommodations) before any training happens.
Keep the relic item grants inside the league namespace (bank contents are part of the isolated save) so no granted Echo tool can ever appear on a normal profile.
acceptanceCriteria: A normal login never sees a relic attribute or a granted relic item.
The 5x XP and other Tier 1 passives are active from the first league login tick.

taskDetails.name: Implement progression data
steps: Author server/data/definitions/league-relics.json keyed by stable relic id with { tier, name, effect text, grantedItemId? }, and a tier table with the wiki's point costs (0/750/1500/2500/5000/8000/16000/25000).

Validate a choice server-side: tier must be unlocked by league.points, the tier must not already hold a relic, and the relic id must belong to that tier; write league.relics.<tier> = <id> and make the write idempotent under retry.
Recompute derived bonuses from the full relic set (XP multiplier, drop-rate multiplier, minigame point multiplier, skill passives) on login and after each unlock.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing a second relic for an already-filled tier is rejected.
Reload restores every relic and its derived bonuses exactly.

taskDetails.name: Implement tasks, points and rewards
steps: Award the relic only when league.points >= the tier cost, deducting nothing (Relics are chosen, not bought) but recording the tier as spent so the interface can show locked tiers until their points are reached.
Grant grantedItemId relics through the standard item-add path, with a bank fallback when the inventory is full, as the wiki requires the unlock to happen in a bank.

Register relic skill/combat effects with the league bus (api.emitCustomEvent("league:relic-effect", {...})) and have the relevant skill/combat plugins apply the success-rate, auto-banking, auto-smelting or auto-cooking behaviour rather than editing those plugins directly.
acceptanceCriteria: A relic cannot be selected below its tier cost or in the wrong tier.
Granted relic items appear exactly once and effects start without a relog.

taskDetails.name: Connect league interfaces
steps: Use the cache-native relic-selection interface and tier structs through Interface.LeagueRelics.js; provide the description and passive-text arguments its scripts require.
Populate locked, available and chosen states from the current profile on open and after selection.
Retain server-side tier/point checks, lock-in confirmation and immediate native widget refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Chosen relics and locked tiers match server state after login.
Selecting a relic updates the relic widget and summary without a relog.

items.name: Area unlocks
devNotes: Main 8166111fa: #1352 the cache's areas and area interface, unlocks at each league's task thresholds and region locking. The world map doesn't grey locked areas yet.

Enforcement is geographic: derive a region-id -> league-area map from the same world/region data used by plugins/world/ProceduralRegionStream.plugin.js, then guard onZoneEnter (PluginTypes.ts onZoneEnter), onCanTeleport and respawn placement. Also restrict Slayer assignments, clue steps and Mahogany Homes contracts to unlocked areas, as the wiki accommodations list requires.
Store unlocks as league.areas (a JSON list of area ids) and the task threshold in league.areas.unlockCount so restore is exact.

Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1898 adds Demonic Pacts regions, task-count unlocks, region-gated travel, League Home Teleport and area quest/diary/Combat Achievement grants. Map-of-Alacrity shortcuts reuse the shared obstacle data. The world map still lacks locked-region shading, so the map-interface task stays partial.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2209 Lead Death's Office's exit portal to an open square in leagues; #2333 fix(leagues): Leagues VI bugs from #2324; #2509 fix(leagues): Leagues VI relic fixes from #2449; #2511 feat(mining): Cam Torum calcified rocks and oozing water; #2513 feat(leagues): 15 more Map of Alacrity shortcuts (stacked on #2509); #2578 Bring eight stale tests up to date. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3948 Hardcore Worlds: world type, Death's Office start, death choice, Escape crystal. #3965 Culling Spree: choose the Slayer task from three and set its kill count (5-200).

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: On a league profile, automatically grant the two default areas (Misthalin, Karamja) at profile creation and deny entry, teleport and respawn in any other area until it is unlocked.

Guard the boundary hooks: onZoneEnter (PluginTypes onZoneEnter) blocks movement into a locked region, onCanTeleport refuses waystones/teleports into locked regions, and respawn selection is clamped to unlocked areas.
Never apply area locks to a normal account; the plugin is inert when LeagueMode is disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: A league account cannot walk, teleport or respawn into a locked region.
Normal accounts have no area restriction.

taskDetails.name: Implement progression data
steps: Author server/data/definitions/league-areas.json mapping each area to its region ids and to the task count needed to unlock it (default areas at 0; unlockable slots at 90, 200 and 400 total tasks).

Validate an unlock server-side: the player must have reached the next threshold, must not already hold three unlocked areas, and the chosen area must be one of the nine unlockable regions; persist idempotently into league.areas.
Recompute the derived region-lock state on login by expanding league.areas through the region map, so a restored profile is blocked in exactly the same places.
acceptanceCriteria: Unlocking a fourth area or unlocking below the threshold is rejected.
After reload the same regions are blocked and the same three unlocked areas are open.

taskDetails.name: Implement tasks, points and rewards
steps: Award the area unlock when the completed-task count crosses 90/200/400 (not the point total - the wiki ties area slots to task counts, while relics use points), and open exactly one new area choice per threshold.
On selection, record the area id in league.areas and immediately re-derive the region locks so the chosen area is walkable and the remaining locked regions stay blocked.
Support the league travel accommodations the wiki lists (waystones, Death's office, POH, rune essence mine accessible from all areas) as explicit always-allowed exceptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one area choice is offered at each of 90/200/400 tasks.
The newly unlocked area accepts travel in the same session.

taskDetails.name: Connect league interfaces
steps: Own the area-unlock map interface: each region badge shows locked/unlocked, and a locked badge is only selectable when an unlock slot is available at the current task count.
Serve the area catalog through api.registerContentEndpoint and register the widget with api.registerCustomInterface; populate from league.areas and the task count on open.
Push a league:progress update after each unlock so the map repaints and the waystone list updates without a relog.
acceptanceCriteria: The map's locked/unlocked badges match server state after login.
Selecting an area unlocks it on the map immediately.

items.name: Combat masteries
devNotes: Main 8166111fa: #1348 Raging Echoes' three styles of six tiers, the ten point challenges, the interface and passives. The Echo bosses don't exist yet, so three of the points can't be earned.

Mastery points are earned while training combat; read the exact earn rate and each mastery's effect from the wiki, do not invent values. Apply the resulting bonuses through the combat hooks onCombatHitRoll / onPlayerDealtDamage (PluginTypes.ts) and the skill-XP path, alongside server/plugins/combat/EquipmentEffects.plugin.js for equipment-style modifiers.
State lives in league.masteries.<style>.<tier> plus league.masteryPoints; derived passives are recomputed on login, never written into a normal save.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Only track and apply masteries on a league profile; on a normal account the plugin registers nothing and never touches the combat hooks.
Award mastery points only from league-valid combat (no points from transferred gear, player kills against non-league profiles, or PvP that the league restricts).
Keep mastery state in the league attribute namespace so it is isolated with the rest of the league profile.
acceptanceCriteria: A normal account's combat is byte-for-byte unchanged and no mastery attribute exists.
No mastery point can be earned from an invalid source.

taskDetails.name: Implement progression data
steps: Author server/data/definitions/league-masteries.json describing the three styles, their six tiers in order, and each tier's effect text; keep the previous-tier prerequisite in the data, not in code branches.

Validate a mastery unlock server-side: the previous tier of the same style must be unlocked, the required mastery points must be available, and the write to league.masteries.<style>.<tier> must be idempotent.
Recompute all derived combat bonuses on login and after each unlock so a restored profile fights identically.
acceptanceCriteria: Skipping a tier or unlocking without points is rejected.
Reload restores every mastery tier and the derived bonuses.

taskDetails.name: Implement tasks, points and rewards
steps: Award mastery points from the authoritative combat events (onNpcDeath for kills, onPlayerDealtDamage/onCombatHitRoll for damage) at the wiki's documented earn rate, storing the running total in league.masteryPoints.

On unlock, apply the mastery's effect through the combat pipeline: modify hit rolls/damage via onCombatHitRoll and onPlayerDealtDamage, and apply skill/utility passives through the league bus, mirroring how EquipmentEffects.plugin.js layers modifiers.
When a tier is first reached in any style, grant that tier's cross-style passive exactly once and record it so it is not re-granted.
acceptanceCriteria: Mastery point awards are once-per-event and sum correctly.
A newly unlocked mastery changes combat output in the same session, and the first-tier passive is granted once.

taskDetails.name: Connect league interfaces
steps: Own the combat mastery interface: three style columns, six tiers each, showing invested points, the next affordable tier, and locked tiers greyed until the previous tier is purchased.
Register the widget with api.registerCustomInterface and serve the static mastery catalog via api.registerContentEndpoint; populate from league.masteryPoints and league.masteries on open.
Push a league:progress update after each point award or unlock so the columns and passives repaint without a relog.
acceptanceCriteria: The interface's unlocked tiers and point balance match server state after login.
Unlocking a tier updates the interface immediately.

items.name: Points & rewards
devNotes: Main 8166111fa: #1370 the Leagues Reward Shop with the cache's 65 rewards; #1361 the Summary panel. Points are per league character rather than pooled, and the league-world tutor isn't spawned (::leagueshop opens the shop).
Main fdf193b28: #1323 League Points are the sum of saved tasks (awarded once per id) with the captured varbit/varps and the "League Task Complete!" popup.

Keep league.points as the authoritative derived total but recompute it from league.tasks at login rather than trusting a persisted counter alone, so the total can never drift from the sum of completed tasks.

End-of-league rewards (trophies) belong to the main profile and are granted when the league closes; in a live server treat them as a separate redemption path. Do not implement a custom reward shop core method - use api.registerItemShopCurrency/registerContentEndpoint and keep player-specific spending on the game socket.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2209 Lead Death's Office's exit portal to an open square in leagues; #2333 fix(leagues): Leagues VI bugs from #2324; #2509 fix(leagues): Leagues VI relic fixes from #2449; #2511 feat(mining): Cam Torum calcified rocks and oozing water; #2513 feat(leagues): 15 more Map of Alacrity shortcuts (stacked on #2509); #2578 Bring eight stale tests up to date. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Make league.points exist only inside a league profile; a normal account has no points and cannot spend or receive them.
Prevent any cross-profile point transfer: no trade, GE, drop or shop path may move league points or league reward items out of the league namespace.
Recompute league.points from the completed-task set at login so a tampered save cannot inflate the total.
acceptanceCriteria: A normal account never has league.points and cannot receive league reward items.
A save with a mismatched point counter is corrected to the sum of completed tasks on login.

taskDetails.name: Implement progression data
steps: Load the reward table (trophy tiers and any redeemable rewards) and the point->threshold map as data, keyed by stable ids, and validate every redemption server-side against the player's actual league.points.
Make redemption idempotent: check a league.rewards.<id> flag before granting, and re-check under the same lock as the point deduction so a double click cannot grant twice.
Persist the redeemed set and the final point total with the league profile and recompute derived eligibility (which rewards are affordable) on login.
acceptanceCriteria: Redeeming a reward without enough points is rejected.
Reload restores redeemed rewards and the correct affordable set.

taskDetails.name: Implement tasks, points and rewards
steps: Subscribe to the league:award-task event and update league.points from it, so the Points plugin is the single writer of the total while Tasks and Relics read it.
Expose helpers (hasPoints/sumCompleted) to the relic, area and interface layers so all eligibility checks use one arithmetic path - the total must always equal the sum of completed task values.
Implement reward spending as a content-endpoint/shop-currency integration (api.registerContentEndpoint / api.registerItemShopCurrency) rather than a bespoke core method.
acceptanceCriteria: Any point change flows through one writer; the total equals the sum of completed tasks.
A reward is granted exactly once per redemption.

taskDetails.name: Connect league interfaces
steps: Own the league summary interface: show current points, points-to-next-relic-tier, tasks completed, unlocked areas and relics, mirroring the in-game League Summary the wiki describes.
Populate from server state on open via api.registerCustomInterface and refresh on every league:progress event so the counter and tier bar advance without a relog.
Render reward rows in available/affordable/redeemed states, including an explicit empty state before any task is completed.
acceptanceCriteria: The summary's point total, next tier and task count match server state after login.
Completing a task updates the summary and the next-tier progress immediately.

items.name: Demonic Pacts
devNotes: Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1898 implements the native 132-node pact tree, Apply Changes, the 40-point cap, point/reset persistence, tutorial and all 73 effect handlers. The Echo-boss reset-task sources remain unavailable, and the docs identify inferred effect/PvP/reset details, so the combined effects/reward task stays partial.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2209 Lead Death's Office's exit portal to an open square in leagues; #2333 fix(leagues): Leagues VI bugs from #2324; #2509 fix(leagues): Leagues VI relic fixes from #2449; #2511 feat(mining): Cam Torum calcified rocks and oozing water; #2513 feat(leagues): 15 more Map of Alacrity shortcuts (stacked on #2509); #2578 Bring eight stale tests up to date. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026): #3051 and #4057 expand task triggers. #3975 matches the recorded behavior of Regenerate above 100%. Full task and effect coverage remains partial.

taskDetails.name: Gate pacts to Demonic Pacts characters
steps: Read the active character profile through league:profile and refuse pact operations outside league VI.
Apply pact modifiers only through the existing generic combat/skilling hooks; leave other worlds unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Normal and other-league characters cannot unlock pacts or receive pact bonuses.

taskDetails.name: Persist the tree, points and resets
steps: Read the 132-node talent_tree from the cache; validate central-first/linked purchases, available points and the 40-point cap.
Persist selected nodes, earned points, resets and one-off rewards; resend the tree/effect state at login.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid purchases change nothing, reset/point grants are once-only, and relog restores the same tree.

taskDetails.name: Apply effects and earn every pact reward
steps: Retain the 73 general/melee/ranged/magic effect handlers and their documented PvP restrictions.
Finish the unavailable Echo-boss reset-task triggers and verify inferred effect/reset readings against current OSRS evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Every pact reward source is reachable and all effect/reset rules match the recorded or Wiki behavior.

taskDetails.name: Connect the native pact interface
steps: Mount the cache-native talent tree with the captured event masks/scripts and tutorial walkthrough.
Decode Apply Changes integer arrays, validate each selected node and refresh point, unlock and effect state; confirm resets before clearing them.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-node purchases, resets and relog show the authoritative server tree without leaking another character’s state.

categories.name: Account types & game modes
categories.summary: Account restrictions and persistent modes layered on the core game.

taskTemplate.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Define {feature} request, accept, reject, leave and timeout transitions.
Validate both players' live state and permissions before each transition.
Send symmetric state updates to every affected participant.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated or crossed requests resolve once.
Disconnect clears pending state for all participants.

taskTemplate.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Apply ignore, privacy, mute, rank and account-mode rules to {feature}.
Enforce rules server-side before broadcasting content or presence.
Return minimal feedback without leaking hidden status.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked users cannot transmit through alternate entrypoints.
Hidden presence remains hidden after relog.

taskTemplate.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Store {feature} relationships, ranks and preferences in existing player persistence.
Normalize names and stable identifiers at the data boundary.
Load state before presence or channel registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename/case differences do not duplicate relationships.
Save/load preserves settings and memberships.

taskTemplate.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Test {feature} during world change, logout, full lists, stale targets and simultaneous actions.
Make cleanup idempotent and scoped to affected participants.
Rate-limit abusive repeat requests where an existing limiter is available.
acceptanceCriteria: No ghost membership or pending request remains after disconnect.
Capacity limits are enforced atomically.

items.name: Ironman
devNotes: Synced with tsps main e811aff0c (15 October 2026): PR #457 implements account selection/downgrades, chat identity, persisted mode and trade/GE/drop/kill-credit/shop restrictions.
Remaining: bond exceptions, group-boss loot exceptions, house/Party Room restrictions and bank-PIN setup. Group Ironman is separate and remains unimplemented.
PR #856 routes Telekinetic Grab through the same ownership veto as normal Ironman pickup, closing the other-player loot bypass. The remaining mode-specific exception/storage criteria are unchanged.
Main 82657e165: #1613 the trade window and Duel Arena stakes refuse Ironmen; bonds stay allowed. Group-boss loot, house/Party Room and bank-PIN setup remain.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2381 Delete across split stacks, and stop two-handed swaps splitting them; #2522 Refuse preset items in charging, storage and Grand Exchange sales; #2550 Collect a single Grand Exchange purchase as the item; #2663 Store and keep gems in an open gem bag; #2675 Add the Party Room chest, lever and balloons; #2695 Fix rev 241 client actions the server dropped or misrouted (Accept Aid, teleport warnings, furnace, nexus, clans, fairy log, close buttons). (8 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Add the mode selector at the Iron Man tutor (NpcIdentifiers.IRON_MAN_TUTOR/IRONMAN_TUTOR_2/IRONMAN_TUTOR_3) that writes ironman.mode once and refuses a second selection; model the 7-day/new-account grace and the de-iron confirmation on https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ironman_Mode and read any duration from the wiki rather than a constant.

Declare api.persistAttribute("ironman.mode") in register() before any handler reads it (PlayerSave.ts:20), and mirror the selection into the chat/player-option identity and the ironman armour set (ItemIdentifiers.IRONMAN_HELM etc.).

On login re-derive every restriction from the persisted mode and publish it with api.emitCustomEvent("ironman:mode", { player, mode }) so trade/GE/shop plugins stay decoupled instead of importing a shared global.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh account can choose Ironman exactly once; a repeated selection and a selection on an ineligible account are rejected per the wiki grace rule.
After relog the mode and the ironman identity indicator are restored.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: Use the existing hooks only: onCanTrade (PluginTypes.ts:649) refuses any trade involving an ironman, onItemOnPlayer (PluginTypes.ts:722) refuses gifted items, onCanShop blocks Grand Exchange offers, and onGroundItemPickup (PluginTypes.ts:706) refuses ground items that carry no ironman ownership mark.

Mark every item the account produces (monster drop, craft, shop purchase, pick-up of an item it dropped) as owned by that account so own drops remain collectable; store the mark in item/attribute metadata, not a per-item id allowlist.
Keep normal shops working (Shopkeepers.plugin.js) and confirm ironman can still buy from NPC shops, as the wiki allows.
acceptanceCriteria: An ironman cannot trade, receive an item, or pick up another player's ground item.
Own drops and NPC-shop purchases remain acquirable.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Store mode and any derived restriction toggles under the ironman.* namespace (PlayerSave.ts:20) so JsonPlayerPersistence writes them into data/saves/characters/<normalized-name>.json (JsonPlayerPersistence.plugin.js:148).
Never add or remove bank/inventory items when the mode changes; restrictions must be recomputed from ironman.mode at login so a tampered save cannot buy extra privileges.
Make the mode write-once except through the wiki de-iron flow, and reject programmatic writes from other plugins.
acceptanceCriteria: Save/load round-trips ironman.mode and every derived restriction.
A normal account in the same save directory carries no ironman attributes.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: Show the mode through the existing chat/player-option identity and the ironman armour set (ItemIdentifiers.IRONMAN_HELM/PLATEBODY/PLATELEGS), reusing the header-badge mounting pattern in plugins/areas/Wilderness.plugin.js:231 rather than a bespoke overlay.
Suppress the trade and Grand Exchange entrypoints for ironman and send the wiki refusal message instead of silently doing nothing.
Cover the edge cases: logout during a pending trade request, ironman-vs-ironman interaction, and the first-login tutorial where the mode is chosen.
acceptanceCriteria: Ironman players see no trade/GE prompt and get the correct refusal text.
The identity indicator survives a world change and relog.

items.name: Hardcore Ironman
devNotes: Synced with tsps main e811aff0c (15 October 2026): PR #457 implements persisted hardcore identity and a once-only downgrade after dangerous death; safe deaths preserve hardcore status.
It inherits the incomplete shared Ironman exception rules.
PR #856 routes Telekinetic Grab through the same ownership veto as normal Ironman pickup, closing the other-player loot bypass. The remaining mode-specific exception/storage criteria are unchanged.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2388 fix: match the four-tick player death window; #2562 Combat: add recorded hurt, Dark Bow, and death sounds; #2663 Store and keep gems in an open gem bag; #2675 Add the Party Room chest, lever and balloons; #2695 Fix rev 241 client actions the server dropped or misrouted (Accept Aid, teleport warnings, furnace, nexus, clans, fairy log, close buttons). Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026): #3948 adds a separate Hardcore world mode with its own death policy and escape crystals. The Hardcore Ironman score still reflects the Ironman ruleset.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Register HCIM as ironman.mode = "hardcore" through the same tutor flow as Ironman and reject selecting hardcore on an account that has already died as a hardcore or already de-ironed a hardcore.
Track the one life in ironman.hardcoreAlive (boolean) and ironman.hardcoreDeaths, declared via api.persistAttribute before use (PlayerSave.ts:20).
Apply all Ironman restrictions unchanged; the hardcore flag only adds the death consequence, not new trade rules.
acceptanceCriteria: A hardcore account carries the full ironman restriction set plus a live hardcore flag.
Selecting hardcore on a previously-downgraded account is refused.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: Reuse the Ironman enforcement hooks (onCanTrade, onItemOnPlayer, onCanShop, onGroundItemPickup) with no hardcore-specific carve-outs, since HCIM is stricter Ironman, not a different economy.
On a counting death, set ironman.hardcoreAlive = false and ironman.mode = "ironman" through one atomic helper that runs before respawn, so the downgrade cannot be lost by a disconnect mid-death.
Exclude safe deaths (minigame arenas, safe areas, the wiki's protected-death list) from the downgrade check.
acceptanceCriteria: A lethal non-safe death downgrades once and changes nothing about the trade rules beyond dropping the hardcore flag.
A safe-area death leaves the hardcore flag intact.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Persist the hardcore flag and death count under the same ironman.* attribute namespace (PlayerSave.ts:20 / JsonPlayerPersistence.plugin.js:148) so they travel with the character save, not a separate file.
Make the downgrade idempotent: if ironman.hardcoreAlive is already false, a second death event is a no-op that awards nothing.
Never restore hardcore from an old save: on login, hardcoreAlive must remain false once downgraded, even if the save predates the change.
acceptanceCriteria: Downgrade survives logout/login and a second death never re-downgrades or restores hardcore.
A normal account never gains hardcore attributes.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: Swap the identity indicator on downgrade (hardcore helm set -> ironman helm set, HARDCORE_IRONMAN_* -> IRONMAN_*) and play the wiki's hardcore-death broadcast/message to the player.
Cover the edge cases: death while disconnected, death during a minigame, a hardcore player in a group-ironman context, and the tutorial selection timing.
Send the downgrade notification through the same identity path used at login so the change is visible without a relog.
acceptanceCriteria: The indicator and armour identity switch at the moment of downgrade.
No duplicate downgrade message or item change fires on relog.

items.name: Ultimate Ironman
devNotes: Synced with tsps main e811aff0c (15 October 2026): PR #457 implements Ultimate identity, persistence, bank blocking and dropping every item on dangerous death.
Allowed/forbidden storage exceptions and some Ultimate-specific looting/POH/seed-vault limits remain incomplete.
PR #856 routes Telekinetic Grab through the same ownership veto as normal Ironman pickup, closing the other-player loot bypass. The remaining mode-specific exception/storage criteria are unchanged.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2113, #2204 — Bank/storage safeguards and Count Check PIN exemption are repaired; missing broader account-mode restrictions retain partial credit.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2249 fix: confirm and remove bank incinerator stacks; #2332 fix: reject stale bank inventory drags; #2522 Refuse preset items in charging, storage and Grand Exchange sales; #2663 Store and keep gems in an open gem bag; #2675 Add the Party Room chest, lever and balloons; #2695 Fix rev 241 client actions the server dropped or misrouted (Accept Aid, teleport warnings, furnace, nexus, clans, fairy log, close buttons). Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Set ironman.mode = "ultimate" via the tutor flow, inherit all Ironman trade/drop/GE restrictions, and persist the mode with api.persistAttribute (PlayerSave.ts:20).
Register onCanBank (PluginTypes.ts:653) and onCanBankItem (PluginTypes.ts:654) to refuse every bank interaction for UIM, including bank booths, bankers, deposit boxes and bank-interface buttons.
Grant the wiki's documented storage exceptions (POH storage, STASH units, seed box, etc.) as named allows so legitimate UIM play still works; read the exact list from the wiki.
acceptanceCriteria: A UIM cannot open or deposit into a bank from any entrypoint.
Allowed storage containers from the wiki remain usable.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: Apply the Ironman hook set unchanged (onCanTrade, onItemOnPlayer, onCanShop, onGroundItemPickup) plus the UIM bank block; UIM does not get relaxed trading.

Make the bank block guard the shared bank-action entrypoint rather than each caller, the same root-cause approach used by the Wilderness attack guard, so no alternate bank path (deposit box, bank button, POH servant) slips through.
For UIM death, route item loss through the existing onPlayerDeathItemDrop / onShouldDropItemsOnDeath hooks and the wiki's keep/lose rule instead of a bespoke death handler.
acceptanceCriteria: Every bank entrypoint is refused and no deposit succeeds.
UIM death drops match the wiki rule while ironman trade restrictions stay in force.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Persist only ironman.mode under the ironman.* namespace (PlayerSave.ts:20 / JsonPlayerPersistence.plugin.js:148); the no-bank rule is derived from the mode at login, never stored as a bank flag that could be edited.
Do not move or delete bank items on conversion; leave the bank container intact so a normal save is never mutated by UIM state.
Reject other plugins writing ironman.mode or a UIM-only bank toggle at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Save/load round-trips UIM mode and re-derives the bank block.
A normal account save is byte-for-byte unaffected by UIM rules.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: Show the ultimate identity (ULTIMATE_IRONMAN_* armour and chat icon) and suppress any bank-related widget option for UIM, including the bank button and minimap bank open.
Cover edge cases: bank open request in flight during login, POH storage, deposit boxes, group storage, and conversion timing during the tutorial.
Reuse the existing interface/indicator mount pattern so no second badge system is introduced.
acceptanceCriteria: A UIM sees the ultimate identity and no working bank controls.
In-flight bank requests after login are refused without desync.

items.name: Group Ironman
devNotes: Greenfield and the largest of the modes: GIM needs a persistent group entity with shared storage, not just a per-player flag. Assets exist only as ids: NpcIdentifiers.ts:9377 GROUP_IRONMAN_TUTOR 11231, ObjectIdentifiers.ts:23231 GROUP_IRONMAN_DISPLAY 47254 / UNRANKED_GROUP_IRONMAN_DISPLAY 47272, and the GROUP_IRONMAN_* / HARDCORE_GROUP_IRONMAN_* armour sets in ItemIdentifiers.ts.

Key OSRS rules: group members may trade and use the shared group storage but remain blocked from outside-player trade/GE/loot; group size, ranks, leaving and the hardcore-group variant all come from https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Group_Ironman. Read capacities from the wiki.

There is no group container or group manager today; model storage on the existing Bank/ItemContainer pattern and store membership under a group.* attribute namespace declared with api.persistAttribute (PlayerSave.ts:20).

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Register group creation/joining through the Group Ironman tutor (NpcIdentifiers.GROUP_IRONMAN_TUTOR) and the display objects (ObjectIdentifiers.GROUP_IRONMAN_DISPLAY), assigning a stable group id and persisting it per member.
Enforce the group size cap and rank model from the wiki at create/join time, including the unranked variant and the hardcore-group options; reject joins that would exceed capacity.
Give each member ironman.mode = "group" (or hardcore-group) and keep all normal ironman restrictions except the documented in-group exceptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Group creation and join respect the wiki size cap and ranks.
A group member is still an ironman toward players outside the group.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: Relax onCanTrade (PluginTypes.ts:649) only between members of the same group, and keep every other ironman block (GE, foreign ground items, item-on-player) in place.
Add the shared group storage as a separate container that only same-group members can open, distinct from the personal bank (so UIM-style rules and the group container do not collide).
Enforce group storage capacity and prevent a non-member or a member of another group from withdrawing; validate on every open/withdraw against the live group id.
acceptanceCriteria: Same-group trade/storage succeeds; any cross-group or non-member access is refused.
Group storage capacity is enforced atomically on deposit.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Persist group membership as stable member identifiers plus a group id under the group.* namespace via api.persistAttribute (PlayerSave.ts:20), and persist the shared storage container separately so it outlives any one member's save.
Resolve members by stable account id, not display name, and normalize names at the boundary so a rename does not orphan membership.
Load group state before a member can access group storage or trade, and reject mutations if the group record is missing.
acceptanceCriteria: A rename or case difference does not duplicate or break membership.
Rejoining after logout restores the same group and storage contents.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: Own the group storage interface (shared container view) and the group roster/rank display, registering via api.registerCustomInterface and gating rows by rank.
Handle edge cases: leader leaving, kick/leave, empty group, full group, member offline at join, and simultaneous deposit/withdraw; make cleanup idempotent.
Show the group identity indicator (GROUP_IRONMAN_* / HARDCORE_GROUP_IRONMAN_* armour and icons) and refresh it on rank/membership change without a relog.
acceptanceCriteria: The roster and storage UI match server state after login and after membership changes.
No ghost member remains after leave/kick/disconnect.

items.name: Deadman Mode
devNotes: Greenfield mechanics, but one real hook already exists: the Deadman Points shop currency is registered in Shopkeepers.plugin.js:38 (POINT_CURRENCIES) and persisted as shopCurrency:Deadman Points via api.persistAttribute, covered by server/tests/shop-currencies.test.cjs.

DMM is a whole-world rule set, so gate it like a world/gamemode (world.json global tag or experienceMultiplier) rather than a per-player toggle; use the Wilderness.plugin.js hasGlobalWorldTag pattern as the model.

Encode the confident rules (PvP everywhere outside guarded zones, harsher death with a bank key/raid, skulling, 5x-tier XP and boosted drops) but read exact multipliers, breach timing, swap value rules and sigil effects from https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Deadman_Mode before writing numbers.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2218 Fire Wilderness Diary tasks that never completed; #2353 Let native shop handlers override imported defaults; #2388 fix: match the four-tick player death window; #2529 Wilderness: Fix diary progress and regional effects; #2562 Combat: add recorded hurt, Dark Bow, and death sounds. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Define DMM as a world-level mode (world.json global tag or gamemode) so on a DMM world every player is subject to it; register DeadmanMode.plugin.js only when that world is selected, mirroring hasGlobalWorldTag("pvp") usage.
Apply the mode account rules from the wiki: PvP allowed everywhere outside guarded/safe zones, the wiki XP multiplier and drop-rate boost, and the skull penalty for unprovoked attacks.
Reuse shopCurrency:Deadman Points (Shopkeepers.plugin.js:38) as the mode currency rather than inventing a second points attribute.
acceptanceCriteria: On a DMM world the whole map outside safe zones is PvP and the wiki multipliers apply; a normal world is unchanged.
Deadman Points earned in the mode are the same currency the shops already accept.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: Route death through onPlayerDeath/onPlayerDeathItemDrop (PluginTypes.ts:667) to apply the DMM consequence: the victim loses items and the killer receives the bank-raid access the wiki describes; validate the killer is a valid participant before granting it.

Implement the breach rule (combat allowed in normally guarded zones during the breach window) and the swap rule (moving items/value to or from the main game) exactly as the wiki states, gated on the DMM world predicate.
Block teleports and trades where the wiki says DMM blocks them, using onCanTeleport (PluginTypes.ts) and onCanTrade, and keep the shop/currency path working for Deadman Points.
acceptanceCriteria: A PvP kill in DMM grants the documented bank-raid access and the victim's loss matches the wiki rule.
Breach and swap behave per the wiki and are inert outside DMM.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Keep DMM progression in its own namespace and world selection; a DMM character must not leak items or Deadman Points into a normal world, and the existing shopCurrency:Deadman Points key is the only shared point store.

Declare every DMM attribute with api.persistAttribute (PlayerSave.ts:20) so JsonPlayerPersistence writes them with the character, and recompute world-scoped rules at login from the current world rather than the save.
Make breach/swap windows transient (recomputed from world time), never persisted, so a stale save cannot reopen a closed window.
acceptanceCriteria: Switching from a DMM world to a normal world carries items but no DMM combat/breach state.
Deadman Points round-trip and are spendable only where the currency is registered.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: Show the DMM indicators the wiki names (skull/risk, Deadman Points balance, breach timer, sigil slot) using the existing overlay-mount pattern in Wilderness.plugin.js:231.
Handle edge cases: death at the breach boundary, guarded-zone entry/exit, logout during a bank raid, and a swap attempt while a raid is pending.
Send minimal feedback and never reveal a hidden raider's presence from the interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Skull, points and breach indicators match server state on login and after each kill.
Guarded-zone and raid edge cases resolve deterministically with no duplicate rewards.

items.name: PvP worlds
devNotes: Task 0 and task 3 are marked done because the PvP-world core already exists, but not in PvpMode.plugin.js: WorldDefinition.hasGlobalWorldTag("pvp") (WorldDefinition.ts:200) drives Wilderness.plugin.js, which applies the +15 PVP_WORLD_ATTACK_RANGE (Wilderness.plugin.js:48) and mounts the pvp_icons overlay (interface 90), and TeleportHandler.ts:112 blocks teleports above level 20.

PvpMode.plugin.js is only the preset-loadout layer (Presets.js/presetsWidget.js): register(api) opens the preset interface and after death, plus the ::presets command; per-player preset prefs persist as pvp:* attributes (Presets.js:39-41, :754).

World selection is data, not account state: world.json:2 tags an optional global "pvp" zone; the main world keeps it off. Missing work is the remaining wiki rules (ironman get no PvP combat XP, PJ timer) and any dedicated PvP-world verification.
Existing PvP behaviour tests are server/tests/pvp-retreat.test.cjs and pvp-f2p-eat.test.cjs, which stub hasGlobalWorldTag for bot defence; extend these rather than adding a smoke script.

Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1924 adds optional contextual PvP bot chatter and Edgeville prayer policies; #1966 adds validated per-site pvp.loadouts selection. These are configurable custom behaviours and do not increase OSRS-parity task credit.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #1993, #2002, #2181 — Roaming target policy, optional regional PvP bot prayer/chatter and combat brackets are updated. Optional bot policy is not credited as new OSRS content.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2218 Fire Wilderness Diary tasks that never completed; #2258 feat(interface): add Character Summary and persistent PvP statistics; #2340 Keep bots teleblocked and in fights they are part of; #2529 Wilderness: Fix diary progress and regional effects; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3904 Prayer: Ironmen and league characters need the real unlocks for Rigour, Augury, Preserve, Chivalry and Piety. #3345 fix: loading a custom preset gives back the real item, not the saved copy. #3334 fix: a custom preset can't turn a preset copy into a real item. 5 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Keep every PvP-world rule behind the existing predicate WorldDefinition.hasGlobalWorldTag("pvp") (WorldDefinition.ts:200) so the mode is world-scoped and a normal world stays vanilla.

Apply the attack rule as implemented: on a PvP world the base range is PVP_WORLD_ATTACK_RANGE = 15 (Wilderness.plugin.js:48) added to the attacker's Wilderness level, with safe zones (Wilderness safe buildings + WORLD_ZONE_BOUNDARIES.safe) still non-attackable.
Add the remaining wiki account rules the server lacks: ironman gain no combat XP from attacking players in PvP (only base Magic cast XP), and the PJ timer that blocks immediate re-targeting.
acceptanceCriteria: On a pvp-tagged world two players at Edgeville (level 0) within 15 combat levels can fight; on a normal world the same pair cannot.
Safe-zone tiles still block attacks on both world types.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: The teleport restriction is already enforced: TeleportHandler.ts:112 refuses teleports above level 20 Wilderness (TELEPORT_BLOCK_LEVEL). Extend the same guard for any PvP-only teleport rule the wiki lists, still gated on hasGlobalWorldTag("pvp").

Add any PvP-world item/skull death rules through onPlayerDeath (PluginTypes.ts:667) and onPlayerDeathItemDrop, and the PJ timer through onCanAttack (PluginTypes.ts:642), keeping per-player timers in a WeakMap like the existing combat-level cache.
Normal-world trade/bank/shop paths must be untouched; do not add a PvP branch where the world predicate is false.
acceptanceCriteria: Teleport spells are refused above level 20 and any added PvP-only restriction is inert off a PvP world.
Attack re-targeting respects the PJ timer without affecting normal combat.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Keep PvP-world state stateless per save: the mode is selected by world.json, so nothing mode-scoped belongs in PlayerSave; persist only per-player preferences such as the preset attributes pvp:open-presets-on-death, pvp:custom-presets and pvp:selected-custom-preset-slot already declared in Presets.js:39-41, :754.
If a PvP-world rank/points system is added, declare it under its own namespace with api.persistAttribute (PlayerSave.ts:20) before use.
Re-derive every world-scoped rule from the current world at login; never trust a saved PvP flag, so moving to a normal world drops PvP rules immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: A player who was on a PvP world and logs into a normal world is subject to normal attack rules at once.
Preset preferences survive relog while no PvP mode flag is saved.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: Done: the pvp_icons overlay (interface 90) is mounted in Wilderness.plugin.js:231 and cache script 386/388 fill the Wilderness level, combat range and multi-combat icons; varbit 3717 bit 2 marks a PvP world (Wilderness.plugin.js:234).
Missing: expose any further indicator the wiki names (for example the safe-zone badge) by extending mountPvpIcons, not by adding a second overlay mount.
Keep the existing edge-case handling: skip bots, retry the mount for MOUNT_RETRY_TICKS, and hide the pvp_icons subtree via UID 90:43 because script 386 re-shows 90:44 every tick.
acceptanceCriteria: Wilderness level/range/multi icons update as the player moves on both world types.
No duplicate overlay is mounted across relogs.

items.name: Free-to-play worlds
devNotes: PR #228 (b9d9c628): setting "membersWorld": false in world.json runs the server as an OSRS free-to-play world; omitted it stays a members world. WorldDefinition validates that a free world declares "f2p"-tagged zones with the spawn inside them, and isMembersWorld/isMembersArea are exposed to plugins.

Core gained generic hooks (onCanUseItem, onCanEquip, onCanGainExperience, onCanSpawnNpc, onCanStockItem, onSpellDisabled, onPrayerDisabled, onCanTeleport, npc-drops:roll, onObjectInteraction, onPlayerProcess) plus members flags on plugins/NPCs/spells; the rules live in FreeToPlay.plugin.js.

Rules implemented: members plugins and quests are not loaded; members items cannot be used, equipped or give bonuses, and are removed from drops and shop stock; members skills give no XP; members spells and prayers above Mystic Might (45) are disabled; members land blocks teleports and border gates and evicts stragglers to the spawn; members NPCs do not spawn; bots use only f2p loadouts and never spawn in members land.

Client feedback: the handshake carries the members flag, the membership varc (script 828), MAP_MEMBERS and GE/collection-log slots follow the world, and edit mode can visualise and edit the f2p zones.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2229 NPCs: bound aggression and pursuit to the spawn's aggression range. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4321 Freeze resistance: read the Wiki's per-NPC value. #3990 Restrict free-world jewellery enchanting to amulets. #3627 Archers: draw the arrow on the bow and fire the captured arrow tier. 4 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement the world mode rules
steps: Read "membersWorld" in WorldDefinition.parseWorldDefinition and reject a free world without at least one "f2p"-tagged zone or with its spawn outside free land; expose isMembersWorld/isMembersArea to core and plugins.
Keep the mode world-scoped: FreeToPlay.register returns immediately on a members world, and PluginManager skips members:true plugins and quests while loading a free world.
Emit the members flag in the login handshake and membership varc from WorldDefinition, never from a per-player flag.
acceptanceCriteria: A world.json without membersWorld behaves exactly as before (members).
A free world cannot start unless its spawn is inside an f2p zone.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across items, skills and land
steps: Gate every members item through onCanUseItem/onCanEquip with the "To use this item please login to a members' world." message, still allowing Drop/Examine; strip members items from npc-drops:roll and shop stock.
Block XP for members skills via onCanGainExperience, members spells via onSpellDisabled and prayers above Mystic Might via onPrayerDisabled.
Block members NPC spawning, members-land teleports (onCanTeleport), border gates/doors (name match) and evict any player standing in members land to the world spawn on process.
acceptanceCriteria: On a free world a members item cannot be used, equipped or give bonuses, and members skills/spells/prayers gain nothing.
A player cannot enter members land for more than the evacuation tick, and bots never load members gear or spawn there.

taskDetails.name: Keep mode state world-scoped
steps: Store no f2p flag in PlayerSave: the mode is re-derived from the current world at login, so moving between worlds changes the rules with no migration.
Validate f2p zones and spawn at startup, and tag the shipped world.json zones so the main world stays members.
Leave members plugins and quests unloaded rather than loading and disabling them, so their handlers, commands and persistence never exist on a free world.
acceptanceCriteria: A character carries nothing f2p-specific across a world change.
Members content cannot be reached through a stale command or attribute on a free world.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces and client feedback
steps: Show the client membership state from the handshake flag (membership varc, MAP_MEMBERS, GE/collection-log slots) so the free world looks like OSRS free-to-play.
Let edit mode visualise and edit the f2p zones from world.json, and carry membersWorld through /api/world for the map editor.
Confirm the edge cases: members item worn before the switch gives no stats, a members item on death is handled per normal rules, and leaving free land is always allowed at a border.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the world map, GE and collection log on a free world shows the f2p variants.
Changing membership and reconnecting updates every membership-driven widget.

items.name: Spawn mode
devNotes: Task 0 stays done, now through world.json:3 pluginConfig "commands:permissions" ({ "items": "NONE" }): PluginManager applies the map over the registered command rank and any plugin setCommandRights override. The SpawnMode plugin was removed in ccf5ab7e; spawn mode is a private-server custom mode, not an OSRS account type (Project Zanaris is the wiki's community-server reference).
World owners can widen or narrow any command from world.json without a plugin, and the pluginConfig map travels through WorldDefinition and /api/world so the map editor can save it back.
Missing: the rest of a spawn-mode package (free teleports, item packs, master/reset commands) and a spawn-mode world definition using the new config.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #2789 Show nearby entities on current and lower floors. #2859 Fix ban, mute and IP moderation commands. #2729 Fix misleading NPC spawn success and explain missing custom definitions.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Done via world.json:3 pluginConfig: world owners set pluginConfig["commands:permissions"] = { "items": "NONE" } and PluginManager applies it over the registered rank; the SpawnMode plugin and its setCommandRights("items", PlayerRights.NONE) call were removed in ccf5ab7e.

Make the mode a world property, not a player toggle: only widen commands for a world whose world.json asks for it, and extend the same config to the other spawn commands (teleport, packs, master/reset).
Do not add a per-player "spawn enabled" attribute that a player could flip at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: On a spawn world any player can run ::items; on the main world it stays staff-only.
Spawn mode cannot be enabled per player at runtime.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: Because spawning bypasses normal acquisition, define the spawn-mode restriction set: which ids are refused (admin-only/debug, quest-locked items flagged in item-gameplay.json) and whether spawned items are tradeable/bankable to keep a spawn economy contained.
Enforce any trade/bank policy for spawned items through the existing hooks onCanTrade (PluginTypes.ts:649) and onCanBank (PluginTypes.ts:653), keyed by an item ownership mark, not a new core branch.
Add the spawn deny-list to the existing guard in itemSearchCommand (AdminCommands.plugin.js:381 already validates CacheDefinitions.hasItem and rights) so the check lives in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Forbidden items cannot be spawned; allowed items follow whatever trade/bank policy spawn mode sets.
Normal worlds gain no spawn behaviour.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Spawn mode grants no persistent progression: created items enter the normal inventory/bank through the standard paths and need no spawn-specific save field.
If spawn presets (item packs) are persisted, store them under a spawn.* namespace declared with api.persistAttribute (PlayerSave.ts:20) so JsonPlayerPersistence writes them with the character.
A character from a spawn world must move to a normal world with exactly the items it owns and no free-spawn flag.
acceptanceCriteria: Switching worlds never grants spawn rights or free items.
Persisted packs round-trip and are ignored when spawn mode is off.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: The ::items search interface (AdminCommands.plugin.js:399) is the spawn UI; expose it to all players on a spawn world and keep the staff-only variant elsewhere.
Add spawn-mode-only entries (packs, teleport, reset) to the command list in Commands.plugin.js:224 so the mode is discoverable.
Handle edge cases: spawning with a full inventory, spawning during a trade/shop, and the search-close-on-move behaviour already wired at AdminCommands.plugin.js:897.
acceptanceCriteria: ::items opens for normal players on a spawn world and for nobody on the main world; a full inventory is handled cleanly.
Moving cancels an open search as before.

items.name: Restricted builds
devNotes: Greenfield and not an official Jagex mode: the wiki page https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Account_builds lists combat pures (1-def, zerker, void, etc.), skillers, and snowflake accounts (area-locked, chunk-locked, OSAAT, equilibrium). This item is about optionally enforcing a chosen build template server-side.

There is no XP-gain hook in PluginTypes.ts (only onPlayerProcess at :584 and onPlayerLevelUp at :595), so a skill cap has to be clamped in onPlayerProcess against the template's cap before the level-up is allowed, or by reverting XP at onPlayerLevelUp - state the chosen approach in the PR.

Enforcement hooks available: onCanEquip (PluginTypes.ts:665) for equipment requirements, onCanAttack (PluginTypes.ts:642) for combat-level/PvP restrictions, onZoneEnter (PluginTypes.ts) for area/chunk locks. Model the plugin shape on PvpMode.plugin.js and gate via world.json disabledPlugins.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2191 Fix worn DFS and tentacle options unequipping the item (#2165); #2229 NPCs: bound aggression and pursuit to the spawn's aggression range; #2356 Add configurable cross-floor visibility and combat; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks; #2664 Keep Fight Cave monsters on their target and stop healers healing Jad mid-fight. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement mode account rules
steps: Define a build template as data: a stable id plus per-skill caps, forbidden equipment, an optional combat-level cap, and optional area/chunk locks, keyed to the wiki's Account builds page (1-defence, zerker, skiller, area/chunk-locked, OSAAT).

Persist the selected template id under a build.* attribute declared with api.persistAttribute (PlayerSave.ts:20); a player may choose at most one template and changing it requires the wiki's reset rules.

Enforce the caps server-side: since PluginTypes.ts has no XP hook, clamp XP in onPlayerProcess (PluginTypes.ts:584) against the template cap so the restricted skill cannot level, and reject unlocking another skill outside an OSAAT order.
acceptanceCriteria: A restricted build cannot gain XP past its configured cap, and an unrestricted account is unaffected.
Selecting a second template is rejected.

taskDetails.name: Enforce restrictions across trade/drop/bank/shops
steps: For pures, enforce equipment/build limits with onCanEquip (PluginTypes.ts:665) and combat targeting with onCanAttack (PluginTypes.ts:642), and prevent a template from granting trade/GE exceptions it should not have.

For skillers (no combat), block combat XP gain and combat equipment through the same cap and equip guards rather than a separate trade rule, and decide (per the wiki) whether shops/GE remain fully open.
Keep every rejection server-side and return the wiki-consistent refusal, and never let a template bypass bank/trade rules that apply to the underlying account type.
acceptanceCriteria: Forbidden equipment cannot be equipped and forbidden combat cannot be started.
The template never relaxes trade, drop or bank rules below the account's actual type.

taskDetails.name: Persist mode state and isolate it from normal saves
steps: Store only the template id and the derived caps/limits under build.* (PlayerSave.ts:20 / JsonPlayerPersistence.plugin.js:148); re-derive every enforcement check from the template at login so a tampered save cannot disable its own restrictions.
Make template selection write-once unless the wiki reset path is followed, and reject programmatic writes from other plugins.
Ensure removing or changing a template leaves skills/items untouched (no forced rollback of XP) unless the wiki says otherwise.
acceptanceCriteria: Save/load round-trips the template and its derived limits exactly.
A normal account carries no build.* attributes.

taskDetails.name: Wire interfaces, indicators and edge cases
steps: Add a build selection/summary interface via api.registerCustomInterface showing the template name, capped skills and remaining headroom, mirroring the wiki build tables.
Show a build indicator/rank and handle edge cases: area/chunk locked accounts entering a locked region (onZoneEnter), OSAAT order violations, and template selection during the tutorial.
Make every lock reversible only through the documented reset, and keep the interface read-only for other players.
acceptanceCriteria: The summary matches the enforced caps after login and after any reset.
Area/chunk locks block entry consistently and unlock only via the documented path.

categories.name: Weapons & equipment
categories.summary: Weapon categories, combat options, ammunition and special behaviour.

steps: Enumerate {feature} item IDs, equipment slot, bonuses, speed, range and level requirements.

Refresh weapon interface and style state on equip changes.

Implement recovery, breakage, empty-state and recharge transitions.

Unsupported or immune targets receive no unintended state change.

taskDetails.name: Add definitions and equip requirements
steps: Enumerate every Pickaxes item id in server/data/definitions/item-gameplay.json and set equipmentType WEAPON, weaponInterface, doubleHanded, the 14-slot bonuses and requirements (Attack and any other required skill) - bronze, iron, steel, black, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon and crystal pickaxes.

Known repo rows: Ahrim's robetop 70 Defence + 70 Magic; ItemDefinitionLoader overrides Ancestral to 65 Defence + 75 Magic. Magic damage is stored per the wiki (occult/ancestral) and must be checked against cache values.
Missing: audit of every magic set row and any set passives (Ahrim's is tracked under Barrows).
PR #751 (f9354e6b): remaining definitions, effects, feedback and edge cases completed.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2377 Make Wield and Remove act on the clicked item; #2381 Delete across split stacks, and stop two-handed swaps splitting them; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Add definitions and equip requirements
steps: Enumerate every Magic armour item id in server/data/definitions/item-gameplay.json and set equipmentType, doubleHanded and the 14-slot bonuses (five attack, five defence, then melee strength / ranged strength / magic damage / prayer).

Set the level requirements from the wiki in the requirements array (index 1 = Defence, 4 = Ranged, 5 = Prayer, 6 = Magic) - e.g. Ahrim's robetop 70 Defence + 70 Magic, ancestral robe top 65 Defence + 75 Magic - and reference ids only through ItemIdentifiers / IdEnums.

Load the rows through server/plugins/items/ItemDefinitionLoader.plugin.js and reject a failed equip atomically in server/src/main/typescript/elvarg/net/packet/impl/EquipPacketListener.ts so an unmet requirement or a two-handed/shield conflict moves neither item.
acceptanceCriteria: Every tracked Magic armour entry exposes wiki-correct bonuses and skill requirements.
A failed equip leaves the inventory and equipment containers unchanged.

taskDetails.name: Implement bonuses, passives and set effects
steps: Confirm magic attack feeds AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc effectiveMagicAttack and magic damage (otherBonus[MAGIC_STRENGTH]) is applied in DamageFormulas.calculateMaxMagicHit.
Magic armour is stat/penalty driven; keep Ahrim's set behaviour in BarrowsEquipment.plugin.js and any void/crystal magic bonus in those items.
acceptanceCriteria: A magic-damage item (occult/ancestral) changes the calculated magic max hit.
Magic attack penalties (e.g. melee armour) are reflected in the accuracy roll.

taskDetails.name: Implement degradation, charges and repair
steps: Standard magic armour has no charges; rune costs are owned by the spell/staff path (ElementalStaves.plugin.js).
Route degradeable magic items (Ahrim's, crystal) to their own plugins.
acceptanceCriteria: Casting consumes only the runes the spell/staff requires, never armour.
Broken/degraded magic armour cannot be equipped until repaired.

taskDetails.name: Implement client feedback and interfaces
steps: Equipment interface 84 shows magic attack, magic defence and Magic DMG % via formatMagicDamage in server/plugins/interface/EquipmentStats.plugin.js; refresh on equip.
Record the named steps and expected results used for the verification in the PR description.
acceptanceCriteria: Equipping a magic-damage item changes the Magic DMG row immediately.
Magic defence from gear is reflected in the defence bonuses.

items.name: Barrows armour sets
devNotes: Implemented: 24 base items with 4 degrade stages (ids 4856-4999) via Barrows.baseItemId/stageItemId, per-item durability in item meta (MAX_DURABILITY 1000, one point per 90 ticks in combat), broken items blocked on equip, repair at Bob/Aneirin/Dunstan/Tindel Marchant, and the amulet of the damned crumble-to-dust.

Set effects implemented in BarrowsEquipment.plugin.js + DharoksArmour.js: Dharok's missing-HP max hit, Guthan's heal, Torag's run-energy drain and missing-HP defence, Verac's accuracy/protection-prayer bypass, Ahrim's Strength drain, Karil's Agility drain, plus amulet-of-the-damned variants (Verac +7 prayer, Ahrim +30% damage, Karil extra half hit, Guthan +10 hitpoints, Torag missing-HP defence).

Missing: client-side feedback (set-effect messages/charge warnings), a deterministic degradation/repair fixture, amulet-of-the-damned charge display, and verification of all six sets plus the Barrows minigame reward hooks.
PR #751 (f9354e6b): remaining definitions, effects, feedback and edge cases completed.
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2478 Credit supported Morytania Diary gameplay tasks. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3263 Barrows: handle durability Check and verify degradation.

taskDetails.name: Add definitions and equip requirements
steps: Enumerate the six sets (Ahrim's, Dharok's, Guthan's, Karil's, Torag's, Verac's): 24 base items in item-gameplay.json, each with 70 [Defence] armour / 70 [Attack] weapons, Ahrim's 70 Magic and Karil's 70 Ranged; the degrade variants 4856-4999 are computed by Barrows.stageItemId, not listed by hand.
Load the base rows through server/plugins/items/ItemDefinitionLoader.plugin.js; the plugin maps base<->stage ids and tracks remaining durability in the item meta key 'barrows'.
Reject a broken item on equip in the onCanEquip hook and validate the set definition (Barrows.ts SETS) as the single source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the 24 base items degrades through the four stage ids (100/75/50/25/0%) and reverts to its base id after repair.
A broken Barrows piece cannot be equipped and reports why.

taskDetails.name: Implement bonuses, passives and set effects
steps: Keep the six set effects and the amulet-of-the-damned interactions in BarrowsEquipment.plugin.js: Dharok's missing-HP damage (DharoksArmour.js), Guthan's heal, Torag's run-energy drain, Verac's accuracy + protection-prayer bypass, Ahrim's Strength drain, Karil's Agility drain.

Apply amulet-of-the-damned variants only with hasDamnedSet (full set + AMULET_OF_THE_DAMNED_FULL/AMULET_OF_THE_DAMNED): Verac's +7 prayer via registerBonusProvider, Ahrim's 30% extra damage, Karil's second half hit, Guthan's +10 HP cap, Torag's missing-HP defence.

Route passive damage through server/plugins/combat/EquipmentEffects.plugin.js / the PluginManager hooks (onCombatHitRoll, onCombatHitResolved, onPlayerDealtDamage) and never add a feature method to PluginManager.
acceptanceCriteria: Each set effect triggers on the correct combat type and never fires for a broken or incomplete set.
The amulet of the damned variants apply exactly once per hit and stack as documented.

taskDetails.name: Implement degradation, charges and repair
steps: Barrows armour degrades only while in combat for 15 hours of combat time; BarrowsEquipment uses MAX_DURABILITY 1000 and TICKS_PER_DEGRADE 90 and must keep degrading every 90 ticks while in combat and stop when out of combat, on logout or on death.
Repair restores the base id and clears the meta; breakage sets the stage-4 broken item and the repair cost is derived from the remaining durability and the per-piece REPAIR_COSTS weights.
The amulet of the damned crumbles to dust at 0 charges; it is destroyed on drop/death rather than dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: A piece at 100% degrades to broken only after the documented combat time and stops ticking outside combat.
Repair at a registered NPC charges the derived cost and fully restores the item; the amulet is consumed at 0 charges.

taskDetails.name: Implement client feedback and interfaces
steps: Refresh inventory, equipment, Appearance and WeaponInterfaceManager on every degrade/repair so the item name/stage and combat tab update (BarrowsEquipment.refresh).
Send the degrade/broken/repair messages and confirm the equipment-stats target rows refresh when an amulet-of-the-damned is worn.
acceptanceCriteria: Degrading changes the visible stage name and refreshes the equipment panel without a relog.
The player receives a clear message on break, repair and amulet crumble.

Requires 42 Attack/Strength/Defence/Hitpoints/Ranged/Magic + 22 Prayer; bought with Pest Control commendations (helm 200, top 250, robe 250, gloves 150).

Anglerfish over-heal uses getAnglerfishHeal(currentHp) and may raise HP above base by the healed amount; the Wiki disables it only while in combat in a PvP area (player or NPC attacker), never on a timer, so there is no expiry. items.name: Antipoison & antivenom
devNotes: Dose chains already exist for Antipoison (90s), Superantipoison (360s), Antidote+ (600s), Antidote++ (720s), Sanfew serum (super restore + 360s) and Anti-venom (180s)/Anti-venom+ (360s). All route through applyPoisonImmunity, which zeroes poison, sends sendPoisonType(0) and starts Combat.getPoisonImmunityTimer().

Poison/venom state is core: CombatFactory.poisonEntity (venom cannot be restacked or downgraded, immunity is respected) and CombatPoisonEffect (regular poison ticks every 30 ticks with damageFromSeverity; venom escalates +2 to a 20 cap every 30 ticks and never decays). PoisonTimer.plugin.js mirrors seconds/type into varps 7996/7997.

Anti-venom cures poison and venom and grants a 12-minute poison immunity (Anti-venom+ 15 minutes; Antidote+ 9 minutes), and a weaker antipoison never shortens an active timer (Wiki, 7 April 2016). Antidote+ does not cure disease in OSRS - its page lists poison only - so no disease system is needed. Boundary coverage is in server/tests/consumable-edge-cases.test.cjs.
The immunity boundary, mix combo and venom-cure flags are covered by server/tests/consumable-edge-cases.test.cjs.

PR #285 (a4dd6a0c): Antidote+ is 9 minutes, Anti-venom 12 and Anti-venom+ 15 (Wiki); applyPoisonImmunity only replaces the timer when the new dose is longer, so a weaker antipoison cannot cut an active immunity short. The Antidote+ and Antidote+ mix dose chains, which had stale keys, are registered again. server/tests/consumable-edge-cases.test.cjs covers the mix heal/cure and the no-decrease rule.

devNotes: This is core-engine, not a plugin (plugin null). Melee is core-owned, not a plugin: MeleeCombatMethod.ts:21 queues one PendingHit, CombatFactory.addPendingHit grants XP/skull and adds a 1-tick melee delivery hop (CombatFactory.ts:584).
Formulas are central: effective attack level in AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.ts:184 (style +3/+1, +8, prayer %, void 110%) and max hit in DamageFormulas.ts:98 ((effStrength*(strBonus+64)+320)/640).

Status/death edge cases complete: auto-retaliation and the OSRS flinch, the single-target under-attack gate, highest-damage kill credit and the PlayerDeath target/attacker reset (CombatFactory.handleRetaliation, Combat.damageMap, PlayerDeath).

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Keep the accuracy roll in AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.attackMeleeRoll (line 219): effectiveAttackLevel * (selected stab/slash/crush attack bonus + 64), max-melee roll for NPCs uses stats[5].

Keep the damage roll in DamageFormulas.calculateMaxMeleeHit (line 98): effectiveStrengthLevel * (strengthBonus + 64) + 320, floored /640, then CombatFactory.getHitDamage rolls 0..maxHit (CombatFactory.ts:161).

Eligibility is CombatFactory.validTarget (line 255) plus canAttackPermission: reject dead/unregistered/untargetable actors, private-area or z mismatches, distance >= 40, and level/wilderness/duel gates before any hit is created.
acceptanceCriteria: A known strength bonus and effective level produce the same max hit as the wiki melee max-hit formula.
An out-of-range, dead or non-attackable target spends no attack cycle and deals no damage.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: MeleeCombatMethod.start (line 9) plays the weapon attack animation and attack sound; Combat.executeAttack plays the target block animation at launch (Combat.ts:551).
Melee pending hits use delay 0 but addPendingHit shifts delivery +1 tick for players (CombatFactory.ts:584), so the swing lands on the tick the wiki documents.
executeHit skips targets that are dead, teleporting or needsPlacement so a queued swing cannot resolve against an actor that left scope (CombatFactory.ts:598).
acceptanceCriteria: A melee hit resolves on the correct tick after the animation, not the same tick as the click.
A target that dies or teleports before delivery takes no stale damage.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Melee consumes no ammo/runes; the only resource is the attack cooldown set from method.attackSpeed in Combat.executeAttack (Combat.ts:541) and the special-attack energy bar.
Equipment requirements and weapon-specific attack ranges come from WeaponProfile.ts / item-gameplay.json, never a hardcoded id list.
Apply duel rules, wilderness level range and safe-building checks through CombatFactory.canAttackPermission so every caller (auto-retaliate, pursuit, manual) fails identically.
acceptanceCriteria: Attack cadence matches the weapon's speed and cannot attack before the cooldown expires.
A wilderness/duel-restricted melee attack is refused with the same message on every path.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Auto-retaliation and the OSRS flinch (half attack speed) live in CombatFactory.handleRetaliation (line 989); preserve the single-target under-attack gate (Combat.ts:604).

Kill credit is the highest-damage player in Combat.damageMap within the 60s DAMAGE_CACHE_TIMEOUT (Combat.ts:414, CombatConstants.ts:2); correct PvP/PvM ownership depends on addDamage being called after resolution.
On death, reset target/attacker and mark untargetable in PlayerDeathTask so no queued melee hit lands on the corpse (PlayerDeath.ts:202).
acceptanceCriteria: A dead or teleported actor cannot be hit or retaliate.
The player who dealt the most recent damage receives kill credit in both PvP and PvM.
