taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Magic accuracy: AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.attackMagicRoll (line 478) uses effectiveMagicLevel (line 408: +9, prayer %, void 145%) * (magic attack bonus + 64); defenceMagicRoll (line 443) uses (magic*7 + defence*3)/10 + 8 for players.

Max hit comes from the spell's maximumHit() (DamageFormulas.getMagicMaxhit, line 124) then CombatSpells.applyChargeMaxHit (god spells +30 with charge) and applyMagicDamageBonus (magic damage % + Augury/Mystic prayer permille).
canCast must reject without side effects on the read-only path; MagicCombatMethod.canPursue (line 121) uses canCast(false) so pursuit never spends runes.
acceptanceCriteria: A spell's max hit with a known magic-damage bonus matches the wiki value.
A caster below level or missing runes cannot cast and loses nothing.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: MagicCombatMethod.start (line 129) plays the spell cast sound and startCast animation/graphic/projectile; the hit is queued with delay 3 (line 55) and impact graphic/sound fires in handleAfterHitEffects (line 204).
A miss must play splash graphic 85 + SPELL_FAIL_SPLASH sound (MagicCombatMethod.ts:225); a hit plays the spell endGraphic and impact sound.
Ancient burst/barrage secondary hits are separate PendingHits flagged handleAfterHitEffects=false (line 92) so their splash/impact is not re-run.
acceptanceCriteria: Cast visuals and impact happen on the documented ticks.
A dead or teleporting caster/target cannot resolve a queued spell.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Runes are deleted once in Spell.canCast when del=true (Spell.ts:108), with a 1/8 Staff of the Dead rune-negation chance; do not delete from pursuit/eligibility checks.

Autocast limits are in Autocasting.ts: ancient spells require a listed staff (Kodai/Master/Ancient/Nightmare/Staff of the Dead/Light) or Ahrim's damned set, lunar cannot autocast, and Ancient staff cannot cast normal spells (lines 73-91).
Spellbook membership is enforced by Spell.getSpellbook vs player.getSpellbook (Spell.ts:65); NetworkBuilder routes self/target/item casts by cache spell name (NetworkBuilder.ts:254-498).
acceptanceCriteria: Rune costs match the wiki table and never go negative.
Autocast/silent casts obey staff and spellbook restrictions on every caller.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Clean castSpell/previousCast on death and logout so a stale previousCast cannot drive finishCast (MagicCombatMethod.finished, line 185).
Protection prayers reduce magic damage in CombatFactory.getHitDamage (line 202 via getProtectingPrayer), and teleblock/freeze are on the target, not the caster.
Keep splash damage from player casts off the queue (CombatFactory.ts:659 magicSplash) but preserve XP parity; ensure multi-target ancient hits each pass validTarget.
acceptanceCriteria: No spell effect applies after its caster or target leaves scope.
Protection prayer and spellbook lockdown interact correctly with damage and XP.

items.name: Accuracy & damage formulas
devNotes: The two core helpers are AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.ts (attack/defence rolls and hitChance line 175) and DamageFormulas.ts (max melee/ranged/magic, magic-damage bonus, volatile nightmare staff). Both are plugin-extensible through EquipmentEffects.ts modifiers.

Plugin hit/accuracy modifiers are registered by EquipmentEffects.plugin.js, which currently wires DharoksArmour.js (HP-scaled melee) and ObsidianArmour.js (+20% melee); PluginManager.modifyRangedMaxHit / modifyRangedAttackRoll are the ranged extension points (AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.ts:164).

NPC defence/accuracy bonuses are read from monsters-complete.json via NpcDefinition stats[] (AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.ts:79,92). Missing: task 5 fixtures for the formula outputs, and task 4 does not cover all immunity/protection combinations.

PR #266 (a592bb6f/d0b8df17): EquipmentEffects.ts gains registerRunEnergyRestoreModifier (consumed by MovementQueue.runEnergyRestoreDelay) and registerIncomingDamageModifier (consumed by CombatFactory for landed player hits), with PluginManager/PluginTypes exports; Justiciar, salve, leaf-bladed, obsidian-accuracy and crystal-armour modifiers register through the shared registries and have tests.

PR #273 (a08d69ae): melee/ranged/magic gear accuracy modifiers now scale the finished attack roll (effective level x (bonus + 64)) instead of the effective level, matching the Wiki DPS calculator order.

PR #273 (a08d69ae): registerMagicDamageBonusModifier was added so SalveAmulet.js can add its 15%/20% magic damage before the spell max hit scales, and DragonHunter/Demonbane/GearChecks add the new passives. Task 3 (hit-time evaluation and roll-cache cleanup) is still in-progress.

PR #975 applies canonical elemental weakness additively to raw magic rolls/base spell damage; PR #981 adds tome modifiers and captures paid-cast state. Hit-time, tick-eating and remaining cleanup criteria are not promoted by these formula-specific repairs.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1823 corrects combat-level calculation and #1766 the Thieving success charts; combat formula credit is otherwise retained.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3380 Enforce vampyre damage tiers (juvinates, Vyrewatch) and Efaritay's aid.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Implement the OSRS hit-chance formula exactly: if att > def, 1 - (def+2)/(2*(att+1)); else att/(2*(def+1)) (AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.hitChance, line 175), with rolls taken as randomInclusive(0, roll).

Keep all effective-level modifiers in one place: style (+1/+3), base +8, prayer percentages (Attack/Strength/Defence/Ranged/Magic tables), void bonuses, and equipment modifiers via applyMelee/Ranged/Magic Attack/DefenseModifiers (EquipmentEffects.ts).
Reject invalid comparisons before rolling: validTarget/level/wilderness gates from CombatFactory.canAttackPermission apply to the formula caller, not inside the roll.
acceptanceCriteria: Accuracy for known attack/defence roll pairs matches the wiki formula within a single RNG roll.
Modifier stacking (prayer x void x style) equals the documented multiplicative order.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: Damage formulas are pure and must not send packets; visual sequencing stays in the hit pipeline (CombatFactory.applyExtraHitRolls, executeHit) and in each CombatMethod's start/handleAfterHitEffects.
After-hit modifiers must run inside the roll window so a plugin cannot change an already-queued hit; Dharok/Obsidian run through registerMeleeHitModifier at roll time (DamageFormulas.ts:120).
Elysian spirit-shield reduction and its graph 321 play during getHitDamage (CombatFactory.ts:215); target-side recoil/vengeance apply in executeHit (line 723).
acceptanceCriteria: Modifiers affect the rolled number, and the matching visual plays on the same resolution step.
No formula helper emits packets or mutates actor state directly.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Keep the reduction constants in CombatConstants.ts (prayer vs players 0.6 / vs NPCs 0, Elysian 0.75) and use them only inside CombatFactory.getHitDamage.

Plugin accuracy/max-hit overrides must be additive to the shared roll (PluginManager.modifyRangedAttackRoll / modifyRangedMaxHit), never a parallel formula; new equipment one-offs go in plugins/combat/effects/, not core.
Guard against double-application: accuracy is rolled once per hit in PendingHit.prepareHits (PendingHit.ts:143) and the roll is cached per entity per cycle (AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.ts:54).
acceptanceCriteria: A plugin modifier changes exactly one roll, not both accuracy and damage by accident.
Repeated calls within a cycle do not double-apply a buff.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Ensure protection prayer, Smite/Redemption and Elysian are evaluated at hit-time (not roll-time) so a prayer flick tick behaves like OSRS (CombatFactory.ts:202).
Damage capped to the target's HP at roll time makes tick-eating work (PendingHit.ts:133); keep this cap before protection and special multipliers so XP and overkill stay correct.
On death, clear rollCache/WeakMap entries for the dying entity to avoid stale effective levels leaking to a respawn.
acceptanceCriteria: Tick-eating (heal after roll, before impact) leaves already-rolled damage non-lethal.
A respawned actor recomputes effective levels from fresh state.

items.name: Protection prayers
devNotes: Core-owned: PrayerHandler.PROTECT_FROM_MAGIC/MISSILES/MELEE (indices 16-18) plus getProtectingPrayer(type) drive the overhead; damage reduction is applied in CombatFactory.getHitDamage (line 202) using CombatConstants.PRAYER_DAMAGE_REDUCTION_AGAINST_PLAYERS 0.6 / AGAINST_NPCS 0.

Overhead exclusivity and activation rules are in PrayerHandler.activatePrayerPrayerId (line 108) and resetPrayersC; the prayer block comes from CombatFactory.disableProtectionPrayers, now the Wiki 8-tick dragon scimitar Sever. Dragonfire protection also consults Protect from Magic (DragonfireProtection.js:122).
Death deactivates prayers and resets the drain accumulator; Protect Item integrates with PlayerDeath.getAmountToKeep and the ItemsKeptOnDeath preview (ItemsKeptOnDeath.plugin.js:24).

PR #277 (8373cdfc): Redemption now runs after the damage lands (HitQueue -> CombatFactory.handleRedemption), fires below 10% HP including on 0s, heals floor(base Prayer/4), and cannot save a player from a lethal hit; Smite drains floor(damage/4); Retribution rolls 0..floor(base Prayer/4) within 3 tiles and is skipped when the killing blow was reflected; Elysian is an explicit 70% activation roll.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2191 Fix worn DFS and tentacle options unequipping the item (#2165); #2229 NPCs: bound aggression and pursuit to the spawn's aggression range; #2356 Add configurable cross-floor visibility and combat; #2450 Restore recorded combat, prayer and area sound behavior; #2664 Keep Fight Cave monsters on their target and stop healers healing Jad mid-fight. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Keep the three overheads mapped to combat types in PrayerHandler.getProtectingPrayer (line 91) and the reduction constants in CombatConstants.ts; damage reduction is applied once, after the damage roll, in CombatFactory.getHitDamage (line 205).
Eligibility: PrayerHandler.canUse (line 227) enforces prayer level, Chivalry/Piety/Rigour/Augury Defence requirements, red-skull Protect Item block and the prayer-block timer on protection prayers.
Redemption/Smite are triggered at hit-time when the hit is accurate (CombatFactory.ts:648): Redemption heals 25% of Prayer level at <=10% HP, Smite drains damage/4 Prayer.
acceptanceCriteria: Protect from Melee/Missiles/Magic reduces the matching combat type by the documented amount and nothing else.
A red-skulled player cannot activate Protect Item.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: Overhead icon is derived by PrayerHandler.getHeadHint (line 343) and pushed to appearance on activate/deactivate; the prayer varbit (pd.configId) drives the tab glow and activation sound (PrayerHandler.ts:204).

Prayer activation is immediate this tick but charged the following tick (player.markPrayerActivatedThisTick + consumePrayerActivatedThisTick, PrayerHandler.ts:378), which is what makes 1-tick flicking free; preserve that ordering.

A protection prayer must be live at hit resolution, not roll time, since both take effect on the same tick they are toggled (CombatFactory.getHitDamage runs when the hit is created in PendingHit.prepareHits).
acceptanceCriteria: The overhead icon and tab glow match the active prayer without a tick of lag.
A prayer toggled on and off in the same tick costs no Prayer points.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Drain uses the OSRS per-tick model in PrayerHandler.processDrain (line 373): drainEffect += drainRate*0.6 per active prayer, resistance = max(1, 60 + prayerBonus*2), floor(pointDrain/resistance) points per tick.
Prayer points deplete to 0 -> deactivatePrayers + depleted sound (PrayerHandler.ts:418); a protection prayer cannot be re-enabled while Prayer is 0 (canUse / activate guard).
Duel no-prayer rule and prayer-block both gate canUse (PrayerHandler.ts:265,277); quick-prayers re-use canUse so the orb cannot bypass them (QuickPrayers.ts:296).
acceptanceCriteria: Drain rate for a given set of active prayers and prayer bonus matches the wiki calculator.
Prayer cannot be activated at 0 points or when blocked, from tab or quick-prayers.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: CombatFactory.disableProtectionPrayers (line 864) starts a 200s prayerBlockTimer and force-clears the three overheads; the block must survive logout/login via the persisted timer state where applicable.
On death, deactivate prayers and reset the drain accumulator (PrayerHandler.deactivatePrayers / PlayerDeathTask resetAttributes) so the corpse cannot keep draining or keep an overhead.
Protect Item integrates with death item keep in PlayerDeathTask.getAmountToKeep (PlayerDeathTask.ts:243) and ItemsKeptOnDeath preview (ItemsKeptOnDeath.plugin.js:24).
acceptanceCriteria: A prayer-blocked player cannot use protection prayers until the timer expires, on every activation path.
Protect Item adds exactly one kept item and is disabled under a red skull.

items.name: Offensive prayers
devNotes: Main 21a2a1daa: #1061 implements Wiki drain effects and bonus resistance, free one-tick activation/flick behavior, and next-tick deactivation when Prayer reaches 0, including external drains. Offensive prayer boosts, tab/quick-prayer selection and unlock requirements remain implemented.

Status/death edges receive partial credit for the implemented depletion/drain handling. This change does not establish every death/reset/recharge boundary as complete; the remaining combat/spellbook edge tasks retain their prior status.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1684 requires the relevant quest and unlock scroll for the five locked prayers.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2450 Restore recorded combat, prayer and area sound behavior; #2475 Credit supported Desert Diary gameplay tasks; #2478 Credit supported Morytania Diary gameplay tasks; #2486 Credit supported Varrock Diary gameplay and Plank Make batches; #2489 Credit supported Falador Diary gameplay tasks; #2490 Credit supported Kourend and Kebos Diary gameplay tasks. (8 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Keep each tier's multiplier in the formula helpers: Clarity 105 / Improved 110 / Incredible 115 / Chivalry 115 / Piety 120 (attack); Burst 105 / Superhuman 110 / Ultimate 115 / Chivalry 118 / Piety 123 (strength); Sharp 105 / Hawk 110 / Eagle 115 / Rigour 120-123 (ranged); Mystic Will 105 / Lore 110 / Might 115 / Augury 125 (magic).
Requirements and Defence gates are in PrayerHandler.canUse (line 227): Chivalry 60 Def, Piety/Rigour/Augury 70 Def; requirements come from PrayerData (line 472).
Augury also grants magic damage (+4% permille in DamageFormulas.magicDamagePrayerPermille, line 258) and the defence prayers feed defencePrayerPercent; apply all via the shared helpers, never inline.
acceptanceCriteria: Known level/prayer combinations reproduce the wiki's boosted effective levels.
A prayer above the player's level or Defence gate is refused.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: Activation visuals are limited to the tab glow + prayer sound (PrayerHandler.getActivationSound, line 71); offensive prayers have no overhead hint (hint -1).
Boosts are read at roll time through the formula helpers, so they apply on the same tick the prayer is toggled; the flick-free accounting comes from consumePrayerActivatedThisTick.
Quick-prayer activation must activate each selected prayer through PrayerHandler.activatePrayerPrayerId so varbits/boosts stay in sync (QuickPrayers.toggleQuickPrayers, line 285).
acceptanceCriteria: Enabling Piety immediately boosts the next accuracy/damage roll.
Quick-prayers produce the same varbit and boost state as manual activation.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Drain is shared with protection prayers in PrayerHandler.processDrain (line 373); a boost does not consume anything extra, only points via the combined drainEffect.

Exclusivity groups (attack/strength/ranged/magic cannot stack within tier sets; Chivalry/Piety/Rigour/Augury clear all five) are enforced by resetPrayersC in PrayerHandler.activatePrayerPrayerId (line 147).
Duel no-prayer and prayer-block gates still apply via canUse; Preserve only affects boost decay timing, not the multiplier.
acceptanceCriteria: Two conflicting offensive prayers cannot be active together.
Drain for a combo equals the sum of the members' drainRates * 0.6 per tick.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Clear offensive prayers on death/depletion through deactivatePrayers and on prayer-block where applicable; ensure the drain accumulator resets so post-respawn drain is clean.
Preserve behaviour when Prayer hits 0 mid-fight: deactivatePrayers + depleted sound (PrayerHandler.ts:418) and no lingering boost.
Altar recharge (Altars.plugin.js) and bone burying (Prayer.plugin.js) are the only restoration paths; confirm they cannot set Prayer above max.
acceptanceCriteria: No offensive boost survives death or a full Prayer depletion.
Prayer never exceeds max after an altar/bone action.

items.name: Normal spellbook
devNotes: Main fdf193b28: #1270 alchemy cast delay and queueing, untradeable items and the Pest Control refusal.

Main 4b1eac7f6: #1276 Enchant jewellery repeats every 7 ticks over every matching piece; recovered #1210/#1211 keep the staff in hand while casting and restore Stun, Tele Block and Magic Dart visuals. Open PR #1270: alchemy cast delay and queueing, untradeable items, Pest Control refusal.

Combat spells are data in CombatSpells.ts (Strike/Bolt/Blast/Wave/Surge; Curse/Weaken/Confuse; Bind/Snare/Entangle; Teleblock; Iban Blast; Magic Dart; Crumble Undead; Saradomin/Guthix/Zamorak god spells), each carrying levelRequired, rune Item[], animation/graphic/projectile and maximumHit.

Utility/self spells are in EffectSpells.ts (Low/High Alchemy, Superheat Item, Telekinetic Grab, Bones to Bananas/Peaches, and lunar Vengeance) and teleports in SpellTeleports.ts; both are reached from NetworkBuilder.ts:474 via CacheDefinitions.getSpellName, with SpellTeleports.plugin.js handling interface-action teleports.
Missing: task 4 edge cases (staff of the dead negation, charge expiry, god-spell cape 30) and task 5 (no spell smoke; package.json's test:spellbook points at a script that does not exist).
PR #256 (7dbe576b): previousCast/castSpell are cleared on death/logout, closing the stale-cast bullet; staff of the dead negation, charge expiry and the god-spell cape remain.

PRs #975/#977/#981/#984 add canonical elemental weaknesses, six NPC stat curses, paid-cast elemental tome effects and corrected Bind/Snare/Entangle damage, duration and immunity handling. Existing broader spell/gear edge cases retain partial credit; these fixes do not establish complete spellbook parity.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2450 Restore recorded combat, prayer and area sound behavior; #2475 Credit supported Desert Diary gameplay tasks; #2503 Play Bones to Bananas' sound; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks; #2557 Play spell impacts and splashes as area sounds at the target; #2695 Fix rev 241 client actions the server dropped or misrouted (Accept Aid, teleport warnings, furnace, nexus, clans, fairy log, close buttons). Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4329 God spells: the recorded refusal lines naming their staves. #4330 Curses: the recorded line for an attack curse on a weakened foe. #4322 Crumble Undead: only undead targets, with the Wiki's refusal line. 7 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Each spell declares maximumHit/levelRequired/itemsRequired in CombatSpells.ts (e.g. Wind Strike 1152 max 2, Fire Strike max 8, Fire Surge max 24, Iban Blast 1539 max 25 with Iban's staff 1409); runes and levels are the wiki's spell table.

Damage is the classic magic roll: Misc.randomInclusive(0, DamageFormulas.getMagicMaxhit) (CombatFactory.getHitDamage:185), where getMagicMaxhit reads spell.maximumHit, applies Charge (god spells +30, CombatSpells.ts:247) and magic-damage bonuses.
Eligibility is Spell.canCast (Spell.ts:46): magic level, spellbook match, rune/equipment presence; the Staff of the Dead 1/8 rune-negation roll happens only on the consuming path (Spell.ts:106).
acceptanceCriteria: Rune/level requirements match the wiki for every standard combat spell.
A cast below level or without runes deals no damage and consumes nothing.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: Use CombatNormalSpell's castAnimation/startGraphic/castProjectile/endGraphic per spell; MagicCombatMethod queues the hit on delay 3 and plays the end graphic + impact sound on accuracy (MagicCombatMethod.ts:204).
Effect spells (curse/weaken/confuse/bind/snare/entangle/teleblock) route through CombatEffectSpell.finishCast, which fires spellEffect only when accurate (CombatEffectSpell.ts:64).
Utility spells use their own animation/graphic in EffectSpells.handleSpell (e.g. alchemy 713/112, bones-to 722/141) and must not create a PendingHit.
acceptanceCriteria: Each spell's impact graphic/sound fires on the correct tick and only on a successful hit.
A splashed effect spell applies no debuff/freeze.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Rune costs are per-spell Item[] in CombatSpells.ts (air/water/earth/fire/mind/chaos/death/blood/nature/law/soul as applicable) and are deleted once in canCast(del=true); validate the exact per-spell amounts against the wiki table rather than copying from memory.

Equipment locks: Iban Blast needs Iban's staff (1409), Magic Dart needs Slayer's staff (4170); the god-spell Charge buff is stored in player attribute CHARGE_UNTIL with a 7-minute (420000 ms) window (CombatSpells.ts:78).
Autocasting index mapping (1-51) and staff restrictions are in Autocasting.ts; the normal spellbook is the default MagicSpellbook.NORMAL interface 1151.
acceptanceCriteria: Rune counts per cast match the wiki exactly and cannot go negative.
Equipment-gated spells fail without the required staff and Charge expires on schedule.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Effect spells interact with immunity: Teleblock refuses if already blocked, but CombatSpells.ts:1674 currently sets 300s when the target has Protect from Magic else 600s while the wiki says 300s normally / 150s with Protect from Magic - fix this to the wiki values. Bind/Snare/Entangle respect the freeze immunity timer via CombatFactory.freeze (CombatFactory.ts:1055).

Clean previousCast/castSpell on death and logout so a stale utility cast cannot fire; ensure teleport-blocked players cannot use SpellTeleports (TeleportHandler.checkReqs plus the Wilderness onCanTeleport rule).
Bound/cursed state must end with the target's death and not leak to respawn.
acceptanceCriteria: Teleblock/freeze/curse never outlive the target or skip immunity.
A dead caster cannot resolve a pending utility cast.

items.name: Ancient Magicks
devNotes: All 16 Ancient spells are declared in CombatSpells.ts:1704-2021 as CombatAncientSpellExtend (Smoke/Shadow/Blood/Ice x Rush/Burst/Blitz/Barrage) with level, runes, max hit, animation/graphic and spellEffect; CombatAncientSpell.ts carries the spellbook and radius contract.

Secondary effects: Smoke poisons 1/8 for 10 (rush/burst) or 20 (blitz/barrage); Shadow drains Attack 10% (rush/burst) or 15% (blitz/barrage); Blood heals 10/15/20% of damage; Ice freezes 5/10/15/20s. Burst/barrage get a multi-target radius handled in MagicCombatMethod.hits (line 63).

Ancient teleports are in SpellTeleports.ts; autocast requires an ancient-capable staff (Autocasting.ts:17). Freeze timer UI is FreezeTimer.plugin.js reading TimerKey.FREEZE. Missing: task 5 and some task-4 coverage.
PR #256 (7dbe576b): ancient splash candidates now pass CombatFactory.validTarget; secondary spell effects still resolve at roll time rather than on impact.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1800/#1802 populate autocast options and support active Zuriel staves and staff aliases.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2356 Add configurable cross-floor visibility and combat; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks; #2557 Play spell impacts and splashes as area sounds at the target; #2588 Fly player shots and spells to a large target's nearest tile. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4331 Blood spells: the recorded drain line, singular or plural by targets hit. #4023 Fix Wave and Surge effects and remove Tele Block damage. #3970 Shadowflame quadrant: runes, all-spellbook autocast, second spell, weakness and melee reach. 7 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Keep each spell's level/rune/maxHit in CombatSpells.ts (Smoke Rush 50/12939 max 13, Ice Barrage 94/12891 max 30, Blood Barrage 92/12929 heals 20%); verify every row against the wiki's Ancient Magicks table.
Magic accuracy/damage use the shared helpers (AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.attackMagicRoll / DamageFormulas.getMagicMaxhit); Ancient never bypasses the standard magic roll.
Autocast eligibility requires a staff in Autocasting.ANCIENT_SPELL_AUTOCAST_STAFFS or Ahrim's damned set (Autocasting.ts:83); Ice spells also require the target to not be freeze-immune.
acceptanceCriteria: Level, rune and max-hit values match the wiki for all 16 spells.
A non-ancient staff cannot autocast and a targeted ancient spell obeys validTarget.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: Rush/blitz are single-target with a projectile, burst/barrage have radius 1 and fan out through MagicCombatMethod.hits (CombatSpells.ts spellRadius; MagicCombatMethod.ts:68).
Impact graphic/sound and spellEffect run via CombatAncientSpell.finishCast only when accurate and damage > 0 (CombatAncientSpell.ts:13) - a splash must not poison/freeze/heal.
Secondary ancient PendingHits are created with handleAfterHitEffects=false (MagicCombatMethod.ts:92) so the end graphic is not replayed per victim.
acceptanceCriteria: Burst/barrage hits the correct multi-combat targets and each impact visual plays once.
A missed ice/smoke spell applies no freeze/poison.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Runes per cast are the Item[] in each CombatAncientSpellExtend (e.g. Ice Barrage 6 water/2 blood/4 death); consume once through Spell.canCast(del=true).
Ancient teleport spells in SpellTeleports.ts respect TeleportHandler.checkReqs and the Wilderness teleport-block rule in Wilderness.plugin.js onCanTeleport.
Freeze immunity: CombatFactory.freeze (line 1055) refuses if FREEZE or FREEZE_IMMUNITY is active and grants immunity for freeze duration + 3s; do not bypass it for multi-target secondary hits.
acceptanceCriteria: Rune costs match the wiki and freeze immunity prevents chained freezes.
Teleporting from deep Wilderness is blocked consistently for ancient teleports.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Freeze sets TimerKey.FREEZE plus TimerKey.FREEZE_IMMUNITY (duration+3 ticks) and resets the movement queue; confirm cleanup on death/teleport and that FreezeTimer.plugin.js stops showing a timer when ticks hit 0.
Smoke poison and Shadow Attack drain must not apply to already-dead/immune targets and must be cleared by cures (Lunar Cure / antipoison).
Blood heal uses the damage actually dealt, so a capped/overkill hit must not heal more than resolved damage.
acceptanceCriteria: No freeze/poison/drain persists after the target dies or the caster leaves scope.
Blood heal never exceeds the damage dealt.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Read each spell’s level and runes from CacheDefinitions.getSpellRequirements; retain the Wiki XP, Defence, cooldown and accepts-aid checks.
Eligibility is the shared Spell.canCast plus the 40 Defence gate for all Lunar casts (LunarSpells.cast, line 34); acceptsAid() must gate beneficial player-target casts (LunarSpells.ts:351).
Vengeance eligibility: 40 Defence, no existing vengeance effect and a finished 30s cooldown (EffectSpells.handleSpell:56).
acceptanceCriteria: Lunar level/rune values match the wiki and a <40 Defence player cannot cast.
Vengeance refuses when already active or on cooldown, spending no runes.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing

Group teleports teleport the caster then nearby accepting players within distance 1 (LunarSpells.forNearbyPlayers, line 345; castGroupTeleport line 124).

Spellbook swap reverts on expiry and on the next cast.

Lunar cannot be autocast (Autocasting.ts:73); Vengeance fails in a duel (EffectSpells.ts:57); heal other refuses non-aid players and Vengeance other refuses a target that already has it (LunarSpells.ts:280).
Cast potion shares on the potion; dispatch potions:share for eligible players within two tiles, one paid dose each and a free caster dose.

Restricted Lunar casts fail identically on the self and targeted routes.

Cures remove poison/venom and grant immunity; heals never kill the caster.

items.name: Arceuus spellbook
devNotes: Main 4b1eac7f6: recovered #1212/#1214 animate Arceuus teleports, Reanimation and Resurrect as live. Visual fixes to credited content.

ArceuusSpells.ts holds self spells (ward, mark of darkness, corruption, offerings, death charge, degrime, shadow veil, vile vigour, 9 resurrect-Thrall variants) and 13 teleports; targeted combat spells (grasp, demonbane, mark, corruption, dark lure) are declared in CombatSpells.ts:1441-1566 and routed by spell name in NetworkBuilder.ts:496.

Timers/effects are player attributes: wardUntil/markUntil (magic*600 ms), corruption counts, death charge 60s, shadow veil, thrall cooldown 30s, offering cooldown 5.4s. Thralls require the Book of the Dead (25818) and 2/4/6 Prayer (ArceuusSpells.ts:171).
Demonbane spells get 1.25x accuracy+damage against demons while the caster has Mark of Darkness (CombatSpells.ts:88). Missing: task 3 polish (some spells unverified against OSRS), task 4 and task 5.

PR #322 (4cf48dd6, 3b311086): Arceuus autocasting - selector rows 53-58 follow cache script 4133 (demonbanes top, grasps bottom) and enum 1986 icons, varp 664 uses the skull sceptre's Arceuus list (9013), and only the Wiki's Arceuus staves (Slayer's staff, skull sceptre, Ahrim's, Kodai, purging, master wand, blue moon spear, staff of the dead/toxic) may autocast; the Slayer's staff (e) is a staff.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility

Demonbane multiplier: 1.25x damage and accuracy only vs demons when hasMark(caster) (CombatSpells.CombatArceuusSpell, line 80; DamageFormulas.ts:141 and AccuracyFormulasDpsCalc.ts:498).
Thrall eligibility requires the Book of the Dead equipped and Prayer >= 2/4/6; refuse during PvP combat (ArceuusSpells.ts:171).

A Thrall cast without Book of the Dead / Prayer is refused.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing

Thralls summon an NPC via ArceuusThralls.summon with a delay; corruption applies a delayed Prayer-drain task (ArceuusSpells.applyCorruption, line 204) that must stop if the target dies or gains ward.
Dark Lure pulls/resets the NPC movement and forces it to attack the caster for 20s (CombatSpells.ts:1560).
acceptanceCriteria: Grasp freeze and corruption drain ticks occur on schedule and stop on death/ward.
Thrall spawn/despawn is cleanup-safe.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Runes (soul 566, blood 565, nature 561, cosmic 564, law 563, etc.) are declared per spell and consumed by Spell.canCast; offering/thrall spells have shared cast delay + per-spell cooldowns (ArceuusSpells.getCastCooldown, line 61).

Arceuus item spells (ArceuusItemSpells.ts) and offerings (ArceuusOfferings.ts) have their own inventory preconditions; validate before rune consumption.

Ward/Mark/Death Charge durations match magic*600 ms/60s.

Cleanse all Arceuus attributes (ward/mark/corruption/death charge/shadow veil/thrall) on death and logout so a respawn starts clean.
Thrall NPCs must be removed when the owner dies/logs or the cooldown ends; offerings must not double-consume bones across a reconnect.

Ward correctly prevents corruption and demonbane mark drain.

items.name: Status effects
devNotes: Core poison/venom, freeze/stun/teleblock, prayer block, vengeance, recoil and skull timers are implemented; PR #964 (4b689a036) separates task cancellation from curing, resumes poison after login, isolates stale callbacks and stops damage to unregistered/dead actors.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Poison: keep damageFromSeverity = floor((severity+4)/5) and a 30-tick interval (CombatPoisonEffect.ts:16,94); poisonEntity takes the max of current/new severity and cannot downgrade venom (CombatFactory.ts:826).
Venom: stored value is the damage dealt, escalates +2 to cap 20, no decay; only a cure ends it (CombatPoisonEffect.ts:55).

Other status formulas: freeze immunity = duration + 3s (CombatFactory.ts:1066), stun immunity = duration + 1 tick (CombatFactory.ts:979), vengeance reflection = max(1, floor(damage*0.75)) (CombatFactory.ts:900), recoil = 10%+1 (CombatFactory.ts:879). Teleblock is currently 300s/600s at CombatSpells.ts:1674 but the wiki says 300s normally / 150s with Protect from Magic - treat the code as a bug to fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Poison/venom damage progression matches the wiki and venom cannot be downgraded.
Each status's immunity window follows its formula.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: Poison hits queue green HitMask.GREEN damage on a 30-tick cadence and pause while an interface is open (CombatPoisonEffect.ts:35).

Freeze resets the movement queue and sends EffectTimer.FREEZE; stun plays graphic 348; vengeance triggers forceChat 'Taste Vengeance!' on proc; recoil/vengeance add a red pending hit to the attacker (CombatFactory.ts:901).
Timer plugins must send config/varbit only on change (WeakMap state) and clear on logout (PoisonTimer.plugin.js:18, FreezeTimer.plugin.js:14).
acceptanceCriteria: Poison ticks, freeze/stun graphics and timer overlays match their tick windows.
The timer UI clears on logout/death without stale values.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Poison immunity (anti-poison) must prevent application and stop an existing task (CombatPoisonEffect.ts:30); venom application is a one-way escalation.

Freeze is refused for size > 2 entities (CombatFactory.ts:1060); teleblock only affects players; protection-prayer disable (dragon scimitar spec) starts a 200s prayerBlockTimer and clears protection prayers (CombatFactory.ts:864).
Skull: white skull 300s from attacking an unskulled player in the Wilderness (wiki: 30 minutes, 10 from the Abyss - fix the timer) ; red skull cannot use Protect Item (CombatFactory.ts:948).
acceptanceCriteria: Immunity and size/area restrictions are enforced before any effect is applied.
Skull duration and Protect-Item lock behave per the wiki.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Stop and clear all status tasks on death: poison/venom, freeze, teleblock, prayer block, vengeance and stun (PlayerDeathTask reset + Combat.reset), so the corpse has no pending effect.
Corruption/poison delayed tasks must check isRegistered and target liveness before applying (ArceuusSpells.applyCorruption:215, CombatPoisonEffect.ts:20).
Timer plugins must drop WeakMap state on logout/disconnect so a reconnect re-syncs from the persisted poison/venom state (PlayerSave venomed/poisonDamage).
acceptanceCriteria: No status effect applies after its actor/target leaves scope.
Poison/venom survives logout/login with the correct orb state.

taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Keep the keep-count rule in PlayerDeathTask.getAmountToKeep (line 243): 3 normally, 0 while skulled, +1 with Protect Item (Prayer >= 25, active, points > 0), 0 under a red skull; protect non-tradeable items that are not isLostOnDeath.

Rank kept items by ItemDefinition value descending and keep the top N (PlayerDeathTask.getItemsToKeep:256); emitShouldKeepItemOnDeath can veto an item and emitShouldDropItemsOnDeath can suppress the whole drop.
Kill credit is only the highest damager in Combat.damageMap within 60s (CombatConstants.DAMAGE_CACHE_TIMEOUT); a PvM death with no player damager has no killer and drops remain on the ground.
acceptanceCriteria: Unskulled/skulled/Protect Item/red skull each keep the documented number of items.
The killer is credited from the damage map, not the last hit.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: Death animation 836 plays on the first death tick, movement is blocked and the player is marked untargetable before the item/drop step (PlayerDeath.ts:222, 211-214).
Items are dropped at the death tile via ItemOnGroundManager with the killer as owner; bones always spawn (PlayerDeath.ts:69).
onPlayerDefeated and onPlayerDeath fire in that order so KillStreaks resets streaks and PvpMode opens presets after respawn (KillStreaks.plugin.js:429, PvpMode.plugin.js:48).
acceptanceCriteria: Death animation and untargetable state precede item drop.
Post-death plugins run in a defined order without double rewards.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Owner/developer accounts never lose items (PlayerDeath.ts:89,128); isLostOnDeath items and untradeable non-barrows items are kept; broken barrows degrade to their BrokenItem id rather than dropping (PlayerDeath.ts:165).
Dropped tradeables go to any killer, with no gravestone/reclaim timer currently implemented - decide whether to add one or document the omission against the wiki.
Wrap each item in onPlayerDeathItemDrop so plugins can suppress/redirect a drop; never drop items the kept set contains.
acceptanceCriteria: Privileged/ineligible items are never dropped and Barrows degrade correctly.
A plugin can fully own a drop without the core also dropping it.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases

Handle the no-killer case (PvM death) and double-death races: isDyingReturn/isUntargetable must prevent a second PlayerDeathTask and stale hits.
Preserve plugin-suppressed drops for bots and respawn bots at their configured location rather than the default (PlayerDeath.ts:35).
acceptanceCriteria: No status effect or stale hit survives death.
A player cannot be processed for death twice; bots respawn correctly.

PR #362 (91305869): the Revenant Caves (entrances, 100k entry fee lost on death and paid to the killer, exits, revenant cave teleport, pvp zone with the singles-plus indicator), revenant combat/drops, the bracelet of ethereum and the Revenant maledictus. taskDetails.name: Implement formulas and eligibility
steps: Keep the level formula in Wilderness.levelAt (line 46) and attack-range rule in Wilderness.plugin.js wildernessAttackRange (line 127): range = (pvp ? 15 : 0) + attackerLevel, with the pair attackable when |attackerCL - targetCL| <= range.
Eligibility also requires both players in the Wilderness (Wilderness.isInLocation), not in a safe building, not sharing a clan chat, and a valid target (Wilderness.plugin.js onCanAttack, line 483).
Teleport eligibility: blocked above level 20 unless developer or a PvP-world bot (Wilderness.plugin.js onCanTeleport, line 519).
acceptanceCriteria: Level difference and PvP-world +15 are enforced exactly, including one-sided depth.
Safe buildings and clan-mates cannot be attacked; teleports above level 20 are blocked.

taskDetails.name: Implement visual and tick sequencing
steps: The pvp_icons block (interface 90) is driven per tick from the tile: skull, crossed-skull for safe carve-outs, level row and multi-combat icon reconverge on every move/login/teleport (syncOverlay/syncPvpLayout, Wilderness.plugin.js:277-332).
Server sends varbit 5963 (in-wilderness), sends the Attack option (sendInteractionOption) and the multi icon; the client paints level text from its own coordinates via scripts 386/388.
Because the client has no 'gameframe ready' packet, the login mount is retried a few ticks later (MOUNT_RETRY_TICKS, Wilderness.plugin.js:47).
acceptanceCriteria: Entering/leaving the Wilderness shows/hides the skull and level with no stranded overlay after teleport or login.
The Attack option appears only where players may be attacked.

taskDetails.name: Implement resources and restrictions
steps: Skull is applied at hit-queue time when attacking a player in the Wilderness who has not damaged you (CombatFactory.handleSkull:914, handleSkull called at CombatFactory.addPendingHit:576); the code's white skull lasts 300s but the wiki says 30 minutes - fix toward the wiki.
Multi-combat targeting and AoE are gated by Wilderness.isMulti / WORLD_ZONE_BOUNDARIES['multi-combat']; the plugin also enforces the under-attack single-combat gate via Combat.ts.
PJ/x-log interactions: killstreak/bot-kill eligibility checks Wilderness.isIn for both parties (KillStreaks.plugin.js:181,381); LootKeys.plugin.js keys off the same Wilderness checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Attacking an innocent player skulls the attacker once, and multi/single restrictions match the tile.
Killstreak and loot-key rewards only apply when both players are in the Wilderness.

taskDetails.name: Implement status and death edge cases
steps: Freeze/teleblock/skull timers are per-player and must be cleared correctly on death and logout; a skulled player keeps 0 items (see Death mechanics) and cannot use Protect Item.

Handle safe-zone transitions: a hit already in flight is cancelled when either actor enters a safe building (CombatFactory.executeHit:609), and NPCs lose aggression tolerance in the Wilderness (onNpcAggressionTolerance, Wilderness.plugin.js:541).
Preserve PJ/kill-credit semantics: skull only applies when the target did not damage the attacker first, so retaliation does not skull the defender (handleSkull checks damageMapContains both ways).
acceptanceCriteria: No skull/teleblock/freeze survives death or logout, and safe-building transitions nullify in-flight hits.
A defender retaliating is never skulled.

taskTemplate.name: Add world definitions

Store static data in the repository's existing definition format.
Validate cache IDs and coordinates against the active cache revision.

The feature appears only at intended locations.

Cancellation leaves the player interactive.

items.name: Regions & collision
devNotes: Recent work (202368ee, 1614a0f5, a0e590b5): runtime region-replacement data (MapRegionReplacementManager) served to the client and applied to rotated instance chunks; scene rebuilds are synchronised and stale objects cleared. Remaining: broader regression coverage.

Procedural streaming is dev-only (::procregion / ::procregionhere / ::cleargen) and per-player: generateRegionPayload (ProceduralRegionStream.plugin.js:440) builds heights/overlays/underlays/flags for a 64x64, 4-plane region and streams META/CHUNK/END chunks on PROCEDURAL_REGION_OPCODE 12. Collision comes from RegionManager.addClipping (terrain flag bit 1 -> BLOCKED_TILE 0x200000) plus cache objects re-applied from decodeRegionObjects.

Missing: object-spawns.json is an empty [] and nothing registers declared object spawns into collision for normal regions; per-player procedural overrides are keyed by lowercased username and only torn down on logout via clearProceduralClippingForPlayer, so persisted overrides across restart/region unload (regionProceduralClipOverrides) and a clean reboot baseline are unfinished.

Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1786 cancels stale WebGPU scene builds; #1853 fixes opened-door replay; #1882 corrects multicombat on crab coasts.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2188 — Leaving a templated instance rebuilds the ordinary map instead of keeping instance geometry.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2379 Fix Castle Wars practice bot patrols and flag runs; #2645 Archived definitions: carry recycled animations, restore replaced regions. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Add world definitions
steps: Enumerate the region grid the server loads: RegionManager.init() indexes every CacheMaps.getRegionIds() into a Region and logs the count; regionId == ((x>>6)<<8)|(y>>6) (RegionManager.ts:66).

Keep world-level static data in data/definitions/world.json (spawn {x:3089,y:3524,z:0}, tagged zones for duel/pvp/multi-combat, disabledPlugins, experienceMultiplier) rather than in code; WorldDefinition.ts parses it.

world.json parses via getWorldDefinition() and every zone resolves by tag.

taskDetails.name: Implement interactions and routing
steps: Apply terrain collision in resetRegionToTerrainOnlyClipping (ProceduralRegionStream.plugin.js:158): flag bit 1 becomes RegionManager.addClipping(..., BLOCKED_TILE 0x200000), matching height when flag bit 2 is set.
Re-apply cache object collision with decodeRegionObjects + RegionManager.addObjectClipping so walls, doors and fences clip; water stays queryable via RegionManager.isWater.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked and water tiles are never reachable by walking and projectile flags stay directional.
Plane z 0..3 is honoured in every clip lookup, not just plane 0.

taskDetails.name: Connect dialogue, animation and UI
steps: Build payloads with generateRegionPayload (heightsB64/overlaysB64/underlaysB64/flagsB64/buildingPlacements) and stream META -> CHUNK -> END over opcode 12; send CLEAR (REGION_PACKET_TYPE.CLEAR) on ::cleargen to return the client to cache maps.
Mirror every streamed change in server clipping via applyProceduralRegionClipping, and stamp roof-removal flag bit 4 across planes (writeRoofFlagAt) plus explicit flag/overlay tiles.
acceptanceCriteria: ::procregionhere renders terrain and buildings and ::cleargen restores the cache map.
Client object positions match server collision immediately after streaming.

taskDetails.name: Handle world-state edge cases
steps: Scope per-player generation: playerProceduralRegionOverrides and playerProceduralRegionPayloads are keyed by lowercased username and cleared by clearProceduralClippingForPlayer on logout/disconnect.
On region unload/reload/restart call clearProceduralRegionClipping for every tracked region so restored cache objects are not applied twice (regionProceduralClipOverrides guards re-entry).
Replay any persisted edits from data/regions/*.pack and plugins/world/data so a restart returns the intended baseline world.
acceptanceCriteria: Two players generating different regions never share clip or payload state.
Logout and server restart leave no stale procedural clipping.

items.name: Darkness & light sources
devNotes: Light sources follow the Wiki table: carried lit torch, lit candle, lit black candle, lit candle lanterns, lit oil lamp, lit oil lantern, lit bullseye/sapphire/emerald lanterns, plus equipped mining helmet, Kandarin headgear, Bruma torch and charged abyssal lanterns. The firemaking cape and max capes count equipped or carried; unlit/bug lantern variants do not.

Lumbridge Swamp Caves is the first dark area (x3136-3264, y9536-9600, the light-optional Chasm of Tears excluded): warning at 9s, swarm at 18s, then 1 damage per tick; players cannot attack while unlit but can still be attacked. The timer clears on lighting a source, leaving the area or logging out.

Gaps: the remaining light-required dungeons (Dorgesh-Kaan mine/south, Mole Hole, Shayzien Crypts, Sophanem, Temple of Ikov, Abandoned Mine, Mos Le'Harmless, Skavid Caves, Kruk's Dungeon, Nardah genie cavern), tinderbox ignition/extinguish of unlit sources, brightness stacking, gas explosions and the Fire of Eternal Light.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #2816 Handle extinguishing carried torches.

taskDetails.name: Add world definitions
steps: Enumerated the lit light-source item ids from the OSRS Wiki Light sources table against the active cache (lit variants only, no unlit or bug lanterns).
Defined the Lumbridge Swamp Caves boundary from the cave NPC cluster, excluding the light-optional Chasm of Tears north (Juna at y~9516) and Dorgesh-Kaan south.
acceptanceCriteria: Every source id resolves to a lit cache item.
The dark area covers only the intended cave tiles.

taskDetails.name: Implement interactions and routing
steps: hasLightSource reads the inventory and equipment; worn lamps (mining helmet, Kandarin headgear, Bruma torch, abyssal lantern) only count while equipped.
The dark area registers through api.registerArea so per-tick processing only runs for members and gets enter/leave edges for free.
acceptanceCriteria: Carried lights work without wielding them; unlit variants never count.
Players outside the area cost the plugin nothing.

taskDetails.name: Connect dialogue, animation and UI
steps: Wiki messages at 15 and 30 ticks ("You hear tiny insects skittering over the ground...", "Tiny biting insects swarm all over you!") and damage through the combat hit queue as HitMask.RED.
The counter is a namespaced player attribute, cleared by a light source, leaving the area or logging out.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages match the Wiki text.
Damage starts exactly on the swarm tick and stops the tick a light is lit.

taskDetails.name: Handle world-state edge cases
steps: postLeave clears the attribute so re-entering restarts the 18s timer instead of resuming it.
Attack blocking is a canAttack rule on the area rather than a global hook; it only applies to players, so cave NPCs still attack normally.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-entering restarts the timer.
Unlit players cannot attack but can be attacked.

items.name: NPC spawns
devNotes: Main 21a2a1daa: #1050/#1196 preserve spawn lineage through death/respawn and reload, retain the original tile/plane/facing/wander radius, honor per-NPC delays, prevent duplicate unique bosses and clear stale queued respawns on reload.

Map spawns are allocated when a player approaches, including neighbouring squares and extended view ranges; pending allocations retry when the pool has room. Activated NPCs deliberately remain alive to preserve damage, scripts and respawn state rather than being discarded on departure.
World definitions, interactions and synchronization keep their existing credit. The lifecycle task now has an authoritative respawn/reload implementation and dedicated regression coverage.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1775 audits wander/aggro ranges; #1902 restores Friendly Forester; #1904 supplies native gateway spawn directions.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2494 Use the cache's Corsair Curse ferry captains, not extra ones; #2505 Stop seated NPCs sliding around; #2510 fix: Varlamore fixes from #2449 (Cam Torum doors, Renu, pets, ground items) and fishing interrupt; #2548 Add remaining Kourend Diary skill and combat actions; #2625 Master clues: count reanimated abyssal and Fiyr shade kills, and roll Piles and Lovada; #2645 Archived definitions: carry recycled animations, restore replaced regions. (8 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4282 Make CrossFloor a configurable server plugin. #3747 NPC spawn overrides: stacked spawns are replaced and removed one for one. #3329 Animal Magnetism: restore adjacent undead-tree attacks. 4 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Add world definitions
steps: Add or edit rows in server/data/definitions/npc-spawns.json using the existing schema {id,x,y,level,wanderRadius,direction,name}; reference ids via NpcIdentifiers (e.g. NpcIdentifiers.ROCK_CRAB), never bare numbers.
Confirm every id is below CacheDefinitions.getCounts().npcs; invalid/unsupported ids are counted and dropped by NpcSpawnDefinitionLoader.toDefinition, so keep those counters at zero.
acceptanceCriteria: Every new spawn id resolves in the active cache and the loader logs invalid=0 unsupported=0.
The total row count stays within World.getNpcs() capacity.

taskDetails.name: Implement interactions and routing
steps: The loader maps direction through CLIENT_TO_SERVER_DIRECTION and sets wander radius (default 5) with npc.getMovementCoordinator().setRadius; honour wanderRadius:0 for stationary shop/quest NPCs.
Create via NPC.create(id, position) and World.getNpcs().add; reloads call removePreviouslyAppliedNpcs first so a reload never duplicates spawns.
acceptanceCriteria: NPCs wander only inside their radius and never through clipped tiles.
Re-applying spawns (::npc / restart) replaces the old set with no duplicates.

taskDetails.name: Connect dialogue, animation and UI
steps: After applyToWorld clears localNpcs (NpcSpawnDefinitionLoader.ts:130) verify the next PlayerSession flush re-syncs spawns for already-logged-in players.
Carry name/description via setDescription (NpcSpawnDefinitionLoader.ts:118) so examine/target text matches the cache definition; spawn graphics come from the NPC def, not code.
A death/despawn must emit a remove packet then a later add, never mutate an existing NPC in place.
acceptanceCriteria: New spawns appear for logged-in players without a relog.
Examine name matches the definition/cache entry.

taskDetails.name: Handle world-state edge cases
steps: Define respawn: on onNpcDeath schedule a respawn at the original spawn tile with the same radius/facing; do not respawn shared bosses twice.
Scope dynamic NPCs to a private area/world where required, and remove plugin-spawned NPCs on plugin reload/server shutdown.
When the NPC pool is full, log the truncation instead of silently dropping rows in applyToWorld.
acceptanceCriteria: Killed NPCs return after their respawn delay on the correct tile and plane.
Restart restores exactly the baseline spawn list with no duplicates.

items.name: NPC dialogue
devNotes: Main 21a2a1daa: #1087 provides canonical multi-speaker/overhead dispatch with strict player/actor/area ownership, continuation-safe condition/jump handling and cancellation cleanup. Missing or unplayable transcripts log one clear warning per NPC name.

#1048 adds requirement-menu warnings; #1192 repairs Shadow of the Storm chorus binding, private-scene actors and the emphasized final word. Dialogue tests cover the missing-transcript warning and terminal/cancelled chains; a package test script is not a scoring requirement.

Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1680/#1681/#1683 improve In Search of Knowledge, Bear Your Soul and Daddy's Home; #1877 fixes Hairdresser services and #1856 Hans. Miniquests are supporting evidence here and are not added to the full-quest inventory.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2116, #2187 — Combat damage closes interrupted native dialogue; non-attackable NPC examines now fall back to generated Wiki text. The 8,914-entry dump is backed by merged osrsreboxed-db #37 and repeated raw-input generation.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2229 NPCs: bound aggression and pursuit to the spawn's aggression range; #2302 fix: end Jorral contact explanations at their follow-up menu; #2431 Items: Implement Mithril seed planting; #2677 Keep transcripts going when an overhead speaker is out of view; #2708 Allow iron arrows with basic bows and sync ammo pickup settings. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Add world definitions
steps: Add transcripts to server/data/definitions/npc-dialogues.json keyed by the wiki page title and link them via npc-dialogue-index.json (npc id -> page); never hand-author speech in the plugin.
Confirm the NPC id against NpcIdentifiers and the cache before indexing; aliases like "Hops (Biohazard)" are resolved by aliasKeys and pickVariant.
Keep executable conversations in the owning feature plugin, and only extend SPECIAL_NPC_DIALOGUES when a generic transcript genuinely must be bypassed.
acceptanceCriteria: Every NPC with a Talk-to option resolves to a transcript page or a plugin dialogue.
Adding a transcript needs only data edits, no plugin change.

taskDetails.name: Implement interactions and routing
steps: Route each click option through onNpcInteraction / onNpcFirstClick-* ; option text is matched with normText/similarity so punctuation drift still resolves (NpcDialogues.plugin.js:97).
Emit npc-dialogue:choice and npc-dialogue:condition for quest logic and mutate the event rather than the transcript, keeping core free of quest branches.
Trader options come from shops.json npcInteractions through Shopkeepers.plugin.js:75; wire new shops in the data file, not a handler.
acceptanceCriteria: Every option shown by the client has a handler or an explicit fallback.
A failed quest/item condition blocks the option before any stage advances.

taskDetails.name: Connect dialogue, animation and UI
steps: Build chains with DialogueChainBuilder using NpcDialogue/PlayerDialogue/ActionDialogue; speakerIdIndex (NpcDialogues.plugin.js:46) gives paired/cutscene speakers their correct chathead.
Emit npc-dialogue:line with a mutable skip so a quest can drop lines that no longer apply, and advance state only after the line/choice resolves.
On cancel or a failed condition, close/clear the chain and any temporary interface so the player is immediately interactive.
acceptanceCriteria: Chatheads and option text match the selected transcript variant.
Cancelling mid-chain leaves no stuck dialogue or chatbox interface.

taskDetails.name: Handle world-state edge cases
steps: Handle random steps, jump-only branches and wiki "continues" markers (continues/jumpOnly, NpcDialogues.plugin.js:72/87); do not hang on a branch with no body.
Guard a missing variant: pickVariant returning undefined must log a warning rather than leave the NPC silent.
Quest overrides attached to custom events must reset when quest state clears so they never leak between players.
acceptanceCriteria: An NPC with no transcript logs a clear warning instead of crashing.
Quest-specific line suppression ends when the quest is completed/reset.

taskDetails.name: Add world definitions
steps: Prefer cache object ids via ObjectIdentifiers/IdEnums.ObjectIds; for static additions/removals append rows to server/data/definitions/object-spawns.json as {id,position:{x,y,z},type,face,remove} and let ObjectSpawnDefinitionLoader.ts validate type 0..22 and face 0..3.
When a name is unambiguous use the name-based hook instead of an id list (see Altars.plugin.js / BankBooths.plugin.js), because the named lookup covers every cache variant.
acceptanceCriteria: Every static object row validates in ObjectSpawnDefinitionLoader with no invalid entry.
Objects appear only at the declared tiles and planes.

taskDetails.name: Implement interactions and routing
steps: Register all visible options for the object name with api.onObjectInteraction(name, { Action: handler }); put handlers at module scope (plugin shape rule in AGENTS.md).
Validate proximity, clipping, level/quest/item requirements server-side in the handler; never trust the client's clicked tile.
For item-on-object routes use api.onItemOnObject (see RingOfWealth.plugin.js:273 for a worked example).
acceptanceCriteria: Every option in the object's cache definition has a handler.
A player cannot trigger the object from far away or through a wall.

taskDetails.name: Connect dialogue, animation and UI
steps: Perform the object's animation/graphic and sound (Animation, Sounds.sendSound) and transform the object with sendObject or its transformVarbit; Windmill.plugin.js:75 refreshBinObject is the reference pattern.
Open any interface only after the interaction resolves and advance persistent state after the visual effect.
acceptanceCriteria: Client feedback (anim/gfx/sound/object model) matches the new world state.
Cancelling an interaction closes the interface and leaves the player interactive.

taskDetails.name: Handle world-state edge cases
steps: Define respawn/transform reset and whether state is per-player or shared; scope dynamic objects to private areas.
Re-apply open/removed object state on region load (Doors.plugin.js uses onRegionLoaded) and clean plugin-spawned objects on plugin reload/server shutdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Two players cannot create duplicate shared object state.
Reload/restart restores the expected baseline objects.

taskDetails.name: Add world definitions
steps: Keep deriving door pairs from the cache (buildDoorCatalog, Doors.plugin.js:35) instead of a whitelist; only add ids to DOUBLE_DOOR_ID_FAMILIES when the cache cannot pair a double door.
Add fixed stairs/shaft links through the "ladders:climbUp"/"ladders:climbDown" custom events from the owning area plugin rather than editing core.
Declare any one-off door/stair object add/remove in data/definitions/object-spawns.json.

Stairs land on a valid, non-clipped tile in the destination plane.

taskDetails.name: Implement interactions and routing

For ladders/stairs keep the same-name check on the destination floor; for explicit links the caller passes a trusted destination (resolveDestination, Ladders.plugin.js:79).
Make the opened door tile walkable at the collision layer so players path through rather than stand on the door.
acceptanceCriteria: Every Open/Close/Climb-up/Climb-down option has a handler.
An opened door allows movement through its tile and a closed one blocks it.

taskDetails.name: Connect dialogue, animation and UI
steps: Transform the door with the paired loc id and a re-sent GameObject (OPEN_OBJECT_STATES + ObjectManager) plus Sound.DOOR_OPEN/DOOR_CLOSE or GATE_OPEN/GATE_CLOSE.

acceptanceCriteria: Client model and collision match the opened/closed state.
A climb ends on the destination tile with the correct facing and plane.

taskDetails.name: Handle world-state edge cases
steps: Keep the 500-tick auto-close and re-apply open doors on region load; preserve partner consistency for the cached double-door families.
Use the shared region/object update path for open doors; per-player doors:resyncTicks was removed in PR #191. Keep runtime double-door records bounded.
acceptanceCriteria: A door left open reverts after 500 ticks with no duplicated runtime records.
Region reload or a restart never leaves a door visually open but colliding closed.

items.name: Spell teleports
devNotes: Main 62d662706: #1495 standard teleports and tablets land on a random tile of the captured 5x5 square, with the area cast sound.

Core SpellTeleports.ts holds the canonical normal/ancient teleport table: lumbridge 3222,3218; varrock 3213,3424 (25/35xp); lumbridge 31/41; falador 2964,3378; house 2953,3224; camelot 2757,3478; kourend castle 1643,3672; ardougne 2661,3301; civitas 1680,3130; watchtower 2549,3112 z2; trollheim 2891,3678; ape atoll 2796,2798 (needs a small ninja monkey greegree, rune id 1963); ancient Edgeville 3087,3496 and Paddewwa/Senntisten/Kharyrll/Lassar/Dareeyak/Carrallanger/Annakarl/Ghorrock. The plugin resolves the spell name via CacheDefinitions.getSpellName and calls SpellTeleports.handleSelf.

Arceuus and Lunar teleports live in their own spellbook files (ArceuusSpells.ts, LunarSpells.ts) rather than the core normal/ancient table, and TeleportInterface is still a free server teleport list rather than the real spell UI.

PR #341 (5bbc0522): teleport tablets now use the captured TELE_TAB type (smash 4069/sound 965, absorb 4071 + spotanim 678, land on tick 4) with the busy varbit 12393 set and cleared, and TeleportTask releases movement/untargetable/teleporting and the click delay on the landing tick and on stop, so an interrupted or killed cast can no longer leave the player frozen; docs/teleport-tablets.md and server/tests/teleport-tablets.test.cjs record the capture.
PR #351 (6112b2c3): Minigame Teleport (interface 951, enums 5923/5924, Rat Pits chatbox choice, Wiki requirements) and the captured 24-tick home teleport cast with walk/combat interruption.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2155, #2177 — Grouping-tab minigame teleports and unlocked league home-teleport animations are restored; the tab is not a generic party/group implementation.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2258 feat(interface): add Character Summary and persistent PvP statistics; #2350 PvP Arena: open the Grouping side panel and run ranked 1v1s; #2475 Credit supported Desert Diary gameplay tasks; #2501 Complete Western Provinces Diary gameplay task integrations; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks; #2695 Fix rev 241 client actions the server dropped or misrouted (Accept Aid, teleport warnings, furnace, nexus, clans, fairy log, close buttons). Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4296 Minigame Teleport: completing Shades of Mort'ton unlocks its teleport (#4294). #3639 ::teleports: no weapons or armour to Entrana through the port destination. #2880 Route Corporeal Beast teleports by account. 4 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Add world definitions
steps: Add destinations only to the canonical table in server/src/main/typescript/elvarg/game/content/combat/magic/SpellTeleports.ts using the teleport(spellbook, level, xp, runes, x, y, z) helper; never a per-plugin coordinate map.
Take level, XP and rune amounts from the OSRS wiki spell table; do not invent values, and keep rune ids via ItemIdentifiers.
Watch tower-style multi-plane destinations: watchtower is z2, so pass z explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Every normal/ancient teleport spell maps to a table entry with correct level, runes and plane.
Unknown spell names return false from handleSelf without side effects.

taskDetails.name: Implement interactions and routing
steps: Route clicks through api.onInterfaceActionClick -> spellName(event) -> SpellTeleports.handleSelf (SpellTeleports.plugin.js:4); the spell object enforces canCast (level + runes) before TeleportHandler.teleport.
Use TeleportHandler.checkReqs for busy, movement-blocked, teleblock and the default 20-level Wilderness cap; jewellery's 30-level cap is the only override.
Pick TeleportType from the spellbook so normal vs ancient animations differ.
acceptanceCriteria: A missing rune or insufficient level shows the standard failure and does not move the player.
Teleblocked/in-Wilderness-above-cap casts are rejected server-side.

taskDetails.name: Connect dialogue, animation and UI
steps: TeleportHandler.teleport plays the TeleportType start/middle/end animations and graphics and Sound.TELEPORT; do not duplicate that in each spell.
Add the destination/page to TeleportInterface.plugin.js DESTINATIONS if it should also appear in the server teleport list, keeping the tab (teleports/wilderness/bosses) correct.
Award Magic XP exactly once after a successful cast.
acceptanceCriteria: Casting shows the correct spellbook animation/gfx and a single XP drop.
The interface list and spell table agree on destinations.

taskDetails.name: Handle world-state edge cases
steps: Reject teleports while busy, mid-movement or under teleblock; clear the teleblock timer when out of the Wilderness (TeleportHandler.ts:117).
Ensure the TeleportTask clears movement block/untargetable/teleporting flags on stop so a cancelled or failed teleport cannot leave the player frozen.
Guard against repeat clicks during the cast window (click delay).
acceptanceCriteria: A killed/interrupted cast leaves the player mobile and un-flagged.
Wilderness warning/limit behaviour matches the wiki.

items.name: Jewellery teleports

Add a new jewellery plugin per item family (glory/dueling/games necklace/skills necklace/combat bracelet/digsite pendant) under server/plugins/items/, and confirm the item's equip slot in item-gameplay.json.

Every destination matches wiki coordinates and plane.

A 0-charge item refuses to teleport with the correct message.

Cancelling the prompt does not consume a charge.

categories.name: Economy, trading & banking
categories.summary: Item storage, exchange and value flows.

taskTemplate.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Define {feature} source, destination, ownership and commit point.
Reuse existing container and transaction methods so validation precedes mutation.
Refresh only containers and interfaces changed by the commit.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful transaction conserves item and currency totals.
Failure leaves every container unchanged.

taskTemplate.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Check tradeability, account mode, binding, capacity, quantity and area restrictions for {feature}.
Perform validation on authoritative current state immediately before commit.
Return a specific player-facing reason for rejection.
acceptanceCriteria: Forged slots, IDs or quantities cannot bypass validation.
Restricted items never enter an invalid container.

taskTemplate.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Add all {feature} balances, tabs, offers or storage state to existing persistence.
Validate hydrated values and repair safe legacy defaults.
Make save/load atomic with the transaction boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart cannot duplicate or erase committed value.
Legacy saves load without manual migration.

taskTemplate.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Test {feature} under disconnect, concurrent request, full container and rapid-repeat conditions.
Lock or revalidate at the smallest shared mutation boundary.
Log invariant violations without exposing sensitive state.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate requests commit at most once.
Both parties recover consistent state after interruption.

items.name: Inventory & equipment
devNotes: Inventory (28 slots) and Equipment (14 slots) both extend ItemContainer; add/switchItem/switchItems/deleteItemContainer at ItemContainer.ts are the only mutation surface the bank, trade, shop, drop and GE paths route through.

Per-item tradeable/stackable/noted/alch/value/dropable comes from item-gameplay.json via ItemDefinition (getValue/isTradeable/isSellable/isStackable/isNoted); the OSRS high/low quote loads into definition.grandExchangeValue from definitions/item-prices.json through ItemDefinitionLoader.plugin.js, so never hardcode a price.
Missing: no smoke coverage proving item-total conservation across a failed transaction, and no market price-stock model tying GE guide prices to definitions/item-prices.json.

Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1674 enforces quest equipment requirements through the Quests child configuration, enabled by default only with the Quests plugin; #1787 opens the remaining item packs/containers; #1837 fixes bank Wield and shift-drop; #1840 fixes item action routing; #1926 corrects exported equipment slots.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2113, #2126, #2170, #2175 — Bank/gateway follow-ups preserve item metadata, placeholders survive charge-state changes, charged/empty tomes share the right placeholder and optional worn actions keep equipment in place.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2381 Delete across split stacks, and stop two-handed swaps splitting them; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Route every insert/remove through ItemContainer.add/switchItem/switchItems/deleteItemContainer (server/src/main/typescript/elvarg/game/model/container/ItemContainer.ts:292) instead of writing item arrays directly.
Check destination free slots with getFreeSlots/fullBoolean before mutating and refresh only the touched containers with refreshItems().

Load ItemDefinition from item-gameplay.json so ids, stack/noted, equipType, alch and value are authoritative, and let ItemDefinitionLoader.plugin.js load the OSRS quote into grandExchangeValue from definitions/item-prices.json.
acceptanceCriteria: Adding then removing the same stack returns Inventory and Equipment to the exact starting ids/amounts.
A full destination leaves the source container unchanged and reports the container-specific full() message.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Validate that the clicked slot item id matches the packet id before any delete (see Bank.withdraw, Trading.handleItem and BankDepositBooth.deposit).
Honour item-gameplay.json flags: tradeable/dropable/sellable gate trade, drop and shop paths; onCanEquip/onCanUnequip (PluginTypes.ts:649) gate equipment.
Clamp every amount to the live container amount and to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, rejecting non-integer or <= 0 quantities.
acceptanceCriteria: A forged itemId/slot pair is rejected without mutating any container.
Untradeable and unsellable items cannot enter a shop or trade container.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Save the 28-slot inventory and 14-slot equipment arrays through PlayerSave.fromPlayer and restore them with SqlitePlayerPersistence.hydrateItems (length-normalised to 28/14).
Keep item meta (charges, looting-bag contents) JSON-serialisable so the Sqlite replacer/reviver round-trips it.
Repair legacy/oversized arrays by truncating to capacity and padding with Item(-1,0).
acceptanceCriteria: Logout/login restores inventory and equipment slot-for-slot including item meta.
A malformed save cannot produce an oversized or undefined item array.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Guard switchItem/deleteItemContainer against negative slots, a missing player and zero free slots so a concurrent bank/trade/shop action cannot double-remove.
Cap stack totals at Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and reject overflow instead of wrapping.
Ensure a disconnect mid-action cannot leave items in both source and destination.
acceptanceCriteria: Rapid repeated add/remove of the same slot cannot create or duplicate items.
A disconnect during a swap leaves exactly one copy on the player or in the container.
