items.name: Player trading
devNotes: Recent work (PR #113, 3ad5c159, 91ba82f9, 09cab42f, 3493abbb): two-screen offer UI showing the partner head, offer values and acceptance status; cancel/refund of overflowing offers and save-on-complete; covered by server/tests/trade.test.cjs.

Trading is core (game/content/Trading.ts), not a plugin: request -> offer screen 335 -> confirm screen 334 with a 2s request delay and 1s button delay; both parties are revalidated via Trading.validate on every packet.
The native client receives the two-screen state as encodeTradeOpen/encodeTradeUpdate with a sorted sessionId; closeTrade returns every offered item to its owner.
Missing: status marks interruption/abuse in-progress because there is no automated two-client check and no explicit logout/disconnect-safe trade teardown test.
Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1965 corrects native-client Offer All/Offer X quantity-op decoding through the gateway. #1917 keeps trade-facing display names separate from persisted login keys.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2045, #2217 — Official-client chat trade requests can be accepted; cancelled trade windows clear the pending flow.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2261 fix: preserve trade confirmation when replacing the offer screen; #2356 Add configurable cross-floor visibility and combat. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Drive the two-stage flow in game/content/Trading.ts: requestTrade (2s delay) -> initiateTrade opens OFFER_INTERFACE 335 -> acceptTrade opens CONFIRM_INTERFACE 334 -> second accept executes the swap.
Offer/withdraw with Trading.handleItem and PlayerItemContainer.switchItem/switchItems so offered items leave the inventory and return on decline.
On the second accept add each side's offered items to the other inventory and resetAttributes for both players.
acceptanceCriteria: After a completed trade each side holds exactly the other side's offered items.
Declining or modifying after accept returns all offered items to their original owner.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Reject untradeable items in handleItem (offered.isTradeable()) and revalidate status/state/interact via Trading.validate on every packet.
Check the receiver has enough free slots before the offer screen advances, counting stackable merges (acceptTrade slotsNeeded logic).
Gate the request through onCanTrade/onTradeRequest (PluginTypes.ts:230,237) and the request delay.
acceptanceCriteria: Untradeable items cannot be added to a trade offer.
A receiver without inventory space blocks the trade before any item moves.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Offered items are held only in the live PlayerItemContainer; on close/decline resetAttributes returns them to the inventory before the save is written.
Rely on PlayerSave inventory/equipment persistence so a committed trade is durable; never persist a trade container as separate state.
acceptanceCriteria: A committed trade survives restart.
An interrupted trade leaves no item stranded in a trade container after login.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Handle logout/disconnect mid-trade by closing both sides and returning offered items (mirror closeTrade).
Test rapid accept/un-accept against button_delay (SecondsTimer, 1s) and revalidate the counterparty interaction on every packet.
Ensure a player cannot be in two trades or trade while busy/shopping/banking (PlayerStatus.TRADING).
acceptanceCriteria: Two rapid accepts commit exactly once.
A disconnect on one side leaves the other side's items intact.

items.name: Shops
devNotes: Main 4ef42c9ee: #1443 a sale is refused, item kept, when the coin or Tokkul payment can't fit; #1441 a saved Buy noted toggle on custom shops.

Recent work (PR #115, fed672d0, 1387fc41): OSRS shop stock imported into shops.json, quantity buttons handled, and sell fixes for notes, unstackable items, sold-out slots and payment capacity; covered by server/tests/shops.test.cjs and shops-data.test.cjs.
shops.json is generated from the wiki by server/scripts/import-osrs-shops.mjs; Shopkeepers.plugin.js binds each npcInteractions optionSlot to an npc click via name-based hooks.

ShopManager buys/sells with a 0.85 SALES_TAX on sell-back, per-item restockTicks/destock, general-store overflow deletion, a 1000-item / 5000-action cap, and a currency that is an item or a registered point currency.
CustomShops.plugin.js registers server-defined group 30009 listing custom-shops.json; missing: automated checks for restock timing and sell-price rounding.

PR #238 (ea01a637): shops.json re-imported after the osrsreboxed dumper fix that resolves shared item names to the version a shop stocks (small fishing net 303, not Evil Bob's 6209; also Barbarian Assault arrows, event cake, LMS potions, opened looting bags and others); import-osrs-shops.mjs now writes one record per line and no longer patches ids.

Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1704 regenerates shop data upstream; #1714 restores per-version bakers; #1749/#1761 support custom shop/NPC bindings; #1902 fixes shared Omnishop prices, quantities, refunds and inventory-capacity checks.

Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1967 makes the Dragon Inn Greenman’s ale transcript charge 10 coins and deliver one ale, using shared full-bag, insufficient-money and refund guards. Forestry kit storage and Catherby Lost Property eligibility are still separate open reports.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #1990, #2027, #2198, #2217 — Quest-gated shops/Lost Property, Forestry stored currencies, Felix pearl sales, arena Collect and Ned shop behavior are updated.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2333 fix(leagues): Leagues VI bugs from #2324; #2344 Shops: load the host editor's shop defaults and currency keys; #2353 Let native shop handlers override imported defaults; #2384 Farming: Fix gardener shop access and update patch parity; #2544 Finish sixteen remaining Kandarin Diary gameplay tasks; #2639 Add the Rogue Trader miniquest. (9 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4095 Shops: the Wiki's sell rate, buy rate and change per item for every coin, tokkul and trading-stick shop. #3088 Shops: accept off-stock sales at Martin Thwait and Bandit Duty Free.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Open with ShopManager.open and trade via handleItemContainerAction -> buyItem/sellItem (ShopManager.ts:506,571), which mutate stock and currency before refreshing every viewer.
Read stock/order from RuntimeShop, display only amount>0 entries, and resolve each price through itemPrice (per-item override, blood-money value, else ItemDefinition value).
Apply general-store rules: it buys anything it never stocked, keeps a 1 floor and deletes surplus (deletesItems).
acceptanceCriteria: Buy removes the exact stock and spends the exact currency; sell adds stock and pays the 0.85 taxed price.
A general store can buy an item it never stocked.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Reject sells the shop does not stock (buysItem) unless it is the general store, and reject PK-shop items sold for coins.
Check affordability, inventory space (stackable vs not) and cap actions at MAX_ACTION_AMOUNT=5000.
Resolve the packet item id against the display slot before acting.
acceptanceCriteria: A forged slot cannot buy or sell a different item.
An unaffordable or full-inventory purchase leaves stock untouched.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Shop stock is world runtime state reseeded from shops.json on ShopManager.initialize/reload, not player state.
The player's currency persists: item currencies in the inventory, point currencies as persisted shopCurrency attributes and PlayerSave.points.
acceptanceCriteria: A server restart reseeds stock to the shops.json amounts.
Currency spent or earned is not lost across restart.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Lock buy/sell at the stock+currency mutation boundary so concurrent viewers cannot oversell the last unit.
Test rapid buy clicks at the quantity cap, out-of-stock and full-inventory states.
Ensure canUseShops (Wilderness/combat/busy) blocks opening in restricted states.
acceptanceCriteria: Two rapid buyers of the last unit cannot both succeed.
No item or currency is created or destroyed by a failed shop action.

items.name: Alternative currencies
devNotes: Recent work (e40e981f, fed672d0, 17e4f51a): OSRS shop currencies registered through ShopManager.registerCurrency (Blood Money etc.) with per-shop currency in shops.json; covered by server/tests/shop-currencies.test.cjs. Remaining: edge/persistence coverage.

Item currencies come from ITEM_CURRENCIES (Tokkul, Mark of Grace, Molch pearl, abyssal pearls, ecto-token, golden nugget, etc.) and are read/written straight from the inventory via ShopManager.registerItemCurrency.

Point currencies (NMZ, Tithe, League Points, Bounty Hunter Points, Foundry Reputation, Mahogany Homes Points, etc.) are registered by name and stored per player as persisted attributes shopCurrency:<name>; the generic Player.points and pcPoints are separate persisted fields (PlayerSave.ts:108).
Missing: there is no single balance interface and no per-currency cap beyond Math.max(0,...); statuses mark persistence in-progress.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2333 fix(leagues): Leagues VI bugs from #2324; #2353 Let native shop handlers override imported defaults; #2384 Farming: Fix gardener shop access and update patch parity; #2544 Finish sixteen remaining Kandarin Diary gameplay tasks; #2614 Match OSRS beginner combat damage and default new accounts to Punch; #2639 Add the Rogue Trader miniquest. (8 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4095 Shops: the Wiki's sell rate, buy rate and change per item for every coin, tokkul and trading-stick shop. #3088 Shops: accept off-stock sales at Martin Thwait and Bandit Duty Free.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Spend through ShopManager.addCurrency/removeCurrency (ShopManager.ts:775,799) so every currency routes through one registered ShopCurrencyHandler.
For item currencies use ShopManager.registerItemCurrency (inventory getAmount/adds/deleteNumber); for points use registerShopCurrency with a persisted attribute handler (Shopkeepers.plugin.js:54).
Resolve the display name from ShopDefinition.getCurrency and show the inventory count or point total in the shop title.
acceptanceCriteria: Spending a currency reduces exactly that currency by the unit price.
An item-currency purchase cannot consume a different item id.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Compare cost against the authoritative live balance immediately before the mutation and reject if insufficient.
Clamp to safe integers and reject negative/NaN amounts in normalizeAmount.
Keep currency keys namespaced (TOKKUL etc.) so two shops cannot accidentally share a balance.
acceptanceCriteria: A forged currency name has no handler and cannot grant value.
A balance never goes negative.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Persist each point currency with api.persistAttribute(`shopCurrency:${name}`); item currencies persist implicitly via the inventory.
Confirm PlayerSave round-trips attributes (cloneAttribute) plus the generic points and pcPoints fields.
Repair non-finite hydrated balances to 0.
acceptanceCriteria: Login restores Tokkul in the inventory and NMZ/Tithe totals exactly.
A corrupted attribute does not throw on load.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Re-read the balance at commit time so a concurrent spend cannot double-spend a stored point balance.
Test awarding and spending the same currency in one tick and on disconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: Two spends cannot exceed the stored balance.
A disconnect cannot duplicate an award.

items.name: Bonds
devNotes: Main fdf193b28: #1259 the Account tab's bond pouch: move, convert (Bank PIN guarded) and redeem from the pouch. Redeem-in-pouch rows and the Buy buttons are not built.

Implemented: tradeable (13190) and untradeable (13192) bonds, redemption for 14/29/45/365 days (1/2/3/20 bonds) stacking onto bond-membership-expiry, conversion back to tradeable for 10% of the guide price (inventory then bank), received-by-trade/donation auto-conversion, drop blocking and keep-on-death.
Covered by server/tests/bonds.test.cjs (registration, trade/donation conversion, 10% fee, 29-day package, drop/death rules, GE veto and bought-bond conversion).
PR #256 (7dbe576b): the destroy confirmation re-runs the item drop policy, so the bond veto blocks the destroy interface too. Fixed conversion refuses without consuming the bond.
PR #237 (ba207f1b): the bond conversion fee reads getGrandExchangeValue() from the relocated server/data/definitions/item-prices.json; the store value is no longer overwritten by the OSRS quote.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2295 fix: restore RFD feast, chest access and affected saves; #2381 Delete across split stacks, and stop two-handed swaps splitting them; #2388 fix: match the four-tick player death window; #2522 Refuse preset items in charging, storage and Grand Exchange sales; #2550 Collect a single Grand Exchange purchase as the item; #2562 Combat: add recorded hurt, Dark Bow, and death sounds. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3690 Bank incinerator: bonds and coal bags holding coal can't be destroyed (follow-up to #2249). #2971 Bonds: a GE bond collected onto banked bonds now arrives untradeable.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Register the tradeable (13190) and untradeable (13192) bonds and their Redeem/Convert options in server/plugins/items/Bonds.plugin.js.
Redeem 1/2/3/20 bonds for the 14/29/45/365-day membership packages, stacking the new expiry onto any existing one (bond-membership-expiry).
Convert an untradeable bond back to tradeable for 10% of the guide price, paid from inventory then bank.
acceptanceCriteria: Redeeming consumes exactly the package's bonds and sets one expiry.
Converting refuses without the fee and keeps the untradeable bond.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Convert bonds received through trade or donation to the untradeable id, and block dropping them.
Veto listing the untradeable bond on the Grand Exchange and deliver a bought bond untradeable (ge:offer-confirmed / ge:offer-collected).
Never hardcode the guide price: read it from item-prices.json for the 10% fee.
acceptanceCriteria: A bond can never change hands as the untradeable id.
The fee follows the live guide price, not a literal.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Persist the membership expiry as bond-membership-expiry through persistAttribute and apply it on login.
Keep old saves without the attribute loading with no membership.
acceptanceCriteria: Expiry survives a save/load round trip.
Old saves without the field still load.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Refuse conversion when the player cannot pay the 10% fee, leaving the untradeable bond untouched.
Keep bonds on death (keep=true) and block the drop path.
Known gap: the generic destroy path (DropItemPacketListener/DestroyItem) can still delete the untradeable bond despite its drop-policy message.
acceptanceCriteria: A failed conversion or redemption changes nothing.
Bonds are always kept on death.

items.name: Item drops
devNotes: NpcDrops.plugin.js rolls the wiki dump per kill: guaranteed always, a pre-roll that replaces the main roll, one weighted main-table roll, roll_group separate rolls and independent tertiary rolls (npc-drops.json + subtables).
Ground spawns go through ItemOnGroundManager.registerLocation; coins/tokens (CURRENCY_IDS) auto-collect, stackable drops merge, otherwise one ground item per unit.
PR #231 (1eea61b8): NpcDrops gained table-level "rolls" and the npc-drops:location event, used by Zulrah's loot-under-the-player delivery.

PRs #854/#855 share atomic ground-item transfer between pickup and Telekinetic Grab, revalidate source identity/visibility after policy callbacks, preserve metadata and clamp stacks. Capacity policies and partial transfers no longer remove uncredited items; broader storage/drop criteria retain their existing partial scores.
Drop rates remain in canonical generated data. Automated coverage is evidence, not a scoring requirement.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2113, #2129 — Canonical regenerated drops and bank/travel follow-ups are recorded alongside native loot-key values. This does not complete all unconnected loot sources or table/storage criteria.
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2549 Keep Looting Bag Deposit-X tied to the selected item. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4362 Settings: the examine price line on plugin item interfaces. #4227 Settings: plugin-owned rows (Accept aid, Load-x, looting bag, auto-smash, warnings, farming protection) work from All Settings. #4146 Award a wearable apron from Gerrant's hanging apron. 14 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Hook onNpcDeath and call dropFor(killer,npc,id,location), which rolls the table and registers each result with ItemOnGroundManager.registerLocation (NpcDrops.plugin.js:360).
Resolve the table id from the npc-drops.json npcs map and read each entry's weight/out_of/quantity_raw from the file; never hardcode a drop rate.
Merge stackable drops into one ground item and split non-stackables into unit items.
acceptanceCriteria: A kill produces only items present in that npc's table.
A ground item is owner-visible for 100 ticks then public (ItemOnGroundManager.PUBLIC_REVEAL_DELAY).

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Skip kills with no killer/npc or an unknown npc id, and wrap the roll in try/catch so a bad row cannot break the death tick.
Ignore non-integer item ids and amount<=0 results before spawning.
Honour the noted flag only when the wiki row marks it and the note id resolves.
acceptanceCriteria: An unknown npc id drops nothing instead of throwing.
Malformed table rows never create id<=0 ground items.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Ground items are transient; the persistent stores are LootingBag (item meta) and LootKeys (persisted chest attribute).
Confirm the looting bag opens to id 22586 and round-trips meta through the Item save path.
acceptanceCriteria: Items moved into a looting bag survive restart.
Ground items despawn but bagged items do not.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Test simultaneous kills of the same npc and a full ground-item region; drops must not overwrite each other.
Ensure auto-collect (CURRENCY_IDS) cannot exceed stack/inventory limits and falls back to a ground spawn.
acceptanceCriteria: Two kills in the same tick both spawn their drops.
Auto-collected currency never exceeds Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

items.name: Loot tables
devNotes: Shared tables live in npc-drop-subtables.json and are rolled with cumulative weights; rare -> gem -> mega-rare recurse with a depth cap of 4 (rollSharedTable, NpcDrops.plugin.js:214).
RingOfWealth.plugin.js removes empty slots from the rareDrop/gem/megaRare pools and doubles the wilderness clue-scroll tertiary chance when the imbued ring is worn.
Missing: no seeded automated check that the shared-table weights and the recursion cap behave.

PR #994 imports repeatable regenerated canonical drops after fixing source-page renames in osrsreboxed-db, including current Shellbane tables. This is canonical data evidence, not completion of the remaining shared-table/storage criteria.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1782 applies custom drop quantities; #1798 restores superior Slayer roll counts; #1810/#1894 restrict the world boss drop multiplier to unique rewards.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2113 — The source-side canonical dump repair is preserved through regeneration; unresolved shared-table/storage scope stays partial.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Resolve a shared_table entry via rollSharedTable (NpcDrops.plugin.js:214): roll one pool and walk cumulative weights where the summed weight over out_of is the miss chance.
Recurse into nested shared tables only up to depth 4.
Publish the resolved item through the same ItemOnGroundManager path as a normal drop.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared-table roll returns at most one item (or nothing).
The rare -> gem -> mega-rare chain terminates.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Parse rarity_raw strictly as n/outOf and skip text rarities; skip rows with no item_id and no subtable.
Treat a roll past the last weighted slot as a miss, never as an item.
acceptanceCriteria: Unparseable rarity rows are skipped without throwing.
A pool miss drops nothing.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Subtables are static data re-read by loadDrops/reloaddrops, not per-player state.
Any produced item persists only through the normal ground-item / looting-bag / loot-key paths.
acceptanceCriteria: reloaddrops picks up edits without a restart.
No subtable state is stored per player.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Count unusable subtable rows at load and expose them through __internals for diagnostics.
Guard against cyclic subtables (depth cap) and an empty sharedTables map.
acceptanceCriteria: A malformed or cyclic subtable cannot hang a kill.
Missing subtables degrade to an empty roll.

items.name: Grand Exchange
devNotes: Main fdf193b28: #1259 offers above max cash, paid and settled with platinum tokens. Simulated liquidity and missing tax keep task 4 partial.

Main 4b1eac7f6: #1260 Bob Barter decants potions and Murky Matt combines jewellery charges. Open PR #1259: offers above max cash paid with platinum tokens. Simulated liquidity and missing tax keep task 4 partial.

PR #847 replaces the fixed-price five-second fill with editable prices, live buy/sell guide values, volume/price-sensitive fill delays, per-item four-hour buy limits, partial fills and persisted offer/limit state. Existing collection and bond hooks remain in use.

The last task remains partial: fills use simulated liquidity, not a player order book, and GE tax is not implemented. Price-distance timing is explicitly a heuristic in GrandExchange.plugin.js. Do not treat new price/limit support as complete OSRS market matching.
PR #1007 improves native interface/order display, sets and offer fidelity. The simulated liquidity/no real player order book and missing tax remain explicit gaps, so the final task stays partial.
Main 82657e165: #1634 the 2% sale tax with the 5M cap and the Wiki exempt list. Simulated liquidity keeps the last task partial.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1723 rejects inverted and outlier price quotes.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2295 fix: restore RFD feast, chest access and affected saves; #2381 Delete across split stacks, and stop two-handed swaps splitting them; #2522 Refuse preset items in charging, storage and Grand Exchange sales; #2550 Collect a single Grand Exchange purchase as the item. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026): #2994 lets buy offers draw coins from the bank when inventory cash is short. Live player order-book parity remains partial.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Keep the offer lifecycle in GrandExchange.plugin.js: start (slots 0-7), confirm (deduct input, arm a completion timer), scheduleCompletion and collect to inventory/notes/bank.
On confirm, apply deleted() to a copied inventory and only write back if the amount matches, so a failed offer never removes live items (GrandExchange.plugin.js:226).
Persist each slot under the grand-exchange-offers attribute and reschedule completion timers on login.
acceptanceCriteria: An offer deducts the exact input and later collects the exact output.
Collection to bank uses Bank.getTabForItem and cannot overflow the bank.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Validate item id with CacheDefinitions.hasItem plus a non-null name, and integer amount 1..0x7fffffff with a safe total (GrandExchange.plugin.js:209).
Check the player owns the input (coins for buy, item for sell) immediately before commit.
Reject a new offer while all 8 slots hold completed offers.
acceptanceCriteria: A forged item id or quantity places no offer.
An unaffordable offer leaves the inventory untouched.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Keep grand-exchange-offers JSON-compatible ({slot:{sell,itemId,quantity,total,finished,completesAt}}) and call api.persistAttribute (GrandExchange.plugin.js:412).
On login reschedule scheduleCompletion for every unfinished offer and drop invalid/legacy entries.
Apply GE tax/fees at collect time from the same guide/market price once introduced.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart neither duplicates nor erases a completed-but-uncollected offer.
A legacy offer object loads without a manual migration.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Clear completion timers on logout (onPlayerLogout) and re-derive them from completesAt on login so an offline period still completes.
Dedupe collect and revalidate the offer identity (offers.get(player) === offer / active()) before mutating.
Complete player-to-player order matching and applicable GE tax; buy limits and editable prices are already implemented by PR #847.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeating collect on the same slot credits once.
A disconnect cannot duplicate collected output.

items.name: Death storage & reclaim
devNotes: Synced with tsps main e811aff0c (15 October 2026): PR #586 implements per-player gravestones, timed expiry into Death's Office, persisted storage, reclaim fees, Coffer payments and first-death tutorial.

Remaining: GE-price fees, boss-count discounts, some settings and item exceptions, grave-to-Coffer disposal and kept-on-death preview parity. Expiry transfers items into Death's Office rather than making them unreclaimable.

PR #835 moves breakable untradeables into the proper PvP-only lost-item path, preserves protected/PvM items, pays the killer and adds Perdu repair/lock/unlock handling. Broader gravestone pricing/settings exceptions remain partial.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2074, #2182 — Grave-bound untradeable previews and per-life PvP kill-credit cleanup are repaired without claiming every gravestone/reclaim exception is finished.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2209 Lead Death's Office's exit portal to an open square in leagues; #2388 fix: match the four-tick player death window; #2397 Stop coffers and Nex's chest losing what a stack can't hold; #2562 Combat: add recorded hurt, Dark Bow, and death sounds. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4362 Settings: the examine price line on plugin item interfaces. #4242 Settings: the gravestone login warning follows its own row, and ten more All Settings rows are saved. #4237 Settings: confirmations and messages for clue scrolls, STASH units, Plank Make, gravestone fees, trades and boat teleports. 13 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Extend PlayerDeathTask so an item that would drop is first offered to the DeathStorage transaction (emit a custom death:storage event) before ItemOnGroundManager.registerLocation.
On reclaim, remove the stored items and charge the Coins fee in one commit; never leave items in both storage and inventory.
Compute the kept set with getItemsToKeep (PlayerDeathTask.ts:256) and the 3 (+1 with Protect Item, 0 when red-skulled) rule.
acceptanceCriteria: Death moves each lost item exactly once into storage or the ground.
Reclaim transfers all stored items in one commit.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Reclaim fee is Coins; validate the player can pay and has inventory space before releasing items.
Do not store untradeable/lost-on-death items, and route broken Barrows pieces through BrokenItem/Perdu repair instead.
Keep the preview read-only via emitShouldKeepItemOnDeath (ItemsKeptOnDeath.plugin.js:54).
acceptanceCriteria: A player who cannot pay or has no space reclaims nothing.
Untradeable quest items are never placed in storage.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Persist gravestone contents, tile, expiry and fee as a persisted attribute (api.persistAttribute) and/or a PlayerSave field, validating hydrated entries.
Expire/clear storage on a timer and repair legacy saves missing the field.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart preserves grave, Office and Coffer contents and their persisted state.
Expiry moves grave contents once to Death's Office, where they remain reclaimable for the required fee.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Latch the death transaction so a second death while a gravestone is active cannot overwrite it (queue or drop the older one per OSRS rules).
Test disconnect during the death drop and during reclaim; both must be atomic.
Prevent reclaiming a gravestone that belongs to a different account or plane.
acceptanceCriteria: Reclaim commits at most once under rapid clicks.
A second death does not duplicate stored items.

items.name: Bank PIN
devNotes: Main 21a2a1daa: #1014 adds the shared bank-pin:guard flow and protected stores beyond ordinary banking: Grand Exchange, construction storage/servants, Shipyard, bonds, loot keys, Miscellania, STASH and the guarded activity reward shops/containers.

A pending protected operation resumes only after the native keypad is unlocked. Salted PIN storage, delayed activation/removal, recovery delays, wrong-attempt cooldowns and session locks retain their existing implementations; deposit boxes remain PIN-free.
Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2204 — Count Check honors the Ultimate Ironman PIN exemption.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #2757 Refuse Seed Vault access for Ultimate Ironmen.

taskDetails.name: Implement the transaction flow
steps: Add the bank PIN setup/entry interface and the four-digit PIN flow from the wiki.
Store the PIN hashed per account, not in plain text.
acceptanceCriteria: A player can set, change and remove a PIN only after entering the current one.

taskDetails.name: Validate items and permissions
steps: Require the PIN before opening the bank, trading/collecting at the Grand Exchange or accessing other protected storage; leave deposit-only boxes PIN-free.
Apply the delay/lockout rules and the forgotten-PIN recovery path.
acceptanceCriteria: Protected interfaces refuse access until the correct PIN is entered.

taskDetails.name: Persist balances and storage
steps: Persist the PIN and its pending-change state across logout/login.
Re-prompt after the configured logout or world hop.
acceptanceCriteria: Relogin requires the PIN again; a pending change is not lost.

taskDetails.name: Handle interruption and abuse cases
steps: Handle wrong PIN attempts, a cancelled prompt and a disconnect during entry.
Never leave a bank interface open after a failed or abandoned PIN check.
acceptanceCriteria: Three wrong attempts trigger the documented cooldown; cancelling closes access.

categories.name: Clues, achievements & collections
categories.summary: Long-term completion and account-goal systems.

taskTemplate.name: Define entries and requirements
steps: Enumerate {feature} entries, stable keys, prerequisites, tiers and source events.

taskDetails.name: Define entries and requirements
steps: Create server/data/definitions/combat-achievements.json: one entry per task with id, boss/category, tier, task type (kill count, mechanical, perfection, restriction, speed, stamina) and requirement params parsed from Combat_Achievements/All_tasks.
Persist per-task completion under a `ca.tasks` attribute and shared boss kill counts under a `boss.kc.<npc>` attribute so kill-count tasks verify from one source.
Register verification at the authoritative hooks: onNpcDeath/onNpcBeforeDeath for kills, onCombatHitResolved/onPlayerDealtDamage for restriction and speed conditions.
acceptanceCriteria: Every task has a unique id and a declared tier and type.
An unmet speed or restriction condition cannot complete a task.

taskDetails.name: Implement generation and progression
steps: Accumulate points as the sum of completed task tiers and recompute the 41/169/436/1100/1965/2697 thresholds after each completion.
Award a task at most once; a single kill or hit may complete multiple eligible tasks in one event.
Re-validate the Grandmaster tier (all tasks) on each completion and re-lock rewards if a later content update raises a threshold, per the wiki note.
acceptanceCriteria: Point total always equals the sum of completed task tiers.
Save/load keeps tasks and points intact.

taskDetails.name: Implement rewards and unlocks
steps: Grant the tier Antique lamp XP and minimum level from the wiki rewards table (5k/10k/15k/25k/35k/50k at min levels 20/30/40/50/60/70) using the ANTIQUE_LAMP_* item ids.

Grant Ghommal's hilt 1-6 and apply each tier's perks at their authoritative hooks: +5% matching clue-tier drop rate, Like-a-boss kill count cap, Pest Control commendation bonus, cannonball capacity, GWD kill-count/ecumenical-key changes.
Claim via the Ghommal/Laidee Gnonock dialogue; each reward tier is claimed at most once.
acceptanceCriteria: A repeated claim cannot duplicate a hilt, lamp or perk.
Crossing a threshold grants exactly the matching tier's reward set.

Populate the boss/task list, per-task progress and points/tier state from server attributes and send increments after each completion.
Represent locked, in-progress, complete and tier-met states.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh login snapshot matches persisted tasks and points.
Completing a task updates the interface without reopening it.

steps: Create server/data/definitions/achievement-diaries.json with the 12 areas (Ardougne, Desert, Falador, Fremennik, Kandarin, Karamja, Kourend & Kebos, Lumbridge & Draynor, Morytania, Varrock, Western Provinces, Wilderness) and their easy/medium/hard/elite tasks with requirements, parsed from wiki Achievement_Diary.

taskDetails.name: Implement generation and progression

Claiming a tier twice cannot duplicate its lamp or item.

items.name: Collection log
devNotes: PR #354 (f06a2e31): the collection log from the cache (tab structs 471-475, category enums/params) and captures. items.name: Follower system
devNotes: Main ece91aca2: #1437 the equipment tab's Call follower button; #1453 twelve pets follow as their world NPCs, keeping house models; #1445/#1446/#1448/#1454/#1455 Talk-to for the Dagannoth hatchlings, Dark core, Yami, Smol Heredit, Kraken, Smoke Devil, Snakeling, Beaver and Penance.

Main 8166111fa: #1420 pets use cache names and the captured pickup sound delay.

Spawn/follow is implemented: chooseSpawnLocation() (Pets.plugin.js:392) scans player.outterTiles(), skips tiles blocked for player.getPrivateArea(), then NPC.create()s the pet with setPet(true)/setOwner/setFollowing/setMobileInteraction(player)/setArea(player.getArea()); spawnPetNpc() adds to World.getNpcs() or World.getAddNPCQueue().

Client index sync is syncFollowerIndex() -> PacketSender.sendConfig(447, index > 0 ? index : 65535); World.ts (~684-700) re-adds the active pet to the owner's local NPC list when private areas match, so the follower is only visible to its owner.
Missing: doors/plane-change catch-up and re-summon after teleport. NPC.canWalkThroughNPCs() already returns true for pets, so followers do not block movement.
PR #213 (f7820a40): death catch-up added in MovementQueue; Interact dialogue and Metamorphosis ordering are still open.
PR #256 (7dbe576b): morph rejects pets without a morphId, click-3 tries Metamorphosis before pickup, and Interact is a no-op for dialogue -1; pet dialogue data is still absent.

PR #268 (edf838b5): a normal relog re-summons the pet logged out with (pets:last read from inventory or bank), and a logout/disconnect with a full backpack banks the pet instead of orphaning it (manual pickup still refuses); MovementQueue.tryTeleportPetToFollower re-homes a follower left by teleport/plane change.
