taskDetails.name: Enumerate follower ids and the ownership source
steps: Use the PETS table at server/plugins/npcs/Pets.plugin.js:15 as the canonical petId -> itemId -> morphId map; keep using NpcIdentifiers constants (e.g. NpcIdentifiers.WISP) where the plugin already does, and add named constants for the remaining bare ids.

The ownership record is the pet item: PET_BY_ITEM_ID (Pets.plugin.js:318) is the item -> pet index and findOwnedPetItemSource() (Pets.plugin.js:418) scans inventory then every bank tab; there is no api.persistAttribute call for pets.
Ownership must exist before following: only the reward path (skilling roll, bot login) or dropping a pet item spawns a follower, so a follower is never created for an unowned pet.
acceptanceCriteria: getPetByNpcId() and getPetForItemId() resolve every PETS entry and every follower NPC id is created through NPC.create().
A pet item in inventory or any bank tab is the only way a follower can exist.

taskDetails.name: Follow in the owner's private area
steps: chooseSpawnLocation() must pick a tile from player.outterTiles() that RegionManager.blocked(tile, player.getPrivateArea()) rejects, falling back to the player's own tile only when no outer tile is free.
Set the full follower contract on the NPC (setPet/setOwner/setFollowing/setMobileInteraction/setArea) so core NPC movement keeps it with the player and it inherits the player's PrivateArea.
Publish the index for the client after spawn and again ~1.2s later (the postcheck in drop()) by calling syncFollowerIndex(); clear it to 65535 on despawn.
acceptanceCriteria: The follower tracks the owner across the map without blocking movement or pathing.
A follower with a private area different from the player's is re-pointed by World.ts rather than left invisible/orphaned.

taskDetails.name: Store and recover the follower
steps: pickup() (Pets.plugin.js:643) must despawn via despawnPetNpc() (which removes the NPC from World.getAddNPCQueue() and queues World.getRemoveNPCQueue()), add the pet item once, setCurrentPet(null) and sync varp 447 to 65535.
Guard a full inventory before despawning so a failed pickup leaves the follower in the world instead of deleting ownership.
onPlayerLogout/onPlayerDisconnect call pickup() and onPlayerLogin calls syncFollowerIndex(); summonOwnedPetOnBotLogin() re-summons only for player bots, so non-bot reconnect is the open gap.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout with space returns exactly one pet item and never leaves a registered follower NPC behind.
Only one follower is active: drop() refuses a second summon while getCurrentPet() is registered.

taskDetails.name: Implement follower interactions and catch-up
steps: Separate the menu actions: first click = Interact (interact() at Pets.plugin.js:706 currently returns true without dialogue because handlers are commented out), pick-up = the 'Pick-up' onAnyNpcInteraction plus the second/third click, metamorphosis = its own action for pets with morphId != 0.

Add a teleport/plane catch-up that re-issues setFollowing(player) and re-homes the NPC location when the follower is out of range or in a different plane, and a door/obstacle route so it does not stall behind closed doors.
Implement pet dialogue from the ids referenced by getPetDialogue() against server/data/definitions/npc-dialogues.json, with a deterministic anim/sound per action.
acceptanceCriteria: Interact, Pick-up and Metamorphosis each have a deterministic, non-overlapping result; Interact never consumes or moves the pet.
After a teleport or plane change the follower is either next to the player or safely picked up, never orphaned in the old area.

items.name: Ownership persistence
devNotes: Main 8166111fa: #1417 an active follower survives saves and server restarts.

Ownership is item-backed, not attribute-backed: findOwnedPetItemSource() (Pets.plugin.js:418) is the authority and there is no api.persistAttribute key for pets. The only persistence is the pet item surviving in inventory/bank via the pickup-on-logout path.

Awarding is split: NpcDrops.plugin.js rolls pet items as ordinary tertiary drops from server/data/definitions/npc-drops.json (no pet-specific call/emit), while onSkill() grants skilling pets with reward=true (Pets.plugin.js:740). reward=true with an active pet adds a duplicate pet item instead of replacing the follower (Pets.plugin.js:622).
No server-side collection-log write exists; client/common/collectionlog/collection-log.json (All Pets structId 535, Skilling Pets structId 529) is client data with no ownership source.
PR #213 (f7820a40): ownership is recorded per pet item in the persisted pets.owned attribute at award time; the client collection log does not read it yet.

PR #268 (edf838b5): pets.owned is persisted via api.persistAttribute as one record per pet family and syncCollectionLog pushes ClientProtocol.encodeCollectionLogSnapshot (ServerPacketId 190) through PacketSender.sendCollectionLogSnapshot on award, pickup, reclaim and login, so the client's collection log ticks from server-side ownership (pets only).
PR #268 (365dd49f): pet items rolled into npc-drops:roll are removed from the pile and awarded through awardPet, which owns the duplicate, main-drop and full-inventory rules.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2333 fix(leagues): Leagues VI bugs from #2324; #2380 fix: use the correct action verb in shared creation menus; #2399 Use the native OSRS quest list and repair quest state publication; #2614 Match OSRS beginner combat damage and default new accounts to Punch. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Define ownership and the duplicate policy
steps: Treat PET_BY_ITEM_ID as the canonical item -> pet index and findOwnedPetItemSource() as the ownership lookup (inventory first, then Bank.TOTAL_BANK_TABS tabs); do not add a parallel attribute without migrating this lookup.

Define duplicate behaviour explicitly: with a follower active, a second reward roll must add a pet item to inventory (or ItemOnGroundManager.registerNonGlobal() when full — Pets.plugin.js:622) and must not spawn or replace the follower.
Decide whether ownership is proven by item possession or by a persisted flag; the current answer is item possession, so an accidentally deleted item deletes ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: A duplicate pet roll yields an item and never a second follower.
Ownership is derivable after relog from inventory or any bank tab.

taskDetails.name: Restore the follower from ownership
steps: summonOwnedPetOnBotLogin() (Pets.plugin.js:453) is the only restore path and it returns early unless player.isPlayerBot(); replace the bot gate with a restore that also covers normal login, reusing the same findOwnedPetItemSource() + drop(player, itemId, true) flow.
Either persist the active pet identity with api.persistAttribute(key) or reconstruct it from the unique pet item, then re-create the NPC and call syncFollowerIndex(player, npc) on login.
Store the morph/variant alongside the active pet so a restored follower keeps its metamorphosis form (see the Metamorphosis item).
acceptanceCriteria: A normal (non-bot) logout/login reconstructs at most one follower for the owned pet.
Restore never creates a duplicate pet item.

taskDetails.name: Persist and clean up ownership state
steps: Before any removeNpc, send setCurrentPet(null) and syncFollowerIndex(player, null) so the client cannot retain a phantom follower index after death/disconnect (pickup() already does this).
currentPet is in-memory only (Player.ts:1365); ensure no code path treats a persisted NPC index as authoritative across restart — the item is the durable record.
On item deletion (DestroyItem / trade / drop on death) confirm the pet becomes unsummonable, matching OSRS where losing the pet item means re-obtaining it.
acceptanceCriteria: After a restart no stale NPC reference is trusted; a fresh login rebuilds from the item.
Deleting the pet item makes the pet unsummonable until re-obtained.

taskDetails.name: Record ownership for the collection log
steps: Decide whether pet acquisition should write a per-item ownership flag exposed to the client; today the All Pets category (client/common/collectionlog/collection-log.json, structId 535, itemIds 13262...) is static data with no server writer.
If needed, expose ownership through api.registerContentEndpoint(name, handler) or a persisted attribute read at login, and have the client tick the owned items; keep it read-only per AGENTS.md.
Grant ownership at the same moment the pet item is awarded (drop/reward), never on viewing the log.
acceptanceCriteria: Ownership is queryable per pet item id and survives restart.
Viewing the collection log grants nothing.

items.name: Storage & reclamation
devNotes: Main 8166111fa: #1410 Probita's native Pet Insurance selection and confirmation replace the instant return.

Pickup/drop storage works: pickup() (Pets.plugin.js:643) despawns and returns the pet item, and dropping a pet item (api.onItemDropPolicy -> drop(player, itemId, false), Pets.plugin.js:762) consumes it to summon the follower.

Reclamation is a shortcut, not OSRS insurance: custom-shops.json id 22 'Pet Shop' stocks every pet item with a huge stock, so a lost pet can be rebought; there is no Probita insurance, insured-pet flag, or death reclaim. No onPlayerDeath hook exists in Pets.plugin.js.
Missing: death handling for an active follower (it is neither stored nor destroyed on death), and a guard so the Pet Shop does not silently replace the OSRS insurance loop.

PR #213 (f7820a40): a follower survives its owner's death and catches up on respawn (Sept 2026 OSRS behaviour); Probita's "I've lost a pet" returns every owned pet the player no longer holds, idempotently. The Pet Insurance interface itself is not built; pets go straight to the backpack.
PR #268 (b2fcd24c): the Pet Shop no longer sells pet items; generic/skilling/boss pets are insured implicitly by being in pets.owned (reclaimable:false cats excluded).

PR #268 (edf838b5): Probita (5906) reclaim now runs from the npc-dialogue:action 'open_interface'/'Pet Insurance' stage direction and returns every owned pet the player no longer holds, with the nothing-to-reclaim and no-space messages; reclaim is idempotent because it filters on the live held set (holdsPetItem). Remaining: no explicit insurance flag/interface, insurance is implicit.
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2298 fix: stock the standard Purple sweets in Pk Supplies. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Define reclaimable pet items and insurance
steps: Enumerate the reclaimable pets as PET_BY_ITEM_ID entries and decide the insured state key (per pet item or a single 'insured pet' record) that OSRS Probita tracks.
Model Probita and the reclaim fee/interface from the wiki; the fee must be read from the wiki/shop data, not invented. Register any NPC interaction by name via api.onNpcInteraction('Probita', {...}).
Decide whether the current custom-shops.json id 22 'Pet Shop' remains as a convenience or is gated, since it bypasses insurance.
acceptanceCriteria: Each pet item has an explicit reclaimable/insured state and a single reclaim path.
No pet can be reclaimed without a recorded loss event.

taskDetails.name: Convert between pet and item safely
steps: pickup() must reject a full inventory with 'You don't have enough inventory space.' and return without despawning (already implemented at Pets.plugin.js:657), so conversion cannot lose the pet.
drop(player, itemId, false) must delete exactly one pet item before/while spawning; drop(player, itemId, true) must not consume and instead add a duplicate item when a follower already exists.
Block summoning in areas that forbid it via canSummonPetHere() -> area.allowSummonPet(player) (PestControl.plugin.js returns false).
acceptanceCriteria: Pet -> item and item -> pet conversions are exactly 1:1 and never duplicate ownership.
A blocked area refuses summon without consuming the item.

taskDetails.name: Handle death, disconnect and reclaim
steps: Add api.onPlayerDeath handling: in OSRS an active pet is lost on death and must be reclaimed (insured) from Probita; today no hook exists so the follower is neither dropped nor reclaimed.
On disconnect/restart, rely on the item record (pickup() on logout/disconnect) and make the reclaim flow idempotent so a crashed session cannot grant two pets.
Route reclaim through Probita's dialogue/interface and deduct the correct fee, returning the pet item (not a live follower).
acceptanceCriteria: Dying with an active follower records a loss and offers reclaim exactly once.
A disconnect during reclaim cannot duplicate the pet.

taskDetails.name: Expose storage and reclaim interactions
steps: Add the Probita 'Reclaim pets'/'Insure' menu options and any confirmation interface; prefer a server-defined interface via api.registerCustomInterface only if no cache group fits.
Echo the pet-item state (insured/not, reclaimable/not) so the player can see it, using the packets already used elsewhere (sendConfig/sendMessage).
Keep bank storage as-is: pet items bank like any other item; do not create a special pet bank tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Every storage/reclaim action has deterministic output and a clear failure message.
Reclaim cannot be triggered for a pet that is not lost/insured.

items.name: Skilling pets
devNotes: Main bce571cb3: #1458 chinchompa colours, #1459 the Giant squirrel, #1461 Tangleroot and #1463-#1466 Rift guardian colours, GOTR exclusion and the unlocked-colour chooser; #1460 a winning Mining roll takes the last slot over the ore.
Main ece91aca2: #1451 the Beaver uses its real follower, and #1452 a winning roll takes the last slot over the log; #1456 the normal Rock Golem is awarded again.

GIANT_SQUIRREL exists in SKILLING_PETS (chance 5000) but Agility only emits agility:lap while Pets subscribes to agility:success, so it can never roll; Hunter now emits hunter:success so the chinchompas are reachable, and Tangleroot stays dead until Farming lands.
Rates remain flat 3000-8000, the 14 Rift Guardians stay outside SKILLING_PETS, and no pets test exists.

PR #213 (f7820a40): every skilling pet rolls at the Wiki 1 in (base - level*25) rate (x15 at 200M XP) from per-action bases on courses, rocks, trees, fish, stalls/pickpockets and chinchompas; Agility emits agility:success; the 14 rift guardians roll per essence in the crafted rune's colour; ownership is the persisted pets.owned attribute and duplicates follow the OSRS "would have been followed" rule.
Remaining: metamorphosis cycles/variant persistence (see Metamorphosis).
PR #238 (ea01a637): each fish carries its Wiki Heron base and a big-net catch rolls the pet once per kind caught through fishing:success.
PR #256 (7dbe576b): metamorphosis is rejected on pets without a morphId; same-item morph families still lack variant persistence.

PR #268 (b2fcd24c, edf838b5): every skilling pet with a cycle (chinchompas, rift guardians, heron, phoenix colours) now morphs through the metadata-gated morph() path, stores the chosen form per family in pets:variant and re-applies it on summon; a pet with morphId 0 refuses with no form change, and a dialogue-less skilling pet's Interact is a documented no-op rather than an empty dialogue box.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2528 Implement remaining Morytania diary activities; #2534 Implement Ardougne Hard and Elite diary gameplay tasks; #2548 Add remaining Kourend Diary skill and combat actions; #2621 Keep calcified rocks standing for Endless Harvest miners when the water stops; #2658 Add the Runite Golem's rock and the Wilderness Diary's rune scimitar task; #2663 Store and keep gems in an open gem bag. (14 merged PRs touch the recorded implementation; highlights shown.) Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Define skilling pet unlocks and rates
steps: Keep PETS as the petId -> itemId -> skill mapping and extend SKILLING_PETS (Pets.plugin.js:329) to include the 14 Rift Guardians (skill RUNECRAFTING) which are declared but never rolled.

Replace the flat `chance` values with the per-pet rate contract from the wiki Skilling_pets table (level- and action-scaled), reading thresholds from data rather than literals; do not copy the current hardcoded 5000/8000 numbers as canonical.
Resolve all Rock Golem NPC variants (ROCK_GOLEM_2..ROCK_GOLEM_25 in NpcIdentifiers.ts) to the one rock-golem pet entry so every spawned form is summoned/pickable.
acceptanceCriteria: Every pet in the collection log 'Skilling Pets' category (structId 529) has a roll source.
Rates are sourced from the wiki/data, not hardcoded per-skill constants.

taskDetails.name: Deliver the pet on a skilling action
steps: Have each skill emit its '<skill>:success' custom event on a successful action (the pattern at Woodcutting.plugin.js:643, Fishing.plugin.js:260, Mining.plugin.js:228, Runecrafting.plugin.js:245, Thieving.plugin.js:150, Firemaking.plugin.js:307) and only then let onSkill() roll.

Implement the missing Agility, Farming and Hunter skill plugins (or at least their :success emitters) so Giant Squirrel, Tangleroot and the Chinchompas have a trigger; model them on the nearest existing skill plugin.
On a hit, drop the pet with reward=true so a follower spawns without consuming an item, and keep the world broadcast message format.
acceptanceCriteria: Each implemented skill can produce its pet at the configured rate without re-rolling on the same action.
A pet roll never fires from a failed action or a non-XP action.

taskDetails.name: Store skilling pet ownership
steps: The reward path does not consume an item; a duplicate skilling pet must therefore create a pet item (drop() reward branch, Pets.plugin.js:622) so ownership is never silently lost.
Ensure a skilling pet obtained while a follower is active still records ownership as an item, and that the item is bankable like any other.
Decide whether a skilling pet is always re-obtainable by rolling again (it is), so no insurance is needed for it.
acceptanceCriteria: Every skilling pet grant leaves exactly one ownership record (item or active follower).
Duplicate grants produce items, not multiple followers.

taskDetails.name: Handle skilling pet interactions and variants
steps: Wire Interact/pick-up for the skilling pet NPCs through the same PETS machinery; most skilling pets have dialogue -1, so Interact should be a no-op while pick-up and metamorphosis (Chinchompas/Rift Guardians) still work.
Implement the Chinchompa (6718/6719/6720) and Rift Guardian morph cycles via the morph() path, persisting the chosen variant.
Reject a morph on a pet without a morphId without changing the active follower.
acceptanceCriteria: A skilling pet with no dialogue does not open an empty dialogue box.
Chinchompa/Rift Guardian variant toggles survive respawn where intended.

items.name: Boss pets
devNotes: Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1682 audits the All Pets sources, adds Noon through the Grotesque Guardians plugin-owned drop table, and makes Beef, Maggot marquess, Mr McGroot and Aggy summonable. Previously alleged missing sources were already present in NPC tables/overrides or the CoX/ToB/ToA reward chests; adding raid pets to NPC tables would duplicate awards. Boss-pet source coverage is complete. Existing award, storage and morph credit is retained; this does not mark every raid visual or pet dialogue complete.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4226 Settings: dialogues, messages and switches follow their All Settings rows. #3623 Grotesque Guardians: a Dusk kill counts once in the collection log.

taskDetails.name: Enumerate boss pet sources and drop items
steps: Cross-reference every boss pet in collection-log All Pets against generated NPC tables, established overrides, plugin-owned boss tables and activity/raid reward paths.
Keep exactly one authoritative award source per pet; raid chest pets must not also be added to NPC tables. Store base drop weights in data and use the established roller/reward calculation.
Map every awarded pet item through PET_BY_ITEM_ID so it is summonable; generated osrsreboxed tables change only by upstream regeneration.
acceptanceCriteria: Every boss pet in collection-log All Pets has one authoritative NPC, boss-plugin or activity reward source.
Base drop weights are data-owned, and raid reward calculations do not also award the same pet through an NPC table.

taskDetails.name: Award the boss pet and roll it correctly
steps: NpcDrops.plugin.js (onNpcDeath -> dropFor) already rolls tertiary entries; verify the pet item id lands on the ground with the right noted/stack behaviour and that kill credit goes to the killer only.
If a boss should grant the pet directly (reward path) instead of a ground item, emit a custom event from NpcDrops and let Pets handle it, rather than importing Pets inside NpcDrops.
Respect Ring of Wealth only where the wiki says it affects the roll; the shared-table logic already gates the rare table, so a pet row must not be mis-tagged into it.
acceptanceCriteria: A kill below/at the drop denominator produces at most one pet item per kill.
The pet item is visible to the killer and summonable immediately.

taskDetails.name: Summon, store and convert the boss pet
steps: Picking up the boss-pet item gives no follower until it is dropped: onItemDropPolicy -> drop(player, itemId, false) consumes it and spawns the follower (Pets.plugin.js:762). Keep this single conversion path.
A duplicate boss-pet drop while a follower is active must produce a bankable item (Pets.plugin.js:622), matching OSRS duplicate behaviour.
Confirm the follower persists via pickup-on-logout, and define whether death destroys the item (OSRS boss pets are lost on death and reclaimed via Probita).
acceptanceCriteria: Dropping a boss-pet item summons exactly one follower and removes exactly one item.
A duplicate drop never replaces the active follower.

taskDetails.name: Map boss pet interactions and variants
steps: Route the boss-pet NPC ids through the PETS click hooks; implement the dialogues referenced by getPetDialogue() (Dark core 123, Callisto cub 130, Hellpuppy 138/143/145/150/154, Abyssal orphan 202/206/209 etc.) against npc-dialogues.json.
Implement the boss-pet metamorphosis cycles: Snakelings (2130/2131/2132), Vet'ion Jr (5536/5537), Kalphite Princess (6637/6638).
Persist the chosen variant so a re-summoned boss pet keeps its morph.
acceptanceCriteria: Every boss pet has a deterministic Interact/pick-up result and morphable ones cycle correctly.
Variant survives a relog where intended.

items.name: Quest & activity pets
devNotes: Main 8166111fa: #1409 the Chompy chick rolls on kills and plucks once the elite Western Provinces reward is claimed.

Quest pets are unimplemented: the pet kitten/cat items 1555-1572 exist in server/data/definitions/item-gameplay.json but Gertrude's Cat is not among the implemented quests (server/plugins/quests/ has only 18 quests) and no plugin grants or grows the kitten, so there is no acquisition path. Hellcat/clockwork cat are likewise absent.

Activity pets in PETS have no granting system: Penance Princess (item 12703, Barbarian Assault), TzRek-Jad (13225, Fight Caves), Jal-nib-rek (21291), Herbi (21509, Herbiboar), Bloodhound (19730, clues), Chompy chick (13071) — none of the source minigames/activities is implemented as a reward route.
The pet items are bankable/summonable once owned (PET_BY_ITEM_ID), so only the unlock/acquisition half is missing; there is no server-side collection-log write.

PR #219 (8de8d0ac): Herbi and Quetzin roll from hunter:success; PR #215 rolls Youngllef as a Gauntlet chest tertiary; PR #221 (29f698d0) awards the phoenix (1/5000) from the Wintertodt reward cart. Cats, Penance princess, Bloodhound and Chompy chick still lack sources.

PR #268 (b2fcd24c): the Gertrude's Cat kitten is now fully modelled - a persisted kitten->cat->overgrown clock (one event per 90 s following), hunger/attention warnings that can make it run away, raw/cooked fish or milk feeding, Stroke/Chase vermin/Guess age/Shoo away, hell-kitten from a hell-rat and generic-pet run-off on death; stage survives relog. Wily/lazy cats still need Ratcatchers.

PR #268 (365dd49f): activity pets award through the follower system from Inferno (Jal-Nib-Rek), ToA (Tumeken's guardian at completion, no longer consuming a chest slot), Gauntlet (Youngllef), Doom of Mokhaiotl (Dom) and shipwreck salvaging (Soup); duplicates follow the OSRS would-have-been-followed rule. Penance Princess (Barbarian Assault), Bloodhound (clues) and Chompy chick (Western Provinces elite diary) still have no source.
Main sync 9949ef068: PR #606 adds the A Ruff Situation shelter puppies as followers (drop, Pet, Guess age, pickup, Release).

Main 82657e165: #1623 Penance Princess from the Barbarian Assault high gamble (1/1000 after a Queen kill and 500 honour), completing the unlock sources. Barbarian Assault waves are absent, so the activity condition stays partial.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2472 Record successful activity rewards in the collection log; #2538 Stop reward chests losing what a stack can't hold. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4251 Settings: clue scroll warnings for skilling clues, and the level-up chatbox list. #3985 Sailing: Opulent salvage's seed, herb and gem rolls, and sorting's clues and Soup. #3673 Fix Gertrude's Cat crate randomisation and Mew cues. 6 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Define quest and activity pet unlocks
steps: Decide the unlock route per pet: quest reward (Gertrude's Cat -> pet kitten/cat, items 1555-1572), minigame reward (Barbarian Assault -> Penance Princess 12703), activity drop (Herbiboar -> Herbi 21509, Fight Caves -> TzRek-Jad 13225), or drop (Bloodhound 19730 from clues).
For quest pets, model the kitten growth/time mechanic from the wiki rather than a one-off item grant; the pet items already exist in item-gameplay.json.
Register each source with the nearest existing system (new quest via QuestRuntime.js; Barbarian Assault/Fight Caves as minigames under server/plugins/minigames/).
acceptanceCriteria: Every quest/activity pet has an explicit, single unlock source.
No unlock is granted without completing its quest/activity condition.

taskDetails.name: Grant the pet and model activity conditions
steps: Barbarian Assault: award Penance Princess on the correct wave/point total and hand it to the player as the pet item; read the requirement from the minigame's own scoring, not a literal.
Gertrude's Cat: add the quest dialogue/stages (npc-dialogues.json) and grant the kitten item at completion; the kitten should grow to a cat and can become a hellcat per the wiki.
Herbiboar/TzRek-Jad/Bloodhound: emit the pet reward from the activity's existing completion/death hook and route it through the PETS reward path so ownership is recorded once.
acceptanceCriteria: Each activity can grant its pet at most once per qualifying completion.
A failed/aborted activity grants nothing.

taskDetails.name: Store and model quest/activity pet ownership
steps: Quest pets (kitten/cat) carry growth state; persist it with api.persistAttribute so a relog keeps the cat/kitten/hellcat stage rather than resetting.
Activity pets are single items and follow the normal item-ownership rule (inventory/bank); no insurance is required for re-obtainable ones.
Ensure a re-grant of an already-owned activity pet yields a bankable item, not a second follower.
acceptanceCriteria: Kitten/cat/hellcat stage survives logout and restart.
Duplicate activity pet grants produce items only.

taskDetails.name: Implement quest/activity pet interactions
steps: Wire dialogues for the quest/activity cats (stroke/feed/command menus per the wiki) and the minigame pets through the existing PETS click hooks.
Model the kitten's needs/growth and the cat's vermin-catching interactions; keep actions deterministic and reject them when the pet is not the active follower.
Use npc-dialogues.json slugs captured via osrsreboxed rather than writing new dialogue text inline.
acceptanceCriteria: Cat/kitten interactions behave correctly and only affect the owned active pet.
Activity pets without dialogue have a clean no-op Interact.

items.name: Metamorphosis
devNotes: Main 8166111fa: #1414/#1418/#1419 metamorphic and sanguine dust unlock all eight Olmlet and five Lil' Zik forms, with the right items.

A primitive exists: morph() (Pets.plugin.js:685) calls npc.setNpcTransformationId(pet.morphId) and sends 'Your pet endures metamorphosis and transforms.'; PETS defines cycles for Snakelings (2130/2131/2132), Vet'ion Jr (5536/5537), Kalphite Princess (6637/6638), Chinchompas (6718/6719/6720) and the 14 Rift Guardians.

Bug: metamorphosis is wired to the NPC third-click branch of interactWithPet() (Pets.plugin.js:795), but that branch calls pickup() first, which returns true whenever the owner's inventory is not full, so morph() is unreachable in-game. There is also no OSRS 'Metamorphosis' menu option and no variant persistence.
Missing: a persisted variant key, correct menu ordering (Interact / Metamorphosis / Pick-up), unmorph-vs-cycle rules, and morph data for the many PETS entries with morphId 0.

PR #268 (b2fcd24c): metamorphosis gates follow the Wiki - firelighters, talismans, egg sacs, metamorphic dust, boss remnants, mole parts, charged ice, coagulated venom, spirit flakes, Gull's 50 fish feeds, a Corrupted Gauntlet completion and TzHaar-Ket-Rak's sixth challenge - with new cycles for Nid/Rax, Muphin, the Tumeken's guardian family, Bran/Ric, Noon/Midnight, Baby mole/Mole-rat and phoenix colours; a denied morph leaves the form unchanged.

PR #268 (edf838b5): morph() advances exactly one form per click inside one pet family, stores the chosen npc id in pets:variant keyed per family and re-applies it on summon; morphId 0 refuses, and the client injects a Metamorphosis option for morphable pets the cache omits (server falls back to the click index).
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2379 Fix Castle Wars practice bot patrols and flag runs. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Define metamorphosis variants and persistence
steps: Enumerate morphable pets and their variant npc ids from the PETS morphId cycles (Snakelings, Vet'ion Jr, Kalphite Princess, Chinchompas, Rift Guardians) and note which have no cycle yet.
Define a persisted variant key per pet (api.persistAttribute) so the chosen form is restored on relog/respawn, rather than only npc.setNpcTransformationId in memory.
Confirm the OSRS rule: metamorphosis toggles only between forms the player has access to for that pet and does not change ownership or item id.
acceptanceCriteria: Every morphable pet has a stable variant key and a defined cycle.
Variant state survives respawn and relog where intended.

taskDetails.name: Wire the metamorphosis action
steps: Implement the menu contract Interact / Metamorphosis / Pick-up and make metamorphosis a separate click branch, not behind pickup(); the current third-click ordering (pickup then morph) makes morph unreachable.
morph() should read the pet's current variant, advance the morphId cycle and setNpcTransformationId while updating player.getCurrentPet()'s identity mapping, then re-sync any per-variant data.
Reject metamorphosis on a pet with morphId 0 or when the player does not own the active follower, without changing the active pet.
acceptanceCriteria: Metamorphosis is selectable in-game and cycles exactly one step per click.
A pet with no cycle shows no Metamorphosis option.

taskDetails.name: Persist and recover the active variant
steps: On summon/pickup/login, apply the stored variant via setNpcTransformationId so the follower respawns in the correct form.
Store the variant against the pet item/ownership so a duplicate item does not carry a stale variant, and clear it on reclaim where OSRS resets the form.
Ensure getPetByNpcId()/PET_BY_ID resolve a transformed id so a morphed follower is still recognised for pickup and further morphs.
acceptanceCriteria: Pickup then re-summon restores the same variant.
A morphed follower can still be picked up and morphed again.

taskDetails.name: Expose metamorphosis interactions
steps: Add the visible 'Metamorphosis' menu option and any transform animation/graphic/sound on the pet NPC; keep the existing message text.
For pets with variants gated behind unlocks (e.g. recolours), hide/deny the option until unlocked and say so clearly.
Keep actions deterministic and idempotent; a rejected morph must not consume the pet or change its form.
acceptanceCriteria: Every morphable pet exposes a deterministic Metamorphosis option.
A denied morph leaves the active pet form unchanged.

categories.name: Social & multiplayer
categories.summary: Player communication and cooperative systems.

taskTemplate.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Define {feature} request, accept, reject, leave and timeout transitions.
Validate both players' live state and permissions before each transition.
Send symmetric state updates to every affected participant.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated or crossed requests resolve once.
Disconnect clears pending state for all participants.

taskTemplate.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Apply ignore, privacy, mute, rank and account-mode rules to {feature}.
Enforce rules server-side before broadcasting content or presence.
Return minimal feedback without leaking hidden status.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked users cannot transmit through alternate entrypoints.
Hidden presence remains hidden after relog.

taskTemplate.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Store {feature} relationships, ranks and preferences in existing player persistence.
Normalize names and stable identifiers at the data boundary.
Load state before presence or channel registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename/case differences do not duplicate relationships.
Save/load preserves settings and memberships.

taskTemplate.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Test {feature} during world change, logout, full lists, stale targets and simultaneous actions.
Make cleanup idempotent and scoped to affected participants.
Rate-limit abusive repeat requests where an existing limiter is available.
acceptanceCriteria: No ghost membership or pending request remains after disconnect.
Capacity limits are enforced atomically.

items.name: Public chat
devNotes: Public chat is core, not a plugin: NetworkBuilder.ts:350-354 dispatches messageType 'public' straight to ChatPacketListener.handleText; FriendsList.plugin.js only receives 'chat' for friends-chat channel lines.

ChatPacketListener.handleText clamps text to 80 chars, strips '<'/'>', prefixes player.getChatIcons() as <img=N>, calls forceChat for the overhead bubble, then sendPublicChat (PacketSender.ts:587) to local players plus the asymmetric 255-cap recipients listed via World.getNearbyPlayersForUpdate.

Privacy is PlayerRelations.canReceivePublicChatFrom: ignore list first, then publicChatMode 0=On / 1=Friends / 2=Off / 3=Hide (PlayerRelations.ts:79-83). Mute and Misc.blockedWord are checked in ChatPacketListener.allowChat before any broadcast.

Known gap that makes task 3 wrong in the seed: publicChatMode and tradeChatMode (and PrivateChatStatus) are memory-only. PlayerSave stores friends/ignores/friendRanks/friendsChat* but has no chat-mode fields, so filters reset to On every relog.

PR #213 (f7820a40): public/private/trade filter modes persist as the chat.filters attribute and are pushed to the client on login via the new CHAT_FILTER_SETTINGS (122) packet. Edge cases audited: ignore/filters/mute run before broadcast.
PR #379 (a9f30544): public chat emits a `public_chat` social-packet event after the filter; a plugin marking it handled suppresses the broadcast.

Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1917 shows display names in live player-facing chat, PMs, channels and trades while keeping login identity stable for persistence and moderation. Lookup accepts current and held names.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Trace the live path end to end: client ChatOps CHAT_SENDPUBLIC (client/rs/cs2/handlers/ChatOps.ts:135) -> encodeChat('public') -> NetworkBuilder 'chat' case (NetworkBuilder.ts:350) -> ChatPacketListener.handleText.
Keep the overhead bubble (player.forceChat) and the sendPublicChat broadcast as separate steps, and keep public chat out of FriendsChatManager - handleChat there is only for the legacy channel.
Preserve the 80-char clamp, '<'/'>' stripping and chat-icon prefixing already in handleText.
acceptanceCriteria: A public message renders above the sender and in every eligible nearby player's chatbox with the sender's crown/title icons.
The sender and all recipients see the same text after clamping and filtering.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Gate every recipient through PlayerRelations.canReceivePublicChatFrom before sendPublicChat; it already runs the ignore check first and then the public chat mode.
Enforce mute (PlayerPunishment.muted / IPMuted) and Misc.blockedWord centrally in ChatPacketListener.allowChat so no alternate entrypoint (chat packet) bypasses it.
Return the existing generic 'You are muted...' / 'Your message did not make it past the filter.' text without revealing which rule blocked it.
acceptanceCriteria: A player who ignores another stops seeing that player's public chat on the next tick while everyone else still sees it.
A player with public chat set to Friends is not heard by non-friends, and a muted/blocked-word message is never broadcast.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Add publicChatMode and tradeChatMode fields (plus the private status) to PlayerSave and round-trip them next to friendRanks/friendsChat* in PlayerSave.load and PlayerSave.fromPlayer (PlayerSave.ts:830-841).
Clamp on load to publicChatMode 0-3, tradeChatMode 0-2 and PrivateChatStatus 0-2, matching PlayerRelations.setChatModes (PlayerRelations.ts:49-53).
Restore the values before PlayerRelations.onLogin sends sendPrivateStatus/sendChatOptions so the client's filter buttons open on the saved state.
acceptanceCriteria: Setting public chat to Off, logging out and back in leaves it Off and non-friends still cannot hear the player.
Old saves missing the new fields default to On (0) without error.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Re-apply the persisted chat modes on login/world change, since the client currently always starts from On.
Keep the two-source recipient union in handleText (localPlayers plus nearby players whose local list includes the speaker) and keep the sent-index Set de-duplication for the 255-cap asymmetry.
Do not add a rate limiter for public chat - one line per input - but keep the mute/blocked-word check ahead of broadcast.
acceptanceCriteria: After a relog a player with public chat Off stays hidden from non-friends.
A recipient present in both local lists still receives exactly one message.

items.name: Private messages
devNotes: Routing is live: NetworkBuilder 'private_message' -> PluginManager.emitSocialPacket -> FriendsList.plugin.js:28 -> FriendsChatManager.handlePrivateMessage (FriendsChatManager.js:144).

handlePrivateMessage normalises the recipient with accountName (lowercase key + stringToLongBigInt encoded id), caps text at 160, runs allowChat (mute + blocked words), requires the recipient on the sender's friend list, then checks recipient.getRelations().canReceivePrivateMessageFrom (ignore list and PrivateChatStatus).

Wire output uses encodeChatMessage('private_in', chatType 3) to the recipient and 'private_out' (chatType 6) to the sender (ClientProtocol.ts:870); the client renders these via SplitPrivateChatPlugin (client tests split-private-chat-plugin.test.ts).
PR #256 (7dbe576b): sending a PM while private is Off now forces the private:Friends mode through FriendsChatManager.setChatFilters, so it persists across relog; presence stays same-world by design.

Audit (PR #213): edge-case criteria already met in code - live recipient lookup with offline fallback, 200/100 caps before mutation, lowest-rank eviction at 500 and full cleanup on channel disable, follow cleared on leader logout/death and idempotent re-follow. Single-world presence by design.

Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1917 shows display names in live player-facing chat, PMs, channels and trades while keeping login identity stable for persistence and moderation. Lookup accepts current and held names.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Keep the single entrypoint: the client CHAT_SENDPRIVATE (ChatOps.ts:153) -> sendPrivateMessage -> PRIVATE_MESSAGE packet -> FriendsList.plugin.js -> handlePrivateMessage.
Preserve the ordering in handlePrivateMessage: normalise recipient, clean/allowChat the text, require sender.hasFriend(recipient), then recipient online + canReceivePrivateMessageFrom.
Send the symmetric pair - 'private_in' to the recipient and 'private_out' back to the sender - from the same call, and leave the client history to SplitPrivateChatPlugin.
acceptanceCriteria: Sending to a friend produces one outgoing line on the sender and one incoming line on the recipient.
A message typed before the sender is friends fails with the existing 'add that player to your friends list first' text and sends nothing.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Apply canReceivePrivateMessageFrom for both directions: it already blocks ignore-list senders and honours PrivateChatStatus ON / FRIENDS_ONLY / OFF (PlayerRelations.ts:85-90).
Route the text through allowChat so mute and Misc.blockedWord apply before the packet is encoded.
Return the same generic offline/busy text for a recipient who is ignored or has private off, so hidden presence does not leak.
acceptanceCriteria: A recipient with Private set to Friends accepts a friend but not a stranger.
An ignore-list or Off recipient is indistinguishable from an offline one from the sender's feedback.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Persist the sender's private mode (PrivateChatStatus) alongside public/trade modes (see Public chat task 3); the friend list itself already persists via PlayerSave.friends/friendRanks.
No new relationship records are needed for PMs - they are transient - so do not add a message table.
Restore the private mode on login before PlayerRelations.onLogin calls sendPrivateStatus so the recipient's visibility is correct immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Private set to Off survives relog and the player shows offline to non-friends.
No PM-specific data is written to the save beyond the mode.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Resolve the recipient by encoded long name for the friend check and by live World lookup for delivery, so a stale player index cannot misdeliver.
If the recipient disconnects between the friend check and delivery, fall back to the existing 'This player is currently offline.' message rather than throwing.
Cover crossed PMs (both send in the same tick) - each call reads its own recipient independently, so no shared state needs locking.
acceptanceCriteria: Two players PMing each other in the same tick both receive their messages.
A recipient who logs out mid-send causes no server error and no ghost message.

items.name: Friends & ignore lists
devNotes: Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1917 keeps login identity as the persisted relationship key while resolving display/held names for friends, ignores, PMs and chat channels. Rename/case aliases cannot create another account entry; current/previous names refresh immediately. Name holds, 28-day cooldown, uniqueness, failed writes and races have regression coverage. Hyphens are unsupported by base-37 names; presence remains same-world only.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3948 Hardcore Worlds: world type, Death's Office start, death choice, Escape crystal. #3691 Display names: a live bot's name can't be taken (follow-up to #2346). #2731 Per-server character slots: one login, several characters, a picker after login. 4 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Route add_friend/remove_friend/set_friend_rank/add_ignore/remove_ignore from FriendsList.plugin.js:24 into FriendsChatManager.handleAction -> handleRelationAction (FriendsChatManager.js:298).

Let PlayerRelations.addFriend/deleteFriend/addIgnore/deleteIgnore own the list mutation and the client add/delete packets; handleRelationAction should only call persist, sendSnapshot and refreshFriendWatchers afterwards.
Send a full encodeFriendsChatSnapshot after every change so the friends/ignore tabs and the channel list stay consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Adding a friend shows them on both players' friend lists and survives relog.
Removing a friend or ignore updates the tab without a relog.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Keep the mutual-exclusion and duplicate guards in PlayerRelations so ignore and friend never both contain the same encoded id.
Make hasIgnore short-circuit public chat (canReceivePublicChatFrom), private chat (canReceivePrivateMessageFrom) and friends-chat messages (handleChat skip).
Adding an ignore while in a channel already removes that member from the owner's channels (handleRelationAction add_ignore branch, FriendsChatManager.js:322).
acceptanceCriteria: An ignored player cannot reach the ignorer through public chat, PM or a shared friends chat.
Adding someone to ignore who is already a friend is rejected with the existing message.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Keep friends/ignores/friendRanks in PlayerSave (getFriends/getIgnores/getFriendRanks at PlayerSave.ts:456-474) and round-trip them in fromPlayer/load.
Normalise every inbound name through accountName before it reaches the bigint list, and on load via PlayerSave.normalizeRelationListToBigInt.
Hydrate the relations before FriendsChatManager.onLogin sends snapshots (FriendsList.plugin.js:16), which currently happens correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename/case variants of the same name do not create a second entry.
Save/load preserves memberships and friend ranks.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Enforce the 200/100 caps atomically at the point of push (PlayerRelations.MAX_FRIENDS/MAX_IGNORES) with the existing 'list is full' message.
Cover stale targets: removing a name that is not on the list already no-ops with a message; ensure a disconnected target is still removable.
Decide and document cross-world presence; today snapshot online state only sees World.getPlayers(), so friends elsewhere read offline.
acceptanceCriteria: The 201st friend is rejected with no partial mutation.
A friend who logs out is shown offline on the next snapshot without leaving a ghost online row.

items.name: Friends chat
devNotes: FriendsChatManager is the whole legacy chat-channel: static channels/membershipByPlayer/temporaryBans/offlinePlayerIds maps, MAX_CHANNEL_MEMBERS=500, KICK_BAN_MS=1h, and ranks Unranked(-1)/Friend(0)/Recruit(1)/Corporal(2)/Sergeant(3)/Lieutenant(4)/Captain(5)/General(6)/Owner(7)/JagexModerator(127) (FriendsChatManager.js:6-21).

Interfaces: group 94 is the setup screen (entry/talk/kick rank dropdowns, set prefix/disable), group 7 join/leave/setup, groups 429/432 switch ignore/friends tabs (optionFromWidget, FriendsChatManager.js:58-74). Rank options map to RANK_OPTIONS 'Anyone'..'Only me'.

Talk goes through handleChat -> encodeChatMessage('channel', chatType 9); kick sets a temporary ban keyed by owner; channel name, entry/talk/kick ranks, last owner and friend ranks persist via PlayerSave friendsChat* fields (PlayerSave.ts:836-841).
Plugin route: FriendsList.plugin.js:24-36 turns 'friends_chat_action' into join/leave/kick and 'chat' (messageType friends_chat) into handleChat; widget clicks arrive via onInterfaceActionClick.

Audit (PR #213): edge-case criteria already met in code - live recipient lookup with offline fallback, 200/100 caps before mutation, lowest-rank eviction at 500 and full cleanup on channel disable, follow cleared on leader logout/death and idempotent re-follow. Single-world presence by design.

PR #703 (b7c3ca998, including review fix 1c04dee61): real PlayerSave round-trip and offline-owner login/rejoin regression confirms persistence of the channel name, rank thresholds, friend ranks and last owner. Presence remains single-world; see server/docs/social-chat-and-following.md.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1804 reconciles chat-channel/social tabs and mounts native interface 707; modern clans are separately implemented by #1820.

Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1917 shows display names in live player-facing chat, PMs, channels and trades while keeping login identity stable for persistence and moderation. Lookup accepts current and held names.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2614 Match OSRS beginner combat damage and default new accounts to Punch. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #2832 fix: don't show a previous name for friends who never changed theirs (#2820).

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Drive join/leave/kick/setup from FriendsChatManager.handleAction, with join requiring profile.channelName and the caller meeting profile.entryRank unless JagexModerator (FriendsChatManager.js:334-366).
Emit a full encodeFriendsChatSnapshot to every member on join/leave/kick/rank change (broadcastChannel) and a 'Now talking in chat-channel X' notification to the joiner.
Keep the /-prefix channel line on chatType 9 ('channel') and leave public chat untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: Joining a channel adds the member to every member's list and typing a line reaches all non-ignoring members.
Leave/kick removes the member and clears their clan-chat state.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Enforce entryRank on join, talkRank in handleChat, and kickRank (minimum Corporal) in kick, with JagexModerator bypassing all three; keep the existing kick/set-rank/kick message text.
Skip members who have the speaker on their ignore list during broadcast, and reject joins from names on the owner's ignore list (handleChat/join branches).
Apply allowChat (mute + blocked words) to channel lines, and keep the 1h temporary ban on kick.
acceptanceCriteria: A below-rank player cannot talk or join and sees the matching existing message.
A kicked player cannot rejoin for the ban window, and an ignored player is skipped by the broadcaster.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Keep friendsChatChannelName, friendsChatLastOwner, friendsChatEntryRank, friendsChatTalkRank and friendsChatKickRank in PlayerSave and load them in PlayerSave.load (PlayerSave.ts:731-738).
Load an offline owner's profile with GameConstants.PLAYER_PERSISTENCE.load (loadOwnerProfile, FriendsChatManager.js:535) so channels work while the owner is offline.
Persist after every mutation via FriendsChatManager.persist (wraps GameConstants.PLAYER_PERSISTENCE.save).
acceptanceCriteria: Channel name and rank thresholds survive owner relog.
A member rejoining after relog lands back in friendsChatLastOwner's channel.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: At the 500-member cap, evict the lowest-ranked member (join branch, FriendsChatManager.js:378) and notify them; keep the operation atomic.

Disabling the channel clears its live membership and broadcasts empty snapshots. Owner logout removes the owner's transient membership while the saved offline-owner profile remains available for other members and automatic rejoin.
Cover offline owner (profileFromSave), rejoin via friendsChatLastOwner on login, and owner-name normalisation.
acceptanceCriteria: No ghost membership survives a channel disable or owner logout.
The 501st join evicts exactly one lower-ranked member.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow

Route clan settings/channel packets and //, /c and guest chat through the existing modern clan implementation.

Case/underscore variants resolve to the same member/clan.

Make leave/kick/disband, stale invitation and capacity handling idempotent; retain per-player Hall transaction recovery.

Clan Hall and world transitions match the documented clan settings and interaction behaviour.

items.name: Grouping
devNotes: No server grouping code exists. The cache has GROUP_STORAGE object ids (ObjectIdentifiers.ts:21961-21967) and NpcIdentifiers.GROUP_STORAGE_TUTOR=11230, but nothing spawns or handles them, and the client has no GROUP_* CS2 opcodes (only HIGHLIGHT_GROUP rendering ops), so this is full greenfield.
OSRS Grouping is a group finder plus shared group storage (used by Group Ironman); read the member cap, role names and storage rules from the wiki page rather than hardcoding.

Build on the custom-interface pattern: api.registerCustomInterface for the group/role list and api.registerContentEndpoint for search, following Commands.plugin.js (server/plugins/interface/Commands.plugin.js:201-218).

The old legacy clan plugin (git dde36e2f^) is not a template for grouping - it was friends-chat storage. Group state must be a new cross-plugin event namespace (e.g. grouping:invite) for minigame/co-op consumers, not new PluginManager surface.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2155 — The native Grouping tab again provides minigame teleports. Party invitations, membership and shared group lifecycle remain the separate unimplemented task scope; all four todo statuses are retained.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2258 feat(interface): add Character Summary and persistent PvP statistics. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Create Grouping.plugin.js holding a GroupStore of {id, leader, members:Set<encoded>, invites:Map<encoded,expiry>} with a documented member cap read from the wiki.

Implement create/invite/accept/decline/promote/leave/kick/disband transitions, each validating leader permissions and member liveness; emit a 'grouping:changed' custom event so co-op content can react.
Sync membership with a server-to-client snapshot on every change; add the registerCustomInterface/registerContentEndpoint UI following Commands.plugin.js.
acceptanceCriteria: A leader can form a group, invite a nearby player, and both see the same member list.
Repeated or crossed invites resolve to one membership.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Restrict invite/kick/promote to the leader (or the rank system from the wiki), and reject invites from/to ignored players.
Respect private mode/world restrictions for the finder and return minimal 'cannot invite' feedback without exposing a hidden player.
Enforce that the group cannot be joined through an alternate entrypoint (stale invite, direct storage click) by re-checking membership at the storage handler.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-leader cannot kick or promote.
An ignored player cannot be invited and a hidden player is not leaked by the finder.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Persist group id/role per player (new PlayerSave fields or a persisted attribute registered with api.persistAttribute) and the group record itself.
Normalise member names via the shared accountName helper before keying the group so rename/case cannot fork membership.
Hydrate the group on login before the member list is pushed.
acceptanceCriteria: Membership and role survive relog and server restart.
Case/underscore variants do not create a second member entry.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: On leader disconnect, promote a member or dissolve the group; on member disconnect keep the slot with an offline marker and clean pending invites.
Make the cap check atomic at accept time and scope cleanup to the affected group.
Rate-limit invites with the existing SecondsTimer pattern (as in Trading.ts) rather than a new limiter.
acceptanceCriteria: No ghost member or pending invite remains after a disconnect.
The cap is enforced atomically on the final accept.

items.name: Player following
devNotes: Follow is core, no plugin: PlayerOptionPacketListener option 3 -> FollowPlayerPacketListener.request (PlayerOptionPacketListener.ts:19), which rejects while busy, cancels prior tasks, bounds-checks the index and resolves the leader from World.getPlayers().

FollowPlayerPacketListener.follow sets player.setFollowing(leader), setMobileInteraction(leader) and face-target, then emits PluginManager.emitPlayerFollow for bot follow-back (PluginTypes.ts:651). MovementQueue re-routes toward the leader each tick and stops at the interaction range (MovementQueue.ts:705-716).
Right-click options are numeric: option 1 Attack, 2 Trade, 3 Follow (PlayerOptionPacketListener.ts:12-19); follow is transient and intentionally not persisted, and is cleared on logout/teleport.

Audit (PR #213): edge-case criteria already met in code - live recipient lookup with offline fallback, 200/100 caps before mutation, lowest-rank eviction at 500 and full cleanup on channel disable, follow cleared on leader logout/death and idempotent re-follow. Single-world presence by design.

PR #703 (b7c3ca998, including review fix 1c04dee61): shared Mobile relocation clears follow-owned facing/interaction state for moveTo/smartMove/smartMoves while preserving unrelated facing and NPC following. Logout clears transient follow state; player action dispatch and the follow index-capacity boundary are guarded. Local regression behavior is documented; live OSRS follow edge cases remain unverified.
Main 281766303 (2 November 2026): #1925 preserves following across movement and handles stop conditions consistently.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2308 fix: restore Pandemonium scenes, cargo and boat destruction; #2356 Add configurable cross-floor visibility and combat; #2431 Items: Implement Mithril seed planting. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #3945 Credit a League's thorns damage with the NPC kill it lands on. #3676 Add bot takeover, return and manual behaviour commands. #3228 fix: the phoenix necklace heals the wearer at 20% Hitpoints. 6 merged PRs changed recorded implementation files for this entry.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Keep the path PlayerOptionPacketListener.request(index,3) -> FollowPlayerPacketListener.request -> follow(), with the busy check, TaskManager.cancelTasks and index bounds before resolving the leader.
Preserve the movement setup: reset queues, walkToReset, setFollowing/setMobileInteraction and setPositionToFace.
Let MovementQueue own the per-tick re-route and the stop-at-range behaviour; do not duplicate follow logic in a plugin.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Follow walks the player to the target and keeps them adjacent as the target moves.
Issuing any other interaction cancels the follow.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Follow is not ignore-gated in OSRS; keep it gated only by the live-state checks already present (other players alive, not self, not busy).
Ensure a bot/player being followed cannot be used to bypass the clan-chat friendly-fire block or trade/duel range rules - those remain separate checks.
Do not broadcast extra presence from a follow; it must not reveal a hidden player.
acceptanceCriteria: Following a player who then ignores you still works (no new restriction).
Following cannot pull a player into a locked/instanced area.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Following is transient by design; add nothing to PlayerSave for it.

Clear transient follow, follow-owned interaction and facing in Mobile relocation, and clear the departing player's follow state in Player.logout; retain MovementQueue's normal interaction reset and target-liveness checks.
No normalisation is needed because no names are stored.
acceptanceCriteria: After relog the player is not still following anyone.
Teleport clears the follow target.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Cover leader logout/death/teleport: MovementQueue already nulls the follow when the target is unregistered, dead, or dying (MovementQueue.ts:705-716).
Cover a stale index pointing at a new occupant - request resolves the leader at click time only.
Make follow idempotent when the same target is clicked twice.
acceptanceCriteria: When the leader disconnects the follower stops without error.
Clicking Follow again on the same target produces one follow state.

items.name: Player trading
devNotes: Core engine, no plugin: PlayerOptionPacketListener option 2 -> TradeRequestPacketListener.request (20-tile range, both alive/registered, emits PluginManager.emitTradeRequest and emitCanTrade) -> player.getTrading().requestTrade.

Trading.ts is a two-stage state machine TradeState NONE/REQUESTED_TRADE/TRADE_SCREEN/ACCEPTED_TRADE_SCREEN/CONFIRM_SCREEN/ACCEPTED_CONFIRM_SCREEN (Trading.ts:414). First accept validates the other side's free inventory slots, second accept is the only place items swap. Editing an offer after an accept resets both sides to TRADE_SCREEN (Trading.ts:293-306). 2s request_delay, 1s button_delay.

Wire packets TRADE_REQUEST/TRADE_OPEN/TRADE_UPDATE/TRADE_CLOSE (ServerPackets.ts:111-114) via encodeTradeRequest/encodeTradeOpen/encodeTradeUpdate/encodeTradeClose (ClientProtocol.ts:1138-1159); the client decodes in ServerBinaryDecoder.ts:1616+ and drives widgetActionTrade.ts.
The project already documents the trade state machine as verified (server/docs/networking-protocol-gaps.md, 'Verified working').

Main 0a219d100 (2026-11-03): #1917 shows display names in live player-facing chat, PMs, channels and trades while keeping login identity stable for persistence and moderation. Lookup accepts current and held names.
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2356 Add configurable cross-floor visibility and combat. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Keep the two-step confirmation: requestTrade (walk-to then send) -> initiateTrade opens the offer screen (Trading.ts:154) -> acceptTrade moves TRADE_SCREEN->ACCEPTED_TRADE_SCREEN and only the matching ACCEPTED_CONFIRM_SCREEN pair swaps items (Trading.ts:196-270).
Preserve the symmetric sendState(open) updates plus encodeTradeOpen on open and encodeTradeUpdate thereafter, and the decline/close cleanup that returns offered items to inventory.
Keep the free-slot validation at the first accept and the 'will not be able to hold that item' feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: A completed trade swaps both offered item sets exactly once on the second accept.
Declining or closing returns every offered item to its owner's inventory.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Keep the plugin gates in TradeRequestPacketListener: emitTradeRequest may mark handled, emitCanTrade may deny (the 'You cannot trade here.' path) - used by wilderness/duel/area rules.
Keep the busy/status checks so a player already TRADING or otherwise busy cannot be pulled into a second trade.
Ignore lists do not gate trading in OSRS; do not add an ignore check here.
acceptanceCriteria: A plugin can veto a trade request and no trade screen opens.
A busy target receives 'That player is currently busy.' and no second session starts.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Trades are atomic and transient: do not add offer persistence. The 'persistence' requirement here is that the inventory/container is the sole source of truth and resetAttributes (Trading.ts:351) runs on every close.
On server shutdown or disconnect mid-trade, refund the offerer's container items; verify PlayerDeath/cleanup does not silently drop them.
Keep the trade interface ids (OFFER_INTERFACE 335, CONFIRM_INTERFACE 334, INVENTORY_INTERFACE 336) and the 3322 inventory container constant consistent across restart.
acceptanceCriteria: A server restart mid-offer leaves no items lost or duplicated.
After any close, both containers are empty and status is NONE.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Cover crossed requests (both click Trade in the same tick): the REQUESTED_TRADE check at Trading.ts:131 initiates when both point at each other; verify no double-open.
Cover offer modification after accept - handleItem must reset both sides to TRADE_SCREEN (Trading.ts:295-306).
Cover disconnect mid-trade (closeTrade from the disconnect path), full inventory at accept, and a stale interact target.
acceptanceCriteria: Crossed requests open exactly one trade session.
Changing an offer after accepting forces both players to re-accept.

Some raid disconnect/rejoin, spectating and public mode cases remain incomplete; no generic core party API is required.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2077, #2085 — Raid storage, rewards, wipe/re-entry and encounter-death handling improve existing co-op content. Remaining raid/spectator cases retain partial credit.

taskDetails.name: Implement the interaction flow
steps: Keep the lobby -> team assignment -> shared objective -> reward flow: CastleWars waiting-room portals assign teams and the game tracks flags/scores; PestControl boat/waiting area launches the Void Knight encounter with the portal objectives.

Validate entry requirements and team capacity before teleporting a player into the arena, and broadcast the shared objective state (varp/varbit updates, e.g. CastleWars TIMER_VARP 380, SCORE_VARBIT maps).
Emit a custom event for cross-plugin consumers instead of adding a per-feature PluginManager method.
acceptanceCriteria: Two players entering the same lobby are placed on opposing teams and both see the shared score/timer.
A player without the entry requirement is rejected before teleport.

taskDetails.name: Implement privacy and moderation
steps: Keep friendly-fire rules enforcement: onCanAttack blocks clan-chat members (FriendsList.plugin.js:6) and the wilderness/multiway rules gate the arena; instance/team areas must override the wilderness attack option.
Prevent players from interacting with the opposing team's spawn point/barriers (CastleWars enemy-spawn and team-colour checks).
Return minimal 'not allowed here' feedback without exposing team internals.
acceptanceCriteria: A player cannot attack a teammate where the rules forbid it.
Entering the enemy spawn or removing team colours is blocked with the existing message.

taskDetails.name: Persist relationships and settings
steps: Minigame match state is session-only; guarantee it is fully cleared on world change, logout and match end (CastleWars/PestControl already reset their maps/WeakMaps).
Any lasting reward (minigame points, tickets) must go through PlayerPersistence, not the in-memory match object.
Do not persist team membership across matches.
acceptanceCriteria: Leaving or logging out mid-match removes the player from the team and cleans the arena.
Awarded points survive relog.

taskDetails.name: Handle multiplayer edge cases
steps: Cover disconnect mid-match: remove the player from the team and rebalance/end the match when too few remain (mirror the existing portal/flag empty checks).
Cover uneven teams and simultaneous start by making the lobby/start transition idempotent.
Cover rejoin after disconnect so it cannot duplicate team membership or double-grant rewards.
acceptanceCriteria: A disconnect mid-match leaves no ghost team member or NPC targeting a gone player.
A match cannot start twice for the same lobby session.

items.name: Christmas events
devNotes: Reuse the existing data-driven patterns, not new facilities: NpcSpawns.plugin.js is a one-line registerDefinitionSource, Pickable.plugin.js is the smallest name-based interaction plugin, and CustomShops.plugin.js already drives custom-shops.json.

The Event Shop (custom-shops.json id 28) and Rares Shop (id 23) already stock the historical Christmas rewards; gate access by the active-event window rather than adding a second, parallel item source.
Reward items already exist as generated constants (e.g. ItemIdentifiers.SANTA_HAT, CHRISTMAS_CRACKER, RED_PARTYHAT) - do not mint new item ids, read the cache dump instead.
Main 82657e165: #1567 the original 2025 Christmas definitions and pub rug placements are imported (inactive); #1555 archived seasonal definitions and opt-in transcripts. No activity is wired yet.
Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2298 fix: stock the standard Purple sweets in Pk Supplies. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #2626 — The 2025 Christmas dinner now has its annual window, dinner activity, reward handling and cleanup. Historical Christmas events and full presentation parity are not claimed.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #2628 Holiday events: a shared once-per-account reward helper, used by the four holiday events.

taskDetails.name: Event definition and date-gated scheduling
steps: Implement the reusable scheduler first (see Reusable event scheduler) so this plugin only declares the Christmas window, not the date logic.

Declare the window as data in the new server/data/definitions/events.json keyed 'christmas' (month/day start-end, an enable override and the event area) and load it with api.registerDefinitionSource('events', 'data/definitions/events.json').

In register, subscribe with api.onCustomEvent('events:active', handler) and spawn or tear down Christmas content only while the active payload key matches 'christmas', following the named-function, attach-only plugin shape in AGENTS.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Outside the configured window the event NPCs, objects and windowed shop access are absent from the world.
Forcing the window (scheduler test override) brings the content up without restarting the server, and closing it leaves no residual state.

taskDetails.name: Quest, mini-quest or activity content
steps: Model the annual activity as a short helper task (gather/return to the event NPC) using the general onNpcInteraction and onObjectInteraction name hooks, mirroring how Pickable.plugin.js matches object names.

Spawn event NPCs only inside the active window - via api.spawnNpc({...}) or a window-scoped block appended to npc-spawns data - and never write event-only entries into the permanent server/data/definitions/npc-spawns.json.
Route every Talk-to through server/data/definitions/npc-dialogues.json transcripts (osrsreboxed slugs) as NpcDialogues.plugin.js does, so prose is not embedded in the plugin.
acceptanceCriteria: Every event NPC's Talk-to resolves a transcript, and the activity can be completed and handed in exactly once.
No event NPC remains in the world or in the permanent spawn definitions once the window closes.

taskDetails.name: Rewards and cosmetics
steps: Grant the canonical reward from ItemIdentifiers (e.g. SANTA_HAT, CHRISTMAS_CRACKER, the partyhats) once per account per event: check a per-player attribute before getInventory().adds and never consume the completion when the inventory is full.

Confirm each reward's equip slot and stack/trade flags in server/data/definitions/item-gameplay.json rather than assuming, and set the item price source of truth to server/data/definitions/item-prices.json if the reward is tradeable.
For a container reward such as the Christmas cracker, follow the existing container/item plugins under server/plugins/items/ rather than adding bespoke container code.
acceptanceCriteria: The reward is granted exactly once per account per event; re-login and a full inventory cannot duplicate or delete it.
Every granted id resolves to a real cache definition (confirmed by the identifier audit/dump).

taskDetails.name: Persistence, re-enable and world cleanup

No temporary world objects persist after the event or a restart.

items.name: Reusable event scheduler
devNotes: This is the framework every other item here depends on: one plugin that owns the calendar and the world lifecycle; content plugins subscribe via api.onCustomEvent('events:active', ...) and api.emitCustomEvent, per AGENTS.md's ban on feature-specific PluginManager methods.
Persist per-player state with api.persistAttribute and run time checks from onServerStartup plus a TaskManager-submitted repeating task; use onServerShutdown/onPlayerLogout for cleanup.
World changes must be ephemeral: spawn/stream content for the window and restore it exactly on close, reusing the ProceduralRegionStream clip restore rather than mutating permanent data.

Main 82657e165: #1534 the scheduler: validated UTC windows, one owned task, startup evaluation, repeat-safe shutdown and the documented events:active/events:status contract; #1537 adds the persisted completion unlock. Supersedes #1471.
Main 3e9ee2d67 (11 November 2026) changes touching recorded implementation: #4381 Settings: Ctrl-clicks on NPCs, objects, ground items and players invert the run mode.

taskDetails.name: Event definition and date-gated scheduling
steps: Create server/data/definitions/events.json holding each event's key, window (month/day, with year/anniversary variants where needed), enabled flag and area, and load it with api.registerDefinitionSource('events', 'data/definitions/events.json').

Compute the active set on onServerStartup and re-evaluate on a repeating task submitted via api.getTaskManager().submit(new Task(...)), keeping one owned key per schedule so it can be cancelled on shutdown.
Expose a config/command override (and injectable clock for tests) so windows can be forced without editing code, and define the date authority (UTC) explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: The scheduler resolves the correct active event(s) for a given clock and reacts to window boundaries without a restart.
No schedule is hardcoded in a content plugin and the timer is cancelled on shutdown.

taskDetails.name: Quest, mini-quest or activity content

Keep the scheduler free of feature-specific logic - it only announces windows and orchestrates spawn/despawn through generic APIs (api.spawnNpc/removeNpc, replaceMapRegion/procedural helpers).
Do not add any method to PluginManager; the event name and payload are the only coupling, matching AGENTS.md.
acceptanceCriteria: A content plugin can be added/removed without changing the scheduler, and the event payload shape is documented.
No feature-specific PluginManager surface exists.

Guarantee safe re-runs: activation must be idempotent (no double spawn) and deactivation must fully restore the world before the next window, including after a crash-restart.
Optionally send a login notice through onPlayerLogin for the active event, reading state from the definition rather than hardcoding text.
acceptanceCriteria: Activating twice or closing twice leaves exactly one clean state; a restart mid-event restores and re-applies cleanly.
Permanent spawns, objects and clipping are unchanged after any close path.

items.name: WebGL world renderer
devNotes: Main 688f96a69: #1435 roof checks aboard a docked boat measure from the drawn deck, ending a large FPS drop at busy ports.

SceneBuilder now maps bridge locs between the server plane and map plane, and scene-bridge-locs.test.ts is wired into the client test list alongside the renderer lifecycle, memory and projectile tests.

PR #282 (75647b7c, 57d57d5e): wall decorations resolve their host wall (straight/corner in tile.wall, shape-9 diagonals in tile.locs), apply decorDisplacement plus a one-unit interior nudge (WallDecorationOffset.wallDecorationOffset/wallDecorationNudge), and Scene.light merges every cross-tile ModelData normal before any light() converts models to Model; ModelData.mergeNormals has a +/-2 Y tolerance for cache-authored seams. Covered by wall-decoration-offset.test.ts and model-merge-normals-tolerance.test.ts.
Main sync e811aff0c: PRs #543/#563 make WebGPU the default and add persistent GPU-plugin settings; #591 fixes HiDPI overlay scaling.
PR #726: loc opcodes 6/7 skip the low-detail model block, fixing black roofs at Seers' Village, Civitas illa Fortis and Varlamore (#495).
PRs #746/#747 (ab113827/75e58c77): player rest poses and spot animations are not cached while their frames stream in.

PRs #802/#823 improve player batching, map-streaming budgets, scene preparation, minimap uploads and renderer performance; #802 also imports the upstream 117 HD texture pack. Existing completed renderer criteria stay complete.

Main 8403b60db (4 November 2026): #2034, #2035, #2036, #2048, #2188 — Below-floor actor parts, static NPC facing, ground-item/alpha ordering and scene transitions are repaired; instance exit restores the ordinary map.

Main 3b61a15a8 (6 November 2026): #1669 Custom content: author NPCs, locs, items and their graphics, over the cache; #2256 fix: light scenery before bridge relinking; #2560 Honour explicit GPU and HD settings on mobile. Existing completion credit and documented limitations are retained unless explicitly updated below.
